```ts
test("what the user sets while Claude thinks is still there when the answer lands, and keeps Claude off its place", async () => {
  const { flair, folder, claude, outlines, preview, pieceAt } = await withPoints()
  const countPiece = await pieceAt(s(22.62))
  claude.replies.set(TECHNIQUES_PROMPT.system, { zooms: [{ point: 2, kind: "punch" }], inserts: [] })
  let release = hold(claude)
  const techniques = flair.planTechniques(folder, request())
  await thinking()
  await flair.setZoom(folder, countPiece.anchor, "drift")
  release()
  await techniques
  // Claude's punch on the same piece gives way to the user's drift
  expect((await outlines.get(folder))!.flair!.zooms!.map((zoom) => [zoom.kind, zoom.edited])).toEqual([["drift", true]])

  const edge = (await preview()).slots.find((slot) => slot.anchor.kind === "beat")!
  claude.replies.set(SOUNDS_PROMPT.system, { cues: [{ at: 1, sound: 1 }] })
  release = hold(claude)
  const sounds = flair.planSounds(folder, request())
  await thinking()
  await flair.setCue(folder, edge.anchor, "s2")
  release()
  await sounds
  expect((await outlines.get(folder))!.flair!.cues!.map((cue) => [cue.effectId, cue.edited])).toEqual([
    ["s2", true],
    ["s1", false],
  ])
  // a drift is no punch: its piece is no place of its own, and p-count, which nothing sits on, is
  const offered = textOf(claude.requests.at(-1)!.content)
  expect(offered).not.toContain("ภาพซูมกระแทก")
  expect(offered).toContain("— นับถอยหลัง (รอง · ตัวเลข/ราคา)")

  const spec: CardSpec = { version: "k", box: { x0: 0.1, y0: 0.6, x1: 0.9, y1: 0.75 }, seconds: 2, tone: "base", in: "pop", out: "fade", pieces: [{ kind: "label", text: "ของฉัน", atS: 0 }], why: "" }
  // on p-space, but not where Claude's graphic for p-space starts: the point, not the moment, keeps Claude off
  const mine = { anchor: { kind: "speech" as const, videoId: CLIP_ID, sourceUs: s(18.5), beatId: "beat-1" }, spec, edited: true, off: false, pointId: "p-space" }
  claude.replies.set(GRAPHICS_PROMPT.system, { graphics: [{ ...CARD, point: 1 }, { ...CARD, point: 2 }] })
  release = hold(claude)
  const graphics = flair.planGraphics(folder, request({ graphic: true }))
  await thinking()
  await outlines.update(folder, (stored) => ({ ...stored!, flair: { ...stored!.flair!, graphics: [mine] } }))
  release()
  await graphics
  expect((await outlines.get(folder))!.flair!.graphics!.map((graphic) => [graphic.edited, graphic.pointId])).toEqual([
    [true, "p-space"],
    [false, "p-count"],
  ])
})

test("a beat that gets a new id while Claude thinks keeps what Claude put on it: zooms, cutaways, graphics and sounds", async () => {
  /** Runs one work with Claude held until the beat has grown a new id in the same place; answers what is stored after. */
  const grownDuring = async (h: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof withPoints>>, work: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
    const release = hold(h.claude)
    const running = work()
    await thinking()
    await h.outlines.update(h.folder, (stored) => ({ ...stored!, outline: { ...stored!.outline, beats: stored!.outline.beats.map((beat) => ({ ...beat, id: `${beat.id}-grown` })) } }))
    release()
    await running
    return (await h.outlines.get(h.folder))!.flair!
  }
  const onSpace = { kind: "speech", videoId: CLIP_ID, sourceUs: s(18.08), beatId: "beat-1-grown" }

  const techniques = await withPoints()
  techniques.claude.replies.set(TECHNIQUES_PROMPT.system, { zooms: [{ point: 2, kind: "punch" }], inserts: [{ point: 1, picture: 1 }] })
  const planned = await grownDuring(techniques, () => techniques.flair.planTechniques(techniques.folder, request()))
  expect(planned.zooms!.map((zoom) => [zoom.anchor.beatId, zoom.pointId])).toEqual([["beat-1-grown", "p-count"]])
  expect(planned.inserts!.map((insert) => [insert.anchor, insert.pointId])).toEqual([[onSpace, "p-space"]])

  const graphics = await withPoints()
  graphics.claude.replies.set(GRAPHICS_PROMPT.system, { graphics: [{ ...CARD, point: 1 }] })
  const drawn = await grownDuring(graphics, () => graphics.flair.planGraphics(graphics.folder, request({ graphic: true })))
  expect(drawn.graphics!.map((graphic) => [graphic.anchor, graphic.pointId])).toEqual([[onSpace, "p-space"]])

  const sounds = await withPoints()
  sounds.claude.replies.set(SOUNDS_PROMPT.system, { cues: [{ at: 1, sound: 1 }] })
  const heard = await grownDuring(sounds, () => sounds.flair.planSounds(sounds.folder, request()))
  expect(heard.cues!.map((cue) => [cue.anchor, cue.pointId])).toEqual([[onSpace, "p-space"]])
})

test("Claude may zoom the same footage in both beats that play it, and a zoom the user sets on one leaves the other to Claude", async () => {
  const twice: Beat[] = [{ ...countdown, id: "hook", name: "เปิด" }, countdown]
  // the countdown's words in each beat
  const inHook: EmphasisPoint = { ...POINTS[1]!, id: "p-count-hook", anchor: { kind: "speech", videoId: CLIP_ID, from: 8, to: 11, beatId: "hook" } }
  const { flair, folder, claude, preview } = await withPoints({}, { beats: twice, points: [inHook, POINTS[1]!] })
  const { pieces } = await preview()
  const later = pieces.find((piece) => piece.beatId === "beat-1" && piece.anchor.sourceUs <= s(22.62) && s(22.62) < piece.anchor.sourceUs + piece.durationUs)!
  const hook = pieces.find((piece) => piece.beatId === "hook" && piece.anchor.sourceUs === later.anchor.sourceUs)!
  // the hook plays first, so its point is [1]
  claude.replies.set(TECHNIQUES_PROMPT.system, { zooms: [{ point: 1, kind: "punch" }, { point: 2, kind: "drift" }], inserts: [] })
  await flair.planTechniques(folder, request())
  const zooms = async () => (await preview()).zooms.map((zoom) => [zoom.beatId, zoom.kind, zoom.edited])
  expect(await zooms()).toEqual([
    ["hook", "punch", false],
    ["beat-1", "drift", false],
  ])
  await flair.setZoom(folder, hook.anchor, "drift")
  await flair.planTechniques(folder, request())
  expect(await zooms()).toEqual([
    ["hook", "drift", true],
    ["beat-1", "drift", false],
  ])
})

```

In `apps/desktop/src/main/flair.test.ts` delete every test that calls `.plan(` on a flair service (`flair.plan(`, `slow.plan(`, `base.flair.plan(`): `flair.plan` is gone, and after T5 these tests are about the sounds, zooms, cutaways and graphics it planned. Today they are the tests starting at lines 154, 168, 179, 186, 194, 205, 242, 342, 375, 395, 404, 419, 476, 495, 510, 521, 534, 545, 557, 566, 616, 628, 639, 769, 794, 813, 832, 855, 901, 912, 925, 936, 947, 957, 973, 991, 1012, 1044, 1151, 1170, 1186, 1197, 1240, 1278, 1302, 1326, 1336, 1347, 1383, 1403, 1415, 1421, 1432, 1446, 1456, 1471, 1492, 1503, 1537, 1553, 1569, 1584, 1595, 1611, 1740, 1748 (T5 may already have rewritten the looks ones among them so that they no longer call `.plan(`; those stay). Before deleting them, check each against this map; the cases whose behaviour the new `planTechniques`, `planGraphics` and `planSounds` keep are ported to `flair-plan.test.ts` in this step, one test for each:

| deleted test (today's line) | what it covered | now in `flair-plan.test.ts` |
|---|---|---|
| :769 same footage in both beats, a user zoom on one | `samePiece` keeps beats apart in the merge | "Claude may zoom the same footage in both beats that play it, …" |
| :991 a sound or look set while Claude plans | an edit made during the call survives the merge | "what the user sets while Claude thinks is still there …" (a zoom, a sound and a graphic, each set inside a held call) |
| :1302 a group taken out while Claude plans | the `groupsNow` filter drops Claude's highlight-anchored sound | "a line of text taken out while Claude chooses sounds …" |
| :1326 a sound set by hand this machine no longer has | the `have` filter | "a sound set by hand that this machine no longer has …" |
| :1336 a beatless user cutaway | `samePlace` on an anchor with no beat | "a cutaway set by hand before cutaways knew their beat …" |
| :1347, :1537 a beat that gets a new id mid-call | `answerOnBeats` in all three merges | "a beat that gets a new id while Claude thinks …" (zooms, cutaways, graphics and sounds) |

  ```ts
      /**
       * Polishes the subtitle lines a write with these options would carry, as they show (the text stored
       * for a line, else the generated one), and keeps what the polish changed in the outline's
       * subtitleTexts, by line key; a line the polish turned back into its generated text keeps nothing. A
       * reply that did not fit changes nothing. `count` is how many lines it changed.
       */
      async polishStored(folder: string, rules: CutRules, length: SubtitleLength, hideUnderHighlights: boolean): Promise<{ count: number; accepted: boolean }> {
        const lines = await service.subtitles(folder, rules, length, hideUnderHighlights)
        if (lines.length === 0) return { count: 0, accepted: true }
        const shown = lines.map((line) => line.savedText ?? line.text)
        const result = await service.polish(shown)
        if (!result.accepted) return { count: 0, accepted: false }
        let count = 0
        // onto the outline as it is now: a line the user typed meanwhile is not written over by an answer about another text
        await deps.outlines.update(folder, (latest) => {
          if (!latest) throw new Error("this project has no outline yet")
          const texts = { ...(latest.subtitleTexts ?? {}) }
          count = 0
          lines.forEach((line, i) => {
            const polished = result.lines[i]
            if (polished === undefined || polished === shown[i] || (latest.subtitleTexts?.[line.key] ?? line.text) !== shown[i]) return
            count++
            if (polished === line.text) delete texts[line.key]
            else texts[line.key] = polished
          })
          return { ...latest, subtitleTexts: texts }
        })
        return { count, accepted: true }
      },
  ```

  ```ts
    /**
     * Frames of the footage at each point's first kept moment, for the graphics call: only the ones it will
     * attach — none of a point in `taken` (the user's own, by number from 1) — one extraction per video.
     */
    async function graphicFrames(folder: string, points: GraphicPoint[], looking: LookingSession | undefined, taken: Set<number>): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
      if (!looking?.at || !deps.videoPath) return {}
      const { keys, wanted } = framesWanted(points, taken)
      const files = new Map<string, string>()
      for (const [videoId, moments] of wanted) {
        // a video that cannot be found, or a frame that cannot be taken, only means Claude does not see
        // those points: it points at nothing there
        const path = await deps.videoPath(folder, videoId).catch(() => null)
        if (!path) continue
        const frames = await looking.at(path, moments.map((moment) => moment.sourceUs)).catch(() => [])
        moments.forEach((moment, i) => {
          if (frames[i]) files.set(moment.name, frames[i])
        })
      }
      return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(keys).flatMap(([key, name]) => (files.has(name) ? [[key, files.get(name)!]] : [])))
    }

    /** The emoji the app has pictures of; pictures that cannot be read leave none, and the cards still come. */
    async function knownEmoji(): Promise<ReadonlySet<string> | undefined> {
      if (!deps.emoji) return undefined
      return deps.emoji().then(
        (set) => set.keys,
        (error: unknown) => {
          console.warn(`graphics are planned without stickers or icons: ${emojiReadProblem(error)}`)
          return new Set<string>()
        },
      )
    }

    /** The Claude connection for one work, or why there is none. */
    async function claude(work: string): Promise<{ transport: LlmTransport; model: string }> {
      if (!deps.llm) throw new Error(`${work} is not ready: no Claude connection`)
      return deps.llm()
    }

    /**
     * The text and every placed point, whatever the level: works 2 and 4 plan on all of them (spec §4.3).
     * The loudest level's filter, not SHOW_ALL: an item on a point that is not placed now (its words cut)
     * or no longer exists plays at no level, so nothing is planned on it or around it.
     */
    const everyPoint = (view: HighlightViewOptions, placed: PlacedPoint[]): ShowRules => ({ text: view.highlightsOn, passes: pointFilter(placed, "heavy") })

    /** Claude's items on points it was not shown this time (their words cut for now) wait for those points to come back. */
    const waitingFor =
      (asked: Set<string>) =>
      (item: { edited: boolean; pointId?: string }): boolean =>
        !item.edited && item.pointId !== undefined && !asked.has(item.pointId)
  ```

  ```ts
      /** Work 2b: zooms and cutaways from the points; the user's own stay; stored as soon as they come. */
      async planTechniques(folder: string, request: PostRequest): Promise<{ count: number; dropped: number }> {
        const { rules, view } = request
        if (!view.flair.zoom && !view.flair.insert) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const { transport, model } = await claude("planning zooms and cutaways")
        const { stored, plan, clips } = await deps.timeline.compiled(folder, rules)
        const placed = placedPoints(stored, plan, clips)
        if (placed.length === 0) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const at = timelineOf(plan)
        const beatNames = new Map(stored.outline.beats.map((beat) => [beat.id, beat.name]))
        // the text as it plays with every point shown, which names what a zoomed piece holds
        const timed = timeHighlights(placeStored(stored, plan, clips, everyPoint(view, placed)), at, plan.durationUs)
        const pieces = view.flair.zoom ? zoomSlotsFor({ plan, groups: timed, beatNames, at }) : []
        const points: TechniquePoint[] = placed.map((point: PlacedPoint) => ({
          pointId: point.point.id,
          kind: point.point.anchor.kind,
          importance: point.point.importance,
          type: point.point.type,
          reason: point.point.reason,
          videoId: point.videoId,
          beatId: point.beatId,
          atUs: point.atUs,
          anchor: pointAnchor(point),
          text: pointText(point, clips),
          piece: pointPiece(pieces, point),
        }))
        const pictures = view.flair.insert && deps.media ? await deps.media.list(folder, stored.videoIds) : []
        // the frames Claude looks at stay on disk only as long as this planning does
        const looking = pictures.length > 0 ? deps.frames?.() : undefined
        let planned: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof planTechniques>>
        try {
          const said = await describedMedia(pictures, { transport, model }, looking)
          planned = await planTechniques({ transport, model, brief: stored.brief, points, media: withDescriptions(pictures, said), pictureFrames: await framesFor(pictures, looking) })
        } finally {
          await looking?.dispose()
        }
        const waiting = waitingFor(new Set(points.map((point) => point.pointId)))
        // merged into the outline as it is now: what the user set by hand, before or while Claude thought, stays
        await amend(folder, (latest) => {
          const flair = latest.flair ?? { looks: {} }
          const myZooms = (flair.zooms ?? []).filter((zoom) => zoom.edited)
          const answerZooms = answerOnBeats(planned.zooms, stored.outline.beats, latest.outline.beats)
          const zooms = !view.flair.zoom
            ? (flair.zooms ?? [])
            : [...myZooms, ...(flair.zooms ?? []).filter(waiting), ...answerZooms.filter((zoom) => !myZooms.some((own) => samePiece(own.anchor, zoom.anchor)))]
          const myInserts = (flair.inserts ?? []).filter((insert) => insert.edited)
          const answerInserts = answerOnBeats(planned.inserts, stored.outline.beats, latest.outline.beats)
          const inserts = !view.flair.insert
            ? (flair.inserts ?? [])
            : [...myInserts, ...(flair.inserts ?? []).filter(waiting), ...answerInserts.filter((insert) => !myInserts.some((own) => samePlace(own.anchor, insert.anchor)))]
          return { ...latest, flair: { ...flair, zooms, inserts } }
        })
        return { count: planned.zooms.length + planned.inserts.length, dropped: planned.dropped }
      },

      /**
       * Work 2c: graphics from the points, around the text 2a placed. Claude is shown each point with the
       * scene under it, where the text over it is drawn with the looks in force, a frame at its first kept
       * moment, and the user's own graphics, which keep Claude off their points. With no canvas it answers
       * `skipped: "no-canvas"`, which the run reads as the work being off (contract §3.3).
       */
      async planGraphics(folder: string, request: PostRequest): Promise<{ count: number; dropped: number; skipped?: "no-canvas" }> {
        const { rules, view } = request
        if (!view.flair.graphic) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const { transport, model } = await claude("planning graphics")
        const { stored, plan, clips, canvas } = await deps.timeline.compiled(folder, rules)
        // no frame size to draw on (the first kept video is not in the draft's bin): the run shows the work as skipped, not done
        if (!canvas) return { count: 0, dropped: 0, skipped: "no-canvas" }
        const placed = placedPoints(stored, plan, clips)
        if (placed.length === 0) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const at = timelineOf(plan)
        const beatNames = new Map(stored.outline.beats.map((beat) => [beat.id, beat.name]))
        const spoken = spokenSentences({ plan, wordsOf: wordsIn(clips), beatNames, at })
        // the text as it plays with every point shown, laid out with the looks in force; the custom style draws in bold-white's font
        const groups = placeStored(stored, plan, clips, everyPoint(view, placed))
        const timed = timeHighlights(groups, at, plan.durationUs)
        const looks = looksInForce(stored, timed.map((group) => ({ id: group.groupId, lines: group.lines.map((line) => ({ lineIndex: line.lineIndex, text: line.text.trim() })) })), view.flair, canvas)
        const font = styleFor(styleInForce(stored.highlights), DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS.custom).font
        const bands = textBands({ placed: groups, timed, clips, canvas, font, looks, position: view.position, subtitlesOn: view.subtitlesOn })
        const points = graphicPoints({ points: placed, sentences: spoken, clips, bands })
        const existing = existingGraphics(stored.flair?.graphics ?? [], points)
        const known = await knownEmoji()
        const looking = deps.videoPath ? deps.frames?.() : undefined
        let answer: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof planGraphics>>
        try {
          answer = await planGraphics({
            transport,
            model,
            brief: stored.brief,
            points,
            canvas,
            // the room highlights/layout.ts keeps highlight text above while subtitles are on
            captionsFromY: view.subtitlesOn ? SUBTITLE_ROOM_FROM_Y : null,
            frames: await graphicFrames(folder, points, looking, new Set(existing.map((graphic) => graphic.point))),
            existing,
            known,
          })
        } finally {
          await looking?.dispose()
        }
        const waiting = waitingFor(new Set(points.map((point) => point.pointId)))
        // merged into the outline as it is now: the graphics the user made theirs stay, whenever they did it,
        // and a point one of theirs sits on is theirs; Claude's answer replaces the rest
        await amend(folder, (latest) => {
          const all = latest.flair?.graphics ?? []
          const mine = all.filter((graphic) => graphic.edited)
          const theirs = new Set(mine.flatMap((own) => (own.pointId === undefined ? [] : [own.pointId])))
          const free = answer.graphics.filter((graphic) => graphic.pointId === undefined || !theirs.has(graphic.pointId))
          const answerGraphics = answerOnBeats(free, stored.outline.beats, latest.outline.beats)
          const graphics = [...mine, ...all.filter(waiting), ...answerGraphics.filter((graphic) => !mine.some((own) => samePlace(own.anchor, graphic.anchor)))]
          return { ...latest, flair: { ...(latest.flair ?? { looks: {} }), graphics } }
        })
        // the renders start now, from the stored outline as the preview will read it
        if (deps.graphics && deps.graphicJobs) {
          try {
            deps.graphics.ensure((await deps.graphicJobs(folder, rules, view)).jobs, folder)
          } catch {
            // only an early start: the preview starts whatever is not made yet
          }
        }
        return { count: answer.graphics.length, dropped: answer.dropped }
      },

      /**
       * Work 4: sounds on the slots of soundSlotsFor — the points, and the start of every line of text,
       * graphic and cutaway work 2 put on them, and each punch — whatever the level in force. The user's
       * own sounds stay, unless this machine no longer has them.
       */
      async planSounds(folder: string, request: PostRequest): Promise<{ count: number; dropped: number }> {
        const { rules, view } = request
        if (!view.flair.sound) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const sounds = deps.sounds ? await deps.sounds.list() : []
        if (sounds.length === 0) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const { transport, model } = await claude("planning sounds")
        const { stored, plan, clips } = await deps.timeline.compiled(folder, rules)
        const points = placedPoints(stored, plan, clips)
        if (points.length === 0) return { count: 0, dropped: 0 }
        const at = timelineOf(plan)
        const beatNames = new Map(stored.outline.beats.map((beat) => [beat.id, beat.name]))
        const shown = everyPoint(view, points)
        const timed = timeHighlights(placeStored(stored, plan, clips, shown), at, plan.durationUs)
        const pointOfGroup = new Map((stored.highlights?.groups ?? []).map((group) => [group.id, group.pointId]))
        const groups = timed.map((group) => ({ ...group, pointId: pointOfGroup.get(group.groupId) }))
        const place = placeOf({ slots: slotsFor({ plan, groups: timed, beatNames, at }), sentences: spokenSentences({ plan, wordsOf: wordsIn(clips), beatNames, at }), plan, at })
        // each punch lands where the writer lands it: on the first line of text in its piece, else at its start
        const pieces = zoomSlotsFor({ plan, groups: timed, beatNames, at })
        const byPiece = new Map(pieces.map((piece) => [pieceKey(piece.anchor), piece]))
        const zoomed = zoomsInForce({ zooms: stored.flair?.zooms ?? [], slots: pieces, flair: view.flair, durationUs: plan.durationUs, passes: shown.passes }).kept
        const punches = zoomed.flatMap((zoom) => {
          const piece = byPiece.get(pieceKey(zoom.cue.anchor))
          if (!piece || zoom.cue.kind !== "punch") return []
          const offsetUs = punchAtUs(piece, timed)
          const anchor: CueAnchor = { kind: "speech", videoId: piece.anchor.videoId, sourceUs: piece.anchor.sourceUs + offsetUs, beatId: piece.beatId }
          return [{ atUs: piece.atUs + offsetUs, anchor, pointId: zoom.cue.pointId }]
        })

        const inserts = insertsInForce({ inserts: stored.flair?.inserts ?? [], place, media: pictures, flair: view.flair, durationUs: plan.durationUs, passes: shown.passes }).kept
        // the graphics as they play at the loudest level, where every point shows
        const graphics =

            ? await deps.graphicJobs(folder, rules, { ...view, flair: { ...view.flair, level: "heavy" } }).then(

        const slots = soundSlotsFor({ plan, groups, points, zooms: punches, inserts, graphics, beatNames, at })
        const planned = await planSounds({ transport, model, brief: stored.brief, slots, sounds })
        const have = new Set(sounds.map((sound) => sound.effectId))
        const waiting = waitingFor(new Set(points.map((point) => point.point.id)))
        // merged into the outline as it is now: a place the user chose a sound for — even on a join the cut
        // has moved a little since — is theirs, unless this machine no longer has that sound
        await amend(folder, (latest) => {

          // a line of text taken out meanwhile takes Claude's sound for it with it
          const groupsNow = new Set((latest.highlights?.groups ?? []).map((group) => group.id))
          const answer = answerOnBeats(planned.cues, stored.outline.beats, latest.outline.beats).filter((cue) => cue.anchor.kind !== "highlight" || groupsNow.has(cue.anchor.groupId))
          const next = [...mine, ...cues.filter(waiting), ...answer.filter((cue) => !mine.some((own) => samePlace(own.anchor, cue.anchor)))]
          return { ...latest, flair: { ...(latest.flair ?? { looks: {} }), cues: next } }
        })
        return { count: planned.cues.length, dropped: planned.dropped }
      },
  ```

`apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts` — flair's `llm` (today :360) `llm: () => editingLlm("planning how the highlight text looks"),` becomes `llm: () => editingLlm("planning zooms, cutaways, graphics and sounds"),` (the name only shows in the "is not ready" error).

```ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest"
import { DEFAULT_CUT_RULES } from "@boxblack/core/cut/rules"
import { POST_WORKS, type AppEvent, type HighlightPreview, type HighlightViewOptions, type PostRequest, type PostWork, type StoredOutline } from "../shared/api.ts"
import { CANCELLED } from "./ai-calls.ts"
import type { OutlineStore } from "./planner.ts"
import { createPostPlanService, type PostPlanDeps } from "./post-plan.ts"

const FLAIR = { enabled: true, level: "medium" as const, text: true, sound: true, zoom: true, insert: true, graphic: true }
const REQUEST: PostRequest = {
  rules: DEFAULT_CUT_RULES,
  view: { position: "auto", subtitlesOn: true, highlightsOn: true, flair: FLAIR },
  subtitles: { length: "short", polish: true, hideUnderHighlights: false },
}
const done = (count: number, dropped: number) => ({ state: "done" as const, count, dropped })

/**
 * A project whose works answer at once and write down the order they ran in. The outline holds points at
 * version 4, planned on by neither work; `points` says how many play on the cut.
 */
function harness(points = 2) {
  const order: string[] = []
  const events: AppEvent[] = []
  const previews: HighlightViewOptions[] = []
  let stored = { folder: "/p", emphasis: { points: [], version: 4, plannedOn: { graphics: null, sounds: null }, transcripts: {} } } as unknown as StoredOutline
  const outlines = {
    get: async () => stored,
    update: async (_folder: string, change: (latest: StoredOutline | null) => StoredOutline) => (stored = change(stored)),
  } as unknown as OutlineStore
  const ran = (name: string, answer: { count: number; dropped: number }) => async () => {
    order.push(name)
    return answer
  }
  const deps: PostPlanDeps = {
    outlines,
    emphasis: { plan: ran("emphasis", { count: 3, dropped: 1 }) },
    highlights: {
      pick: async () => {
        order.push("text")
        return { preview: { groups: [{}, {}] } as unknown as HighlightPreview, dropped: 1 }
      },
      preview: async (_folder, _rules, options) => {
        previews.push(options)
        return { emphasis: { points: Array.from({ length: points }, () => ({})) } } as unknown as HighlightPreview
      },
    },
    flair: { planTechniques: ran("techniques", { count: 2, dropped: 0 }), planGraphics: ran("graphics", { count: 1, dropped: 1 }), planSounds: ran("sounds", { count: 4, dropped: 0 }) },
    timeline: {
      polishStored: async () => {
        order.push("subtitles")
        return { count: 2, accepted: true }
      },
    },
    send: (event) => events.push(event),
  }
  /** What the screen was told about one work, in order. */
  const told = (work: PostWork) => events.flatMap((event) => (event.type === "post-plan" && event.work === work ? [event.state.state] : []))
  return { deps, order, events, previews, told, plannedOn: () => stored.emphasis!.plannedOn }
}

  })
  expect(h.order).toEqual(["subtitles", "emphasis", "text", "techniques", "graphics", "sounds"])

})
```

Create `apps/desktop/src/main/post-plan.ts`:

```ts
import type { CutRules } from "@boxblack/core/cut"
import { EMPTY_EMPHASIS } from "@boxblack/core/emphasis/types"
import { POST_WORKS, type AppEvent, type PostRequest, type PostRunView, type PostWork, type PostWorkState, type RethinkWork } from "../shared/api.ts"
import { CANCELLED } from "./ai-calls.ts"
import type { EmphasisService } from "./emphasis.ts"
import type { FlairService } from "./flair.ts"
import type { HighlightService } from "./highlights.ts"
import type { OutlineStore } from "./planner.ts"
import type { TimelineService } from "./timeline.ts"

export interface PostPlanDeps {
  outlines: OutlineStore
  emphasis: Pick<EmphasisService, "plan">
  highlights: Pick<HighlightService, "pick" | "preview">
  flair: Pick<FlairService, "planTechniques" | "planGraphics" | "planSounds">
  timeline: Pick<TimelineService, "polishStored">
  send?: (event: AppEvent) => void
  /** the signal the next stop of the editing room's Claude calls aborts, read as a run starts: a stop pressed between two works ends the run too */
  stopSignal?: () => AbortSignal
}

/** What a work answers: how many things it put down, and how many of Claude's it could not use; `skipped` when it found it had nothing to draw on (graphics with no canvas). */
type Counted = { count: number; dropped: number; skipped?: "no-canvas" }

/** The works each rethink runs; the points go through emphasisOnly. */
const RETHOUGHT: Record<RethinkWork, readonly PostWork[]> = { graphics: ["text", "techniques", "graphics"], sounds: ["sounds"], subtitles: ["subtitles"] }

const messageOf = (error: unknown): string => (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))

export function createPostPlanService(deps: PostPlanDeps) {
  const send = deps.send ?? (() => {})
  /** each project's run as it stands, or as the last one ended, since the app started */
  const runs = new Map<string, PostRunView>()

  /**
   * One run of some works on a project: every work it will touch is marked waiting and the screen told,
   * then each is marked as it runs and ends. The works it does not touch keep how they stood after the
   * project's last run, so thinking one work again does not hide that another failed. A second run on
   * the project is refused while this one goes.
   */
  function begin(folder: string, works: readonly PostWork[]) {
    if (runs.get(folder)?.running) throw new Error("a plan for this project is already running")
    const stop = deps.stopSignal?.()
    let stopped = false
    const view: PostRunView = { running: true, states: { ...(runs.get(folder)?.states ?? {}) } }
    runs.set(folder, view)
    const mark = (work: PostWork, state: PostWorkState) => {
      view.states = { ...view.states, [work]: state }
      send({ type: "post-plan", folder, work, state })
    }
    for (const work of works) mark(work, { state: "waiting" })
    /** the user pressed stop: during a call, which then failed "cancelled", or between two */
    const halted = () => stopped || stop?.aborted === true
    return {
      halted,
      /** Runs one work unless the run was stopped; true when it is done. A failure is kept on the work, not thrown, so the next work still runs. */
      async run(work: PostWork, body: () => Promise<Counted>): Promise<boolean> {
        if (halted()) {
          mark(work, { state: "skipped", reason: "stopped" })
          return false
        }
        mark(work, { state: "running" })
        try {
          const { count, dropped, skipped } = await body()
          // found only once it looked, as the graphics find a rough cut with no canvas: as good as switched off
          if (skipped !== undefined) mark(work, { state: "skipped", reason: "off" })
          else mark(work, { state: "done", count, dropped })
          return true
        } catch (error) {
          const message = messageOf(error)
          if (message === CANCELLED) stopped = true
          mark(work, { state: "failed", error: message })
          return false
        }
      },
      /** A work that does not run: its switch is off, or there is nothing for it to go on; after a stop, it was stopped. */
      skip(work: PostWork, reason: "off" | "no-emphasis"): void {
        mark(work, halted() ? { state: "skipped", reason: "stopped" } : { state: "skipped", reason })
      },
      end(): void {
        view.running = false
        send({ type: "post-plan-finished", folder })
      },
    }
  }
  type Run = ReturnType<typeof begin>

  /** How a project's run stands, as a copy the caller cannot change. */
  function stateOf(folder: string): PostRunView | null {
    const view = runs.get(folder)
    return view ? { running: view.running, states: { ...view.states } } : null
  }

  /** The version of the points as they are stored now. */
  const versionNow = async (folder: string): Promise<number> => (await deps.outlines.get(folder))?.emphasis?.version ?? 0

  /** Notes that a work planned on this version of the points, so the "จุดเน้นเปลี่ยน" banner goes; one that cannot be noted leaves the banner up. */
  async function plannedOn(folder: string, work: "graphics" | "sounds", version: number): Promise<void> {
    await deps.outlines
      .update(folder, (latest) => {
        if (!latest) throw new Error("this project has no outline yet")
        const emphasis = latest.emphasis ?? EMPTY_EMPHASIS
        return { ...latest, emphasis: { ...emphasis, plannedOn: { ...emphasis.plannedOn, [work]: version } } }
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }

  /** Whether any point plays on the rough cut now: works 2 and 4 have nothing to go on without one. */
  async function anyPoint(folder: string, request: PostRequest): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      // the graphics are left out: reading the preview would start their renders
      const preview = await deps.highlights.preview(folder, request.rules, { ...request.view, flair: { ...request.view.flair, graphic: false } })
      return preview.emphasis.points.length > 0
    } catch {
      // a preview that cannot be made leaves the works nothing to plan on
      return false
    }
  }

  /**
   * Work 2 in its three calls, in order: the text (2a), zooms and cutaways (2b), then graphics (2c),
   * which keep clear of the text just placed. A call switched off is skipped; with no point, all are.
   * With points on the cut, the version the points had when it started is noted as planned on when none
   * of the calls that ran failed or was stopped — also when all three are off, since there is then
   * nothing to think again and the "จุดเน้นเปลี่ยน" banner must be able to go (a call switched off is
   * never one a stop kept from running). `afterText` is told once the text is over, however it ended.
   */
  async function workTwo(folder: string, request: PostRequest, run: Run, points: boolean, afterText: () => void = () => {}): Promise<void> {
    const { view } = request
    const version = await versionNow(folder)
    const results: boolean[] = []
    const step = async (work: PostWork, on: boolean, body: () => Promise<Counted>) => {
      if (!on) return run.skip(work, "off")
      if (!points) return run.skip(work, "no-emphasis")
      results.push(await run.run(work, body))
    }
    await step("text", view.highlightsOn, async () => {
      const { preview, dropped } = await deps.highlights.pick(folder, request.rules, view)
      return { count: preview.groups.length, dropped }
    })
    afterText()
    await step("techniques", view.flair.zoom || view.flair.insert, () => deps.flair.planTechniques(folder, request))
    await step("graphics", view.flair.graphic, () => deps.flair.planGraphics(folder, request))
    if (points && results.every(Boolean)) await plannedOn(folder, "graphics", version)
  }

  /** Work 4: the sounds, on the slots of what work 2 put down; noted as planned on as work 2 is, the sounds switched off included. */
  async function workFour(folder: string, request: PostRequest, run: Run, points: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const version = await versionNow(folder)
    if (!request.view.flair.sound) {
      run.skip("sounds", "off")
      // nothing to think again while the sounds are off: the banner that asks for it goes
      if (points) await plannedOn(folder, "sounds", version)
      return
    }
    if (!points) return run.skip("sounds", "no-emphasis")
    if (await run.run("sounds", () => deps.flair.planSounds(folder, request))) await plannedOn(folder, "sounds", version)
  }

  /** Work 5: the subtitles' polish, when subtitles are on and the polish is asked for. */
  function workFive(folder: string, request: PostRequest, run: Run): Promise<unknown> {
    const subtitles = request.subtitles
    if (subtitles === null || !subtitles.polish) {
      run.skip("subtitles", "off")
      return Promise.resolve()
    }
    return run.run("subtitles", async () => {
      const { count, accepted } = await deps.timeline.polishStored(folder, request.rules, subtitles.length, subtitles.hideUnderHighlights)
      // a reply that did not fit leaves every line as it was: one answer Claude gave that could not be used
      return { count, dropped: accepted ? 0 : 1 }
    })
  }

  return {
    /** The run behind the one button (spec §5.1): emphasis; then text, techniques, graphics; then sounds; the subtitles' polish alongside. */
    async plan(folder: string, request: PostRequest): Promise<PostRunView> {
      const run = begin(folder, POST_WORKS)
      try {
        // the polish needs no one, unless the lines under the text are hidden: then it waits for the text
        const waitsForText = request.subtitles?.hideUnderHighlights === true && request.view.highlightsOn
        let polishing: Promise<unknown> | null = waitsForText ? null : workFive(folder, request, run)
        const emphasis = await run.run("emphasis", () => deps.emphasis.plan(folder, request.rules))
        // the points failed or there are none on the cut: works 2 and 4 do not start
        const points = emphasis && (await anyPoint(folder, request))
        await workTwo(folder, request, run, points, () => {
          polishing ??= workFive(folder, request, run)
        })
        polishing ??= workFive(folder, request, run)
        await workFour(folder, request, run, points)
        await polishing
      } finally {
        run.end()
      }
      return stateOf(folder)!
    },

    /** One work again on the points as they are ("graphics" runs text, techniques and graphics); the user's own stays. */
    async rethink(folder: string, work: RethinkWork, request: PostRequest): Promise<PostRunView> {
      const run = begin(folder, RETHOUGHT[work])
      try {
        if (work === "subtitles") await workFive(folder, request, run)
        else {
          const points = await anyPoint(folder, request)
          if (work === "graphics") await workTwo(folder, request, run, points)
          else await workFour(folder, request, run, points)
        }
      } finally {
        run.end()
      }
      return stateOf(folder)!
    },

    /** The points alone, with the same events (the planEmphasis API); a failure is thrown once the events are sent. */
    async emphasisOnly(folder: string, rules: CutRules): Promise<Counted> {
      const run = begin(folder, ["emphasis"])
      const outcome: { counted?: Counted; failure?: unknown } = {}
      try {
        await run.run("emphasis", async () => {
          try {
            outcome.counted = await deps.emphasis.plan(folder, rules)
            return outcome.counted
          } catch (error) {
            outcome.failure = error
            throw error
          }
        })
      } finally {
        run.end()
      }
      if (outcome.counted === undefined) throw outcome.failure instanceof Error ? outcome.failure : new Error(messageOf(outcome.failure))
      return outcome.counted
    },

    /** How the run of this project stands, or how the last one ended; null when none ran since the app started. */
    state: stateOf,
  }
}

export type PostPlanService = ReturnType<typeof createPostPlanService>
```

## Task 7: Renderer — the ClipRoom data container, four stage chips, the write page

The edit room (`screens/EditScreen.tsx`, 770 lines) splits in three (spec §3.2): `room/ClipRoom.tsx` holds every piece of data, effect, listener and the write, and stays mounted while the user moves between post-production and the write page; `screens/PostScreen.tsx` is today's room minus that (a first cut — T8 turns it into the six-tab page); `screens/WriteScreen.tsx` is the new full-page write step (spec §3.4). The stage bar becomes four chips (spec §3.1). No behaviour of the post page changes beyond what the split forces; the write loses its confirm sheet.

**Starting state.** T1–T6 are done. This task relies on what they left, all per the contract: `WriteResult` with `dropped`, `zoomsLost`, `emphasisCount` (T3); `HighlightPreview.zoomsLost` (T3) and `.emphasis: EmphasisView` (T4); `HighlightViewOptions.highlightsOn` and `HighlightRequest.highlightsOn` (T2); `SubtitleLine.savedText` and `setSubtitleText` (T4); `planEmphasis`, `planPost`, `rethinkPost`, `postPlanState`, `PostRequest`, `PostRunView`, `PostWork`, `PostWorkState`, `RethinkWork` and the `post-plan` / `post-plan-finished` events (T4, T6); and `apps/desktop/src/renderer/test/fake-api.ts` defaults for every one of those methods (`postPlanState` answering `null`). Line numbers below are as the code stood on 2026-09-27 before T1; T2–T6 edited `EditScreen.tsx`, `EditScreen.test.tsx` and `App.test.tsx`, so every hunk and every moved test is located by its text or its test title, not by the number alone.

**Decisions this task takes** (the contract left them open, or the code forced them):
- The post page keeps today's four tabs (`BeatPanel` as it is), the clip settings sheet and today's AI menu (pick / flair / polish) until T8. Its screen state is therefore `selectedBeat`, `tab`, `editingGraphic` **plus** `settingsOpen`, `settingsTab` and the old menu's `picking`, `dropped`, `planningFlair`, `flairDropped`, `graphicsError`, `polishing`, `polishNotice`; T8 deletes them with the sheet and the menu.
- `ClipRoomValue` gains two members beyond the contract: `thinking: boolean` and `ask(call)`, which run the old menu's `pickHighlights` / `planFlair` so that Claude's placed answer still meets the room's placement bookkeeping (`latestHighlights`) and holds the write while it thinks. T8 removes both with the old menu. `aiFailure` is exported from `ClipRoom.tsx` for the post page.
- The preview is read whatever is switched on (contract §6.1: "no longer gated on `highlightsOn`"), so the write needs a preview to exist before it may start, and always sends a `HighlightRequest` (contract §2.3).
- The write also waits while a Claude call of the old menu is out (`thinking`) or a plan run is going (`run.running`): both are still changing what the write would carry. Spec §3.4 wants every hold to be a row of the checks, so each of these holds gets a "รอ" row that says why: `write.check.planning` while a run or a Claude call is out, `write.check.placing` while the preview or the subtitle lines are still being read or placed. The CapCut row has a third wording, `write.check.capcutUnknown`, for the moment before the first poll answers, so it never says CapCut is closed before that is known.
- `WriteState`'s `"written"` variant gains `level: FlairLevel | null` (the contract has only `result`): the level the room's settings held when its own write started, `null` for a write it only followed. The result card names that level beside `emphasisCount`, which main counted at it, and not the level on screen now, which the user may have changed on the post page since. A followed write's count is shown without a level (`write.resultEmphasis`).
- A typed subtitle line is saved with `setSubtitleText` once typing rests for 400 ms (one save a pause, not one a letter), and any line still waiting is saved as the room unmounts.
- The write page shows one write button whose label turns into "เขียนอีกครั้ง" after a write (spec §3.4 point 4's button), and the backups list of the page sits in the result card whether or not a write happened yet.
- `edit/WriteBar.tsx` also exports `ACTION_TOAST_MS`, which the room's own toast uses.
- New i18n keys beyond the contract: `write.resultText` ("ข้อความเด่น {count} บรรทัด"): `WriteResult` counts highlight lines, not groups, so `write.text` cannot say it; `write.resultEmphasis` ("จุดเน้น {count} จุด"), for a followed write whose level is unknown; `write.check.planning`, `write.check.placing` and `write.check.capcutUnknown`, the check rows above.
- One i18n key removed beyond contract §7.3: `write.replacing`. Its only user was the confirm sheet in `edit/WriteBar.tsx` (deleted in Step 11), and its only test (`App.test.tsx`, "a restore on the timeline step…") is rewritten in Step 8j to read `warn.timelineReplaced`, as the write page does. Spec §12 says to delete keys nothing uses.
- The room's run keeps the states main keeps: T6's `post-plan.ts` keeps the states of the works a run does not touch (a rethink of one work must not hide that another failed, spec §3.3), so a new run here starts from the last states (`{ running: true, states: current.states }`), each `post-plan` event sets its own work's state on top of them, and `rethink("emphasis")`, whose `planEmphasis` answers only counts, reads `postPlanState(folder)` afterwards instead of guessing. The screen and main then agree on every tab's mark without a remount.
- Mutation lists beyond `t7-room.json` for `ClipRoom.tsx`: `mut25/t7-write.json` for `WriteScreen.tsx`, `mut25/t7-app.json` for `App.tsx` (the stage logic: `reachable`, `storedChanged`, `onStage`, `backupRestored`, the confirm) and `mut25/t7-chips.json` for `StageChips.tsx` (the order and the labels), since spec §9 asks for a mutation check on every file the task touches.
- The test split: the room's own behaviour (claims, following, draft rereads, subtitle texts, the plan run, the post page's toast) goes to `room/ClipRoom.test.tsx`; the placement and graphics-read tests (`EditScreen.test.tsx` 1688–1890) stay with the post page in `PostScreen.test.tsx`, since they act through its flair tab. A shared helper `apps/desktop/src/renderer/test/room.tsx` renders a room with either page.
- The post page marks the placement with `aria-busy` on its `<section>` (no visual change); the moved graphics-read tests watch that instead of the write button, which is no longer on that page.

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { act, render } from "@testing-library/react"
import type { ProjectDetail, RendererApi, StoredOutline } from "../../shared/api.ts"
import { ClipRoom } from "../src/room/ClipRoom.tsx"
import { PostScreen } from "../src/screens/PostScreen.tsx"
import { WriteScreen } from "../src/screens/WriteScreen.tsx"
import { detail, fakeApi, storedOutline, type FakeApi } from "./fake-api.ts"

export type Page = "post" | "write"

export interface RoomOptions {
  /** the page the room opens on; post unless said */
  page?: Page
  capcutRunning?: boolean | null
  claim?: (folder: string | null, api: FakeApi) => void
  project?: ProjectDetail
  stored?: StoredOutline
}

/**
 * The room with one of its pages, and the toolbar the page hands to the app's bar rendered beside it,
 * as the app does. `go` switches the page inside the same room; the post page's own button does too.
 * A write's new backup and a restore bump the write page's list and the room's draft as the app would.
 */
export function renderRoom(overrides: Partial<RendererApi> = {}, options: RoomOptions = {}) {
  const api = fakeApi(overrides)
  const project = options.project ?? detail()
  const stored = options.stored ?? storedOutline({ confirmed: true })
  let outline = 0
  let restored = 0
  let show!: (page: Page) => void
  function Host() {
    const [toolbar, setToolbar] = useState<ReactNode>(null)
    const [page, setPage] = useState<Page>(options.page ?? "post")
    const [backups, setBackups] = useState(0)
    const [draft, setDraft] = useState(0)
    show = setPage
    return (
      <>
        <div className="topbar">{toolbar}</div>
        <ClipRoom
          api={api}
          project={project}
          stored={stored}
          // null is an answer of its own (CapCut not looked for yet), so only a missing option means closed
          capcutRunning={options.capcutRunning === undefined ? false : options.capcutRunning}
          draftVersion={draft}
          claim={options.claim && ((folder) => options.claim!(folder, api))}
          onWritten={() => setBackups((n) => n + 1)}
          page={page}
        >
          {page === "post" ? (
            <PostScreen onEditOutline={() => (outline += 1)} onToolbar={setToolbar} onGoWrite={() => setPage("write")} />
          ) : (
            <WriteScreen
              onToolbar={setToolbar}
              backupsKey={backups}
              onRestored={() => {
                restored += 1
                setBackups((n) => n + 1)
                setDraft((n) => n + 1)
              }}
            />
          )}
        </ClipRoom>
      </>
    )
  }
  render(<Host />)
  return { api, outline: () => outline, restored: () => restored, go: (page: Page) => act(() => show(page)) }
}
```

```tsx
import { userEvent } from "@testing-library/user-event"

import { DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS } from "@boxblack/core/highlights/styles"
import { backupInfo, detail, fakeApi, highlightGroups, highlightPreview, settingsView, subtitleLines } from "../../test/fake-api.ts"
import { renderRoom, type RoomOptions } from "../../test/room.tsx"
import { formatDate } from "../format.ts"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"

afterEach(cleanup)
afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers()
})

const FOLDER = detail().folder

/** The write page in its room, with the toolbar it hands to the app's bar rendered beside it. */
const renderWrite = (overrides: Partial<RendererApi> = {}, options: RoomOptions = {}) => renderRoom(overrides, { page: "write", ...options })

const calls = (api: { calls: unknown[][] }, name: string) => api.calls.filter(([method]) => method === name)
const writeButton = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("timeline.write") })
const writingButton = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("write.writing") })
const againButton = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("write.again") })
const ready = () => screen.findByRole("heading", { name: t("stage.write") })
const card = (title: "write.summaryTitle" | "write.checksTitle" | "write.resultTitle") => within(screen.getByRole("region", { name: t(title) }))
/** Writes as soon as everything the write waits for is in: one click, and no second question. */
const writeNow = async () => {
  await waitFor(() => expect(writeButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", false))
  await userEvent.click(writeButton())
}
const wrote = (pieces = 5, duration = "0:12") => t("write.result", { pieces, duration })
/** What the fake write answers, for events that carry it. */
const writeResult = () => fakeApi().writeTimeline(FOLDER, settingsView().cut, 0, null, null)
const writeEvent = (event: { state: "started" } | { state: "done"; result: WriteResult } | { state: "failed"; error: string }) => ({ type: "timeline-write", folder: FOLDER, ...event }) as AppEvent
const textAndSubtitles = () =>
  settingsView({
    subtitles: { enabled: true, length: "line", polish: true },

/* what the page says before writing */

  const { api } = renderWrite({ getSettings: async () => textAndSubtitles(), previewHighlights: async () => highlightPreview({ groups: highlightGroups() }) })
  await ready()
  const summary = card("write.summaryTitle")
  expect(await summary.findByText(t("write.text", { groups: 2, lines: 3 }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await summary.findByText(`${t("write.video", { pieces: 5, duration: "0:12" })} · ${t("write.target", { target: "0:30" })}`)).toBeTruthy()
  expect(await summary.findByText(t("write.subtitles", { count: 3 }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(summary.getByText(t("write.colour"))).toBeTruthy()

  await writeNow()
  expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(calls(api, "writeTimeline")).toHaveLength(1))
  const [, folder, rules, segments, subtitles, highlights] = calls(api, "writeTimeline")[0]!

test("writing waits while the groups are being placed again, so it never carries an old count", async () => {
  let groups = highlightGroups()
  // the previews asked for once the group is gone are held until the test lets them land, so the timing is the test's own
  let removed = false
  let released = false
  let held = 0
  const waiting: (() => void)[] = []
  const room = renderRoom({
    getSettings: async () => settingsView({ highlights: { enabled: true, position: "auto", hideSubtitles: true, custom: DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS.custom } }),
    previewHighlights: () => {
      const snapshot = groups
      if (!removed || released) return Promise.resolve(highlightPreview({ groups: snapshot }))
      held += 1
      return new Promise((resolve) => waiting.push(() => resolve(highlightPreview({ groups: snapshot }))))
    },
    removeHighlightGroup: async (_folder, groupId) => {
      groups = groups.filter((group) => group.id !== groupId)
      removed = true
    },
  })
  await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: /เปิดเรื่อง/ })
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name: new RegExp(t("edit.tab.text")) }))
  await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: t("highlights.removeGroup") })[0]!)
  await waitFor(() => expect(held).toBeGreaterThan(0))
  // the user goes on to write while the groups are still being placed: the same room, still placing
  room.go("write")
  await ready()
  expect(writeButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  const checks = card("write.checksTitle")
  expect(checks.getByText(t("write.check.placing"))).toBeTruthy()
  released = true
  for (const land of waiting.splice(0)) land()
  await waitFor(() => expect(writeButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", false))
  expect(checks.queryByText(t("write.check.placing"))).toBeNull()
})

test("the draft's backups are listed on the page, and one is put back after a second look", async () => {

test("until the room knows whether a write is running nothing can be written, and a write that ends meanwhile is shown", async () => {
  let known!: (writing: boolean) => void
  const { api } = renderWrite({ writingTimeline: () => new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => (known = resolve)) })
  await ready()
  expect(card("write.checksTitle").getByText(t("write.check.writeKnown"))).toBeTruthy()
  // everything else the write waits for is in: only the question holds it
  await waitFor(() => expect(calls(api, "previewHighlights")).toHaveLength(1))
  await act(async () => {})
  expect(writeButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  const result = await writeResult()
  act(() => api.emit(writeEvent({ state: "done", result })))
  expect(await card("write.resultTitle").findByText(wrote())).toBeTruthy()
  // asked before that write ended and answered after: the answer is out of date
  await act(async () => known(true))
  expect(card("write.checksTitle").queryByText(t("write.check.writeKnown"))).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(againButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", false))
  cleanup()

  // a question that cannot be answered holds nothing up: the main process still refuses a second write
  renderWrite({ writingTimeline: async () => Promise.reject(new Error("no answer")) })
  await ready()
  await waitFor(() => expect(writeButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", false))
  expect(screen.queryByText(/no answer/)).toBeNull()
})

test("a room that cannot learn whether a write is running still tells how one ends", async () => {

  expect(await card("write.resultTitle").findByText(wrote())).toBeTruthy()
})

test("a room that cannot learn whether a write is running tells its own write's end once, even when the event of it comes late", async () => {
  const { api } = renderWrite({ writingTimeline: async () => Promise.reject(new Error("no answer")) })
  await ready()
  await writeNow()
  const result = card("write.resultTitle")
  await result.findByText(wrote())
  // the event of that same write, late: nothing is left to follow, so what it says is not told again
  const late = { ...(await writeResult()), segmentCount: 9 }
  act(() => api.emit(writeEvent({ state: "done", result: late })))
  expect(result.queryByText(wrote(9))).toBeNull()
  expect(result.getByText(wrote())).toBeTruthy()
})

test("the room that started a write shows how it ended once, whether its answer or the event comes first", async () => {
  const result = await writeResult()
  for (const eventFirst of [true, false]) {
    let answer!: (result: WriteResult) => void
    const { api } = renderWrite({ writeTimeline: () => new Promise<WriteResult>((resolve) => (answer = resolve)) })
    await ready()
    await writeNow()
    act(() => api.emit(writeEvent({ state: "started" })))
    // the event says a different length, so a second telling would show
    const told = { ...result, segmentCount: 9 }
    if (eventFirst) {
      act(() => api.emit(writeEvent({ state: "done", result: told })))
      expect(writingButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
    }
    await act(async () => answer(result))
    if (!eventFirst) act(() => api.emit(writeEvent({ state: "done", result: told })))
    const shown = card("write.resultTitle")
    expect(shown.getAllByText(wrote())).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(shown.queryByText(wrote(9))).toBeNull()
    cleanup()
  }
})
```

- [ ] **Step 6: failing tests for the room** — create `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/room/ClipRoom.test.tsx`. It carries `EditScreen.test.tsx` tests 2121 ("the room claims its draft's write ends only once it listens…"), 2139 ("the room gives its claim up in the same moment…"), 2226 ("an answer about the draft the room showed before…"), 2325 ("the timeline is checked again once CapCut is closed…", now on a bare room), 2007 ("a write that left graphics out says so for longer…", now the post page's toast) and the toast half of 1980 ("what was written counts the graphics…": the three graphics wordings of `doneMessage`, read from the post page's toast), and the room's new behaviour:

```tsx
import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from "vitest"
import { useLayoutEffect, useState } from "react"
import { act, cleanup, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react"
import { userEvent } from "@testing-library/user-event"
import type { AppEvent, PostRunView, PostWork, PostWorkState, RendererApi, WriteResult } from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS } from "@boxblack/core/highlights/styles"
import { detail, fakeApi, settingsView, storedOutline, subtitleLines } from "../../test/fake-api.ts"
import { renderRoom } from "../../test/room.tsx"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"
import { WriteScreen } from "../screens/WriteScreen.tsx"
import { ClipRoom, useClipRoom, type ClipRoomProps, type ClipRoomValue } from "./ClipRoom.tsx"

afterEach(cleanup)
afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers()
})

const project = detail()
const FOLDER = project.folder
const stored = storedOutline({ confirmed: true })

const calls = (api: { calls: unknown[][] }, name: string) => api.calls.filter(([method]) => method === name)
const postReady = () => screen.findByRole("heading", { name: /เปิดเรื่อง/ })
const writeReady = () => screen.findByRole("heading", { name: t("stage.write") })
const writeButton = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("timeline.write") })
/** What the fake write answers, for events that carry it. */
const writeResult = () => fakeApi().writeTimeline(FOLDER, settingsView().cut, 0, null, null)
const writeEvent = (event: { state: "started" } | { state: "done"; result: WriteResult } | { state: "failed"; error: string }) => ({ type: "timeline-write", folder: FOLDER, ...event }) as AppEvent
const postEvent = (work: PostWork, state: PostWorkState): AppEvent => ({ type: "post-plan", folder: FOLDER, work, state })
const withSubtitles = { getSettings: async () => settingsView({ subtitles: { enabled: true, length: "line" as const, polish: false } }) }

type RoomProps = Partial<Omit<ClipRoomProps, "children">>

/** The room alone, with a child that hands the test what the room gives its pages. */
function renderProbe(overrides: Partial<RendererApi> = {}, props: RoomProps = {}) {
  const api = fakeApi(overrides)
  let room: ClipRoomValue | null = null
  function Probe() {
    room = useClipRoom()
    return null
  }
  const element = (more: RoomProps) => (
    <ClipRoom api={api} project={project} stored={stored} capcutRunning={false} page="post" {...props} {...more}>
      <Probe />
    </ClipRoom>
  )
  const view = render(element({}))
  return { api, room: () => room!, rerender: (more: RoomProps) => view.rerender(element(more)) }
}

/* one room for both pages */

  const asked = () => ["getSettings", "inspectProject", "previewCut", "previewHighlights", "writingTimeline", "postPlanState"].map((name) => calls(room.api, name).length)
  const before = asked()
  room.go("write")
  await writeReady()

})

    {},
    {
      page: "write",

      },

test("the room gives its claim up in the same moment it leaves the screen, before what replaces it runs", async () => {
  const api = fakeApi()
  const claims: (string | null)[] = []
  let seenByNext: string | null | undefined
  function Next() {
    useLayoutEffect(() => {
      seenByNext = claims.at(-1)
    }, [])
    return null
  }
  let leave!: () => void
  function Host() {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(true)
    leave = () => setOpen(false)
    return open ? (
      <ClipRoom api={api} project={project} stored={stored} capcutRunning={false} page="write" claim={(folder) => claims.push(folder)}>
        <WriteScreen onToolbar={() => {}} backupsKey={0} onRestored={() => {}} />
      </ClipRoom>
    ) : (
      <Next />
    )
  }
  render(<Host />)
  await writeReady()
  act(() => leave())
  expect(seenByNext).toBeNull()
  expect(claims).toEqual([FOLDER, null])
})

test("a write that left graphics out is told for longer on the post page, since it asks the user to do something", async () => {
  const toastTimes = async (graphicsSkipped: number) => {
    // the room opens on a write that is running, and follows it
    const { api } = renderRoom({ writingTimeline: async () => true })
    await postReady()
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: new RegExp(t("edit.settings")) })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true))
    const result = { ...(await writeResult()), graphicCount: 1, graphicsSkipped }
    const scheduled = vi.spyOn(globalThis, "setTimeout")
    act(() => api.emit(writeEvent({ state: "done", result })))
    await screen.findByRole("status")
    const times = scheduled.mock.calls.map(([, ms]) => ms)
    scheduled.mockRestore()
    cleanup()
    return times
  }
  expect(await toastTimes(1)).toContain(12_000)
  const plain = await toastTimes(0)
  expect(plain).toContain(6_000)
  expect(plain).not.toContain(12_000)
})

test("the post page's toast counts the graphics the write placed, and the ones a failed render kept out", async () => {

    const result = { ...(await writeResult()), graphicCount, graphicsSkipped }

test("a plan run going on when the room opens is read from main, its events fill it in, and each work that ends is read again", async () => {

  const lines = calls(api, "previewSubtitles").length

test("thinking the points again keeps how the other works last ended: a failed sounds work still shows failed, as main still says", async () => {
  const failed: PostRunView = { running: false, states: { sounds: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" } } }
  let state: PostRunView | null = failed
  let finish!: () => void
  const { api, room } = renderProbe({
    postPlanState: async () => state,
    planEmphasis: () => new Promise<{ count: number; dropped: number }>((resolve) => (finish = () => resolve({ count: 2, dropped: 0 }))),
  })
  await waitFor(() => expect(room().run).toEqual(failed))
  await waitFor(() => expect(room().request()).not.toBeNull())
  let going!: Promise<void>
  act(() => {
    going = room().rethink("emphasis")
  })
  // while the points are thought again, the sounds tab keeps its mark
  await waitFor(() => expect(room().run).toEqual({ running: true, states: failed.states }))
  state = { running: false, states: { ...failed.states, emphasis: { state: "done", count: 2, dropped: 0 } } }
  await act(async () => {
    finish()
    await going
  })
  expect(room().run).toEqual(state)
  // a new run's first event adds its work to the states it had, rather than starting a list afresh
  act(() => api.emit(postEvent("emphasis", { state: "running" })))
  expect(room().run).toEqual({ running: true, states: { sounds: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" }, emphasis: { state: "running" } } })
})

  cleanup()

  const refused = renderProbe({

      throw new Error("a plan for this project is already running")
    },
  })
  await waitFor(() => expect(refused.room().request()).not.toBeNull())
  await act(async () => {
    await refused.room().planPost()
  })
  expect(refused.room().error).toBe("a plan for this project is already running")
})
```

```tsx
/** Through the stages to post-production, the way a user gets there. */
async function reachPost(api: ReturnType<typeof fakeApi>) {
  render(<App api={api} pollMs={10} />)
  await openProject()
  await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("prepare.start") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", false))
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("prepare.start") }))
  await waitFor(() => expect(api.calls.some(([name]) => name === "startAnalysis")).toBe(true))
  act(() => {
    for (const videoId of ["a", "b"]) {
      api.emit({ type: "transcription", folder: "/drafts/0917", videoId, status: { state: "done", fromCache: false, transcript: transcript("x") } })
      api.emit({ type: "vision", folder: "/drafts/0917", videoId, status: { state: "done", fromCache: false, insight: insight("y") } })
    }
    api.emit({ type: "analysis-finished", folder: "/drafts/0917", outcome: "done" })
  })
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("prepare.next") }))
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("brief.submit") }))
  await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "นักบินอวกาศ" })
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("outline.confirm") }))
  await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: /เปิดเรื่อง/ })
}

/** On to the write page, by the button post-production puts on the bar. */
async function reachWrite(api: ReturnType<typeof fakeApi>) {
  await reachPost(api)
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("post.goWrite") }))
  await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: t("stage.write") })
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: `edit/WriteBar.tsx` keeps only the ends of a write** — replace the whole file (today 102 lines: `WritePhase` :8, `WriteSummary` :10–22, `WriteBarProps` :24–35, `WriteBar` :49–89 go; `doneMessage` :42 becomes exported; `WriteEnd` :92 and `WriteEndToast` :98 stay) with:

```tsx
import type { WriteResult } from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { formatDuration } from "../format.ts"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"
import { Toast } from "../ui/Toast.tsx"

// a toast that asks the user to do something takes longer to read: graphics left out ask them to render
// again and write once more, and a write that failed asks them to write again
export const ACTION_TOAST_MS = 12_000

/** What was written; graphics are counted when there were any, and so are the ones a failed render kept out. */
export function doneMessage(written: WriteResult): string {
  const said = { pieces: written.segmentCount, duration: formatDuration(written.durationUs), graphics: written.graphicCount, skipped: written.graphicsSkipped }
  if (written.graphicsSkipped > 0) return t(written.graphicCount > 0 ? "write.doneGraphicsSkipped" : "write.doneGraphicsAllSkipped", said)
  return t(written.graphicCount > 0 ? "write.doneGraphics" : "write.done", said)
}

/** How a write ended. */
export type WriteEnd = { state: "done"; result: WriteResult } | { state: "failed"; error: string }

/**
 * How a write ended, told when no room of its draft is open to show it: the user may be anywhere
 * in the app, so it says which project the write was for.
 */
export function WriteEndToast({ projectName, end, onDone }: { projectName: string; end: WriteEnd; onDone: () => void }) {
  const message = end.state === "done" ? doneMessage(end.result) : t("write.failed", { message: end.error })
  const long = end.state === "failed" || end.result.graphicsSkipped > 0
  return <Toast message={t("write.away", { project: projectName, message })} ms={long ? ACTION_TOAST_MS : undefined} onDone={onDone} />
}
```
