```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { CUT_PRESETS } from "@boxblack/core/cut/rules"
import { DEFAULT_FLAIR_OPTIONS } from "@boxblack/core/flair/catalogue"
import type {
  CutDecisionChange,
  CutPlan,
  CutPreset,
  CutPresetId,
  CutRules,
  FlairLevel,
  FlairOptions,
  HighlightOptions,
  HighlightPreview,
  PostRequest,
  PostRunView,
  ProjectDetail,
  RendererApi,
  RethinkWork,
  StoredOutline,
  SubtitleLine,
  SubtitleOptions,
  WriteResult,
} from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { ACTION_TOAST_MS, doneMessage } from "../edit/WriteBar.tsx"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"
import { Toast } from "../ui/Toast.tsx"

/**
 * How the write to this draft stands, as the room last heard. A failed one is idle with `error` set.
 * A written one keeps the level its emphasis points were counted at: the room's level when its own
 * write started (the user may change it afterwards), or null for a write the room only followed.
 */
export type WriteState = { kind: "idle" } | { kind: "writing" } | { kind: "written"; result: WriteResult; level: FlairLevel | null }

export interface ClipRoomProps {
  api: RendererApi
  project: ProjectDetail
  stored: StoredOutline
  capcutRunning: boolean | null
  /** bumped when a backup was restored: the draft is no longer what it was */
  draftVersion?: number
  /** tells the app which draft's write ends this room tells itself, and with null that it tells none */
  claim?: (folder: string | null) => void
  /** a write took a new backup */
  onWritten?: () => void
  /** the page showing: a write that ends while the post page shows is told by a toast there */
  page: "post" | "write"
  children: ReactNode
}

export interface ClipRoomValue {
  api: RendererApi
  folder: string
  project: ProjectDetail
  stored: StoredOutline
  capcutRunning: boolean | null
  rules: CutRules | null
  presets: Record<CutPresetId, CutPreset>
  subtitles: SubtitleOptions | null
  highlights: HighlightOptions | null
  flair: FlairOptions | null
  plan: CutPlan | null
  /** read whatever is switched on or off; null until the first answer */
  preview: HighlightPreview | null
  lines: SubtitleLine[] | null
  /** one per line: what the user typed and has not saved yet, else `savedText`, else the generated text */
  texts: string[]
  error: string | null
  setError: (message: string | null) => void
  /** the groups are being placed again: nothing is written meanwhile */
  placing: boolean
  deciding: boolean
  /** a change of the user's is being saved */
  editing: boolean
  /** one of the AI menu's calls that answers with a placed preview is out (see `ask`) */
  thinking: boolean
  /** the main process has said whether a write to this draft is running */
  writeKnown: boolean
  write: WriteState
  /** a write is running: the post page shows but changes nothing */
  writing: boolean
  run: PostRunView
  decide(videoId: string, change: CutDecisionChange): Promise<void>
  changeRules(next: CutRules): void
  changeSubtitles(next: SubtitleOptions): void
  changeHighlights(next: HighlightOptions): void
  changeFlair(next: FlairOptions): void
  /** saves a change to what is stored, then places everything again; answers the failure's message, or null */
  changeHighlightText(action: () => Promise<unknown>, showsFailure?: boolean): Promise<string | null>
  /** a subtitle line typed by the user: shown at once, saved with setSubtitleText once the typing rests (null when back to the generated text) */
  editSubtitle(index: number, text: string): void
  /**
   * runs a Claude call that answers with the groups already placed: the answer is shown unless a newer
   * placement was asked for while it thought, and nothing is written meanwhile. Rejects as the call does.
   */
  ask<T extends { preview: HighlightPreview }>(call: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
  /** the PostRequest for the settings on screen, or null before they are read */
  request(): PostRequest | null
  planPost(): Promise<void>
  rethink(work: RethinkWork | "emphasis"): Promise<void>
  /** runs a write the write page built: marks it as this room's own, follows it to its end, refreshes the project */
  runWrite(call: () => Promise<WriteResult>): Promise<void>
}

const RoomContext = createContext<ClipRoomValue | null>(null)

/** The room the page sits in; only a page inside a ClipRoom may ask. */
export function useClipRoom(): ClipRoomValue {
  const room = useContext(RoomContext)
  if (room === null) throw new Error("useClipRoom is used outside a ClipRoom")
  return room
}

// graphics made in the background are shown as they come, but a burst of them reads the preview once
const GRAPHICS_REFRESH_MS = 500
// how long the user's own colours must stay put before the graphics are read again in them: a colour
// picker changes many times a second while dragged, and each read renders every graphic again
const RECOLOUR_READ_MS = 600
// how long a typed subtitle line rests before it is saved: one save a pause, not one a letter
const SUBTITLE_SAVE_MS = 400

const NO_RUN: PostRunView = { running: false, states: {} }

/** What to tell the user when a Claude call ends badly: nothing when they stopped it, plain words when it ran out of time. */
export const aiFailure = (error: unknown): string | null => {
  const message = (error as Error).message
  if (/\bcancelled$/.test(message)) return null
  if (/\btimed out$/.test(message)) return t("edit.ai.timedOut")
  return message
}

/**
 * Everything the post-production and write pages share about one project: the settings, the rough
 * cut, the placed preview, the subtitle lines, the plan run, and the write. It stays mounted while the
 * user moves between the two pages, so nothing is read or rendered again on the way, and it is the one
 * that claims the draft's write ends from the app.
 */
export function ClipRoom({ api, project: initialProject, stored, capcutRunning, draftVersion, claim, onWritten, page, children }: ClipRoomProps): ReactElement {
  const folder = initialProject.folder
  const [project, setProject] = useState(initialProject)
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<CutRules | null>(null)
  const [presets, setPresets] = useState<Record<CutPresetId, CutPreset>>(CUT_PRESETS)
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<CutPlan | null>(null)
  const [write, setWrite] = useState<WriteState>({ kind: "idle" })
  // whether the main process has said if a write to this draft is running: nothing is written until it has
  const [writeKnown, setWriteKnown] = useState(false)
  // this room's own write: its answer says how it ended, so the events about it are left alone
  const ownWrite = useRef(false)
  // a write this room did not start, running when it opened (the room was left and opened again while
  // the write waited for its graphics): only the events say how that one ends
  const following = useRef(false)
  // a write that ended while the post page showed: told there by a toast
  const [told, setTold] = useState<WriteResult | null>(null)
  const toldDone = useCallback(() => setTold(null), [])
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [subtitles, setSubtitles] = useState<SubtitleOptions | null>(null)
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<SubtitleLine[] | null>(null)
  const [texts, setTexts] = useState<string[]>([])
  // the subtitle lines are read again: a plan run polished them
  const [linesVersion, setLinesVersion] = useState(0)
  const [decisionsVersion, setDecisionsVersion] = useState(0)
  const [deciding, setDeciding] = useState(false)
  const [highlights, setHighlights] = useState<HighlightOptions | null>(null)
  const [flair, setFlair] = useState<FlairOptions | null>(null)
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<HighlightPreview | null>(null)
  // a change to the stored groups: the groups are placed again
  const [highlightsVersion, setHighlightsVersion] = useState(0)
  // graphics were made in the background, can be made now, or are drawn in new colours: the preview is read
  // again for their posters and how their renders stand, and nothing else changed
  const [graphicsVersion, setGraphicsVersion] = useState(0)
  // any change to the groups, including Claude's answer, which arrives already placed
  const [highlightTextVersion, setHighlightTextVersion] = useState(0)
  // a new level was saved: the subtitle lines hide the words of the text that level shows, which the main process reads from the saved settings
  const [levelVersion, setLevelVersion] = useState(0)
  // the groups are being placed again: until they come, lines are named by places that may be stale
  const [placing, setPlacingState] = useState(false)
  // the same, for the placement effect, which must not run again each time placing changes
  const placingNow = useRef(false)
  const setPlacing = (next: boolean) => {
    placingNow.current = next
    setPlacingState(next)
  }
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false)
  // how many of the AI menu's calls are out
  const [thinking, setThinking] = useState(0)
  const [run, setRun] = useState<PostRunView>(NO_RUN)
  const previewedRules = useRef<CutRules | null>(null)
  // answers to earlier previews must not overwrite the one for the latest rules
  const latestPreview = useRef(0)
  const latestSubtitles = useRef(0)
  const latestHighlights = useRef(0)
  // what the last placement was asked for, to tell a read for graphics from a change of the user's
  const placedFor = useRef<unknown[] | null>(null)
  // subtitle lines typed and not saved yet, by key, with the generated text they are forgotten at
  const typed = useRef(new Map<string, { text: string; generated: string }>())
  const saveTimers = useRef(new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>())
  // the page showing, for the ends of writes that arrive between renders
  const pageNow = useRef(page)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    pageNow.current = page
  }, [page])

  const refreshProject = () =>
    api.inspectProject(folder).then(
      (detail) => setProject(detail),
      (e: Error) => setError(e.message),
    )

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshProject()
    api.getSettings().then(
      (settings) => {
        setRules(settings.cut)
        setPresets(settings.cutPresets)
        setSubtitles(settings.subtitles)
        setHighlights(settings.highlights)
        setFlair(settings.flair)
      },
      (e: Error) => setError(e.message),
    )
    // load once for this project
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [api, folder])

  /** A write this room shows the end of: on the write page the page says it, on the post page a toast does. */
  const ended = (result: WriteResult, level: FlairLevel | null) => {
    setWrite({ kind: "written", result, level })
    if (pageNow.current === "post") setTold(result)
  }

  // a write outlives the room: one started here goes on while the user is in the settings or the outline,
  // and the room opened again follows it to its end. Its end is shown once, by whichever room is open
  // when it comes; an end heard while the question is still out is newer than the answer. The app tells
  // the ends no room is open for, so the room claims its draft only once it listens, and gives it up as
  // it leaves the screen: in the commit itself, as a layout effect, not some moment after
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    // an answer that comes after this effect is cleaned up is about a room no longer here
    let live = true
    let asking = true
    let endedWhileAsking = false
    const stop = api.onEvent((event) => {
      if (event.type !== "timeline-write" || event.folder !== folder || ownWrite.current) return
      if (event.state === "started") {
        following.current = true
        setWrite({ kind: "writing" })
        return
      }
      if (!following.current && !asking) return
      following.current = false
      if (asking) endedWhileAsking = true
      if (event.state === "done") {
        // a write this room did not start: the level its points were counted at is not known here
        ended(event.result, null)
        // the draft holds what was written: the next write is checked against that
        void refreshProject()
      } else {
        setError(event.error)
        setWrite({ kind: "idle" })
      }
    })
    api
      .writingTimeline(folder)
      .then(
        (writing) => {
          if (!live || !writing || endedWhileAsking || ownWrite.current) return
          following.current = true
          setWrite({ kind: "writing" })
        },
        // a question that cannot be answered holds nothing up: the main process refuses a second write itself.
        // A write may be running all the same, and no one else is left to tell its end
        () => {
          if (live) following.current = true
        },
      )
      .finally(() => {
        if (!live) return
        asking = false
        setWriteKnown(true)
      })
    claim?.(folder)
    return () => {
      live = false
      stop()
      claim?.(null)
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [api, folder])

  // a restore put another timeline in the draft: the count the write is checked against has changed
  const seenDraft = useRef(draftVersion)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (seenDraft.current === draftVersion) return
    seenDraft.current = draftVersion
    void refreshProject()
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [draftVersion])

  // CapCut may have changed the timeline while it was open; the write refuses a stale count
  const wasRunning = useRef(capcutRunning)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wasRunning.current === true && capcutRunning === false) void refreshProject()
    wasRunning.current = capcutRunning
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [capcutRunning])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!rules) return
    const request = ++latestPreview.current
    // a decision redraws the review in place; new rules start from the waiting message
    if (previewedRules.current !== rules) setPlan(null)
    previewedRules.current = rules
    api.previewCut(folder, rules).then(
      (next) => request === latestPreview.current && setPlan(next),
      (e: Error) => request === latestPreview.current && setError(e.message),
    )
  }, [api, folder, rules, decisionsVersion])

  const highlightsOn = highlights?.enabled === true
  const subtitlesOn = subtitles?.enabled === true
  const highlightPosition = highlights?.position
  const graphicsOn = flair?.graphic === true
  // the whole flair setting drives the placement, so any change to it places the groups again
  const flairKey = JSON.stringify(flair)
  // everything a placement is for; graphics made in the background change none of it
  const placementInputs = [api, folder, rules, highlightsOn, highlightPosition, subtitlesOn, decisionsVersion, highlightsVersion, flairKey]
  // the preview is read whatever is switched on: sounds, zooms, cutaways and graphics play without the text
  useEffect(() => {
    const request = ++latestHighlights.current
    // a read for graphics alone changes nothing the user can act on, so it holds nothing up and a
    // failure keeps the preview on screen. Anything else that changed with it is the user's, and while
    // the user's change is still being placed, this placement stands in for that one: neither is quiet
    const graphicsAlone = placedFor.current !== null && placementInputs.every((input, i) => Object.is(input, placedFor.current![i]))
    placedFor.current = placementInputs
    const quiet = graphicsAlone && !placingNow.current
    if (!rules || !highlightPosition) {
      setPreview(null)
      setPlacing(false)
      return
    }
    if (!quiet) setPlacing(true)
    const settled = () => request === latestHighlights.current && setPlacing(false)
    api.previewHighlights(folder, rules, { position: highlightPosition, subtitlesOn, highlightsOn, flair: flair ?? DEFAULT_FLAIR_OPTIONS }).then(
      (next) => {
        if (request !== latestHighlights.current) return
        setPreview(next)
        settled()
      },
      (e: Error) => {
        if (request !== latestHighlights.current) return
        // the next graphic made, or the user's next change, reads it again
        if (!quiet) setError(e.message)
        settled()
      },
    )
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [...placementInputs, graphicsVersion])

  // each graphic rendered in the background shows as soon as it is made. A burst of them is read at
  // once and then at most every GRAPHICS_REFRESH_MS, always once more after the last, or a row would
  // stay on "rendering"; the graphics renderer sends nothing when a preview queues nothing, so this cannot loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let last = -Infinity
    let due: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
    const refresh = () => {
      due = undefined
      // a clock that never goes back, so a change of the system time cannot hold the next read up
      last = performance.now()
      setGraphicsVersion((version) => version + 1)
    }
    const stop = api.onEvent((event) => {
      // the renderer pack is in: graphics that waited for it are read again, which starts their renders
      const packInstalled = event.type === "graphics-pack" && event.state === "done"
      if ((!packInstalled && (event.type !== "graphics" || event.folder !== folder)) || due !== undefined) return
      const wait = last + GRAPHICS_REFRESH_MS - performance.now()
      if (wait > 0) due = setTimeout(refresh, wait)
      else refresh()
    })
    return () => {
      stop()
      clearTimeout(due)
    }
  }, [api, folder])

  // a plan run outlives the room like a write does: the room opened again asks how it stands, and every
  // work that ends reads again what it changed. An event heard while the question is out is newer than the answer
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true
    let heard = false
    const stop = api.onEvent((event) => {
      if ((event.type !== "post-plan" && event.type !== "post-plan-finished") || event.folder !== folder) return
      heard = true
      if (event.type === "post-plan-finished") {
        setRun((current) => ({ ...current, running: false }))
        return
      }
      // a work's state lands on top of how the others last stood: main keeps the states a run does not touch
      setRun((current) => ({ running: true, states: { ...current.states, [event.work]: event.state } }))
      if (event.state.state !== "done") return
      if (event.work === "subtitles") setLinesVersion((version) => version + 1)
      else setHighlightsVersion((version) => version + 1)
      // new groups change which words the subtitles leave out
      if (event.work === "text") setHighlightTextVersion((version) => version + 1)
    })
    api.postPlanState(folder).then(
      (state) => live && !heard && state !== null && setRun(state),
      // nothing known is nothing running: the run's own events still come
      () => {},
    )
    return () => {
      live = false
      stop()
    }
  }, [api, folder])

  const subtitleLength = subtitles?.length
  const hideUnderHighlights = highlightsOn && highlights?.hideSubtitles === true
  const hiddenWordsVersion = hideUnderHighlights ? `${highlightTextVersion}:${levelVersion}` : ""
  useEffect(() => {
    const request = ++latestSubtitles.current
    setLines(null)
    if (!rules || !subtitlesOn || !subtitleLength) return
    api.previewSubtitles(folder, rules, subtitleLength, hideUnderHighlights).then(
      (next) => {
        if (request !== latestSubtitles.current) return
        setLines(next)
        setTexts(next.map((line) => typed.current.get(line.key)?.text ?? line.savedText ?? line.text))
      },
      (e: Error) => request === latestSubtitles.current && setError(e.message),
    )
  }, [api, folder, rules, subtitlesOn, subtitleLength, decisionsVersion, hideUnderHighlights, hiddenWordsVersion, linesVersion])

  /** Saves the line typed under this key, if it still waits; a line typed back to the generated text is forgotten. */
  const saveTyped = (key: string) => {
    clearTimeout(saveTimers.current.get(key))
    saveTimers.current.delete(key)
    const entry = typed.current.get(key)
    if (!entry) return
    api.setSubtitleText(folder, key, entry.text === entry.generated ? null : entry.text).then(
      // a newer text typed while this one was saved waits for its own save
      () => {
        if (typed.current.get(key) === entry) typed.current.delete(key)
      },
      (e: Error) => setError(e.message),
    )
  }

  // a line typed just before the room goes is saved as it goes, not lost with the timer
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      for (const key of [...saveTimers.current.keys()]) saveTyped(key)
    },
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [],
  )

  const editSubtitle = (index: number, text: string) => {
    const line = lines?.[index]
    setTexts((previous) => previous.map((value, i) => (i === index ? text : value)))
    if (!line) return
    // the key holds the generated text, so a line typed back to it needs no special case
    typed.current.set(line.key, { text, generated: line.text })
    clearTimeout(saveTimers.current.get(line.key))
    saveTimers.current.set(
      line.key,
      setTimeout(() => saveTyped(line.key), SUBTITLE_SAVE_MS),
    )
  }

  const decide = async (videoId: string, change: CutDecisionChange) => {
    setDeciding(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      await api.setCutDecision(folder, videoId, change)
      setDecisionsVersion((version) => version + 1)
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setDeciding(false)
    }
  }

  const changeSubtitles = (next: SubtitleOptions) => {
    setSubtitles(next)
    setError(null)
    void api.updateSettings({ subtitles: next })
  }

  const changeFlair = (next: FlairOptions) => {
    const relevelled = next.level !== flair?.level
    setFlair(next)
    setError(null)
    const saved = api.updateSettings({ flair: next })
    // the subtitle lines leave out the words of the text the level shows, read from the saved settings: read them again once saved
    if (relevelled) void saved.then(() => setLevelVersion((version) => version + 1), () => {})
  }

  // the graphics are drawn in the custom style's colours, which the main process reads from the saved
  // settings: new ones are read again once saved, and once the user has stopped picking
  const recolour = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(recolour.current), [])

  const changeHighlights = (next: HighlightOptions) => {
    const recoloured = JSON.stringify(next.custom) !== JSON.stringify(highlights?.custom)
    setHighlights(next)
    setError(null)
    const saved = api.updateSettings({ highlights: next })
    if (!recoloured || !graphicsOn) return
    clearTimeout(recolour.current)
    recolour.current = setTimeout(() => void saved.then(() => setGraphicsVersion((version) => version + 1), () => {}), RECOLOUR_READ_MS)
  }

  const changeRules = (next: CutRules) => {
    setRules(next)
    setError(null)
    void api.updateSettings({ cut: next })
  }

  const changeHighlightText = async (action: () => Promise<unknown>, showsFailure = false): Promise<string | null> => {
    setEditing(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      await action()
      // the groups on screen are old from here on: nothing is written until they are placed again
      setPlacing(true)
      setHighlightsVersion((version) => version + 1)
      setHighlightTextVersion((version) => version + 1)
      return null
    } catch (e) {
      const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
      if (!showsFailure) setError(message)
      return message
    } finally {
      setEditing(false)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Shows the groups Claude's answer came placed in — unless the rules or settings changed while it
   * thought, and a placement for them was asked for since: then the new groups are placed again.
   */
  const answered = (since: number, placed: HighlightPreview) => {
    if (latestHighlights.current === since) {
      // an older placement still on its way must not replace Claude's answer
      latestHighlights.current += 1
      setPreview(placed)
      setPlacing(false)
    } else setHighlightsVersion((version) => version + 1)
  }

  const ask = async <T extends { preview: HighlightPreview }>(call: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
    setThinking((count) => count + 1)
    setError(null)
    const since = latestHighlights.current
    try {
      const result = await call()
      answered(since, result.preview)
      setHighlightTextVersion((version) => version + 1)
      return result
    } finally {
      setThinking((count) => count - 1)
    }
  }

  const request = (): PostRequest | null => {
    if (!rules || !highlights || !flair || !subtitles) return null
    return {
      rules,
      view: { position: highlights.position, subtitlesOn, highlightsOn, flair },
      subtitles: subtitlesOn ? { length: subtitles.length, polish: subtitles.polish, hideUnderHighlights } : null,
    }
  }

  /** Starts a run of the works this room asks for; the events fill it in, and its answer says how it ended. */
  const running = async (call: (asked: PostRequest) => Promise<PostRunView | null>) => {
    const asked = request()
    if (!asked) return
    setError(null)
    // the works this run does not touch keep their marks, as main keeps their states
    setRun((current) => ({ running: true, states: current.states }))
    try {
      const outcome = await call(asked)
      setRun((current) => outcome ?? { ...current, running: false })
    } catch (e) {
      setError(aiFailure(e))
      setRun((current) => ({ ...current, running: false }))
    }
  }

  const planPost = () => running((asked) => api.planPost(folder, asked))

  const rethink = (work: RethinkWork | "emphasis") =>
    running(async (asked) => {
      if (work !== "emphasis") return api.rethinkPost(folder, work, asked)
      // the points answer with their counts; how the run ended, the other works' states with it, is main's to say
      await api.planEmphasis(folder, asked.rules)
      return api.postPlanState(folder)
    })

  const runWrite = async (call: () => Promise<WriteResult>) => {
    // the write page builds its request from these same settings, so main counts the points at this level
    const level = flair?.level ?? null
    ownWrite.current = true
    setWrite({ kind: "writing" })
    setError(null)
    try {
      const result = await call()
      ended(result, level)
      // the main process let this write run, so no other was running to follow
      following.current = false
      onWritten?.()
      await refreshProject()
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message)
      setWrite({ kind: "idle" })
    } finally {
      ownWrite.current = false
    }
  }

  const value: ClipRoomValue = {
    api,
    folder,
    project,
    stored,
    capcutRunning,
    rules,
    presets,
    subtitles,
    highlights,
    flair,
    plan,
    preview,
    lines,
    texts,
    error,
    setError,
    placing,
    deciding,
    editing,
    thinking: thinking > 0,
    writeKnown,
    write,
    writing: write.kind === "writing",
    run,
    decide,
    changeRules,
    changeSubtitles,
    changeHighlights,
    changeFlair,
    changeHighlightText,
    editSubtitle,
    ask,
    request,
    planPost,
    rethink,
    runWrite,
  }

  return (
    <RoomContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {told && <Toast message={doneMessage(told)} ms={told.graphicsSkipped > 0 ? ACTION_TOAST_MS : undefined} onDone={toldDone} />}
    </RoomContext.Provider>
  )
}
```

Apply Step 2's check to `result.graphicsError`.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react"
import type { GraphicView, HighlightPreview, HighlightStyleId } from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { AiMenu } from "../edit/AiMenu.tsx"
import { BeatPanel, type BeatTab } from "../edit/BeatPanel.tsx"
import { BeatSidebar } from "../edit/BeatSidebar.tsx"
import { byBeat, type BeatFlair } from "../edit/byBeat.ts"
import { ClipSettingsSheet, type SettingsTab } from "../edit/ClipSettingsSheet.tsx"
import { cueKey, FlairTab } from "../edit/FlairTab.tsx"
import { GraphicSheet } from "../edit/GraphicSheet.tsx"
import { HighlightTab } from "../edit/HighlightTab.tsx"
import { SpeechTab } from "../edit/SpeechTab.tsx"
import { SubtitleTab } from "../edit/SubtitleTab.tsx"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"
import { aiFailure, useClipRoom } from "../room/ClipRoom.tsx"
import { Button } from "../ui/Button.tsx"

export interface PostScreenProps {
  onEditOutline: () => void
  onToolbar: (toolbar: ReactNode) => void
  onGoWrite: () => void
}

const EMPTY_FLAIR: BeatFlair = {
  groups: [],
  slots: [],
  cues: [],
  inserts: [],
  pieces: [],
  zooms: [],
  graphics: [],
  counts: { text: 0, sound: 0, zoom: 0, insert: 0, graphic: 0 },
}

/**
 * Claude is asked to plan when there is anything to place: text, a picture, a piece to zoom, a point
 * with a sound for it — or, with graphics on, a sentence the rough cut plays to put one on.
 */
const nothingToPlan = (preview: HighlightPreview, sentences: boolean): boolean =>
  preview.groups.length === 0 && preview.media.length === 0 && preview.pieces.length === 0 && !(preview.slots.length > 0 && preview.sounds.length > 0) && !sentences

/**
 * The post-production page: the beats on the left, and whichever beat is chosen on the right, one side
 * of it at a time. Everything it shows and changes lives in the room around it.
 */
export function PostScreen({ onEditOutline, onToolbar, onGoWrite }: PostScreenProps): ReactElement {
  const room = useClipRoom()
  const { api, folder, stored, rules, presets, plan, preview, lines, texts, subtitles, highlights, flair, error, placing, deciding, editing, thinking, writing } = room
  const [selectedBeat, setSelectedBeat] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<BeatTab>("speech")
  // the graphic whose words, numbers or length are being changed by hand
  const [editingGraphic, setEditingGraphic] = useState<GraphicView | null>(null)
  // the clip settings sheet, until each work's settings sit at the head of its tab
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false)
  const [settingsTab, setSettingsTab] = useState<SettingsTab>("rules")
  // the AI menu's three calls, until the plan run takes their place
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState(false)
  const [dropped, setDropped] = useState(0)
  const [planningFlair, setPlanningFlair] = useState(false)
  const [flairDropped, setFlairDropped] = useState(0)
  // why Claude's last plan left the graphics as they were; the rest of that plan was kept
  const [graphicsError, setGraphicsError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [polishing, setPolishing] = useState(false)
  const [polishNotice, setPolishNotice] = useState<string | null>(null)
  // the lines on screen now: a polish that answers once they were prepared again changes nothing
  const linesNow = useRef(lines)
  useEffect(() => {
    linesNow.current = lines
    setPolishNotice(null)
  }, [lines])

  const highlightsOn = highlights?.enabled === true
  const subtitlesOn = subtitles?.enabled === true
  // each work has its own switch, and every level shows what is switched on: the level only chooses which emphasis points' items play
  const flairOn = flair !== null && (flair.text || flair.sound || flair.zoom || flair.insert || flair.graphic)
  const cutawaysOn = flair?.insert === true
  const graphicsOn = flair?.graphic === true

  const pickHighlights = async () => {
    if (!rules || !highlights || !flair) return
    setPicking(true)
    setDropped(0)
    try {
      const result = await room.ask(() => api.pickHighlights(folder, rules, { position: highlights.position, subtitlesOn, highlightsOn, flair }))
      setDropped(result.dropped)
    } catch (e) {
      room.setError(aiFailure(e))
    } finally {
      setPicking(false)
    }
  }

  const planFlair = async () => {
    if (!rules || !highlights || !flair) return
    setPlanningFlair(true)
    setFlairDropped(0)
    setGraphicsError(null)
    try {
      const result = await room.ask(() => api.planFlair(folder, rules, { position: highlights.position, subtitlesOn, highlightsOn, flair }))
      setFlairDropped(result.dropped)
      setGraphicsError(result.graphicsError ?? null)
    } catch (e) {
      room.setError(aiFailure(e))
    } finally {
      setPlanningFlair(false)
    }
  }

  const polish = async () => {
    const asked = lines
    setPolishing(true)
    setPolishNotice(null)
    room.setError(null)
    try {
      const result = await api.polishSubtitles(texts)
      if (linesNow.current !== asked) return
      result.lines.forEach((text, i) => asked?.[i] && text !== texts[i] && room.editSubtitle(i, text))
      if (!result.accepted) setPolishNotice(t("subtitles.polishRejected"))
    } catch (e) {
      room.setError(aiFailure(e))
    } finally {
      setPolishing(false)
    }
  }

  const beatsById = new Map(stored.outline.beats.map((beat) => [beat.id, beat]))
  // a graphic plays only while graphics are on; the preview may still hold the last ones
  const beatCounts = (beat: BeatFlair): BeatFlair["counts"] => (graphicsOn ? beat.counts : { ...beat.counts, graphic: 0 })
  const flairByBeat = preview && plan ? byBeat(preview, plan).beats : new Map<string, BeatFlair>()
  const beats = (plan?.beats ?? []).map((cut) => ({
    beatId: cut.beatId,
    name: beatsById.get(cut.beatId)?.name ?? cut.beatId,
    videoName: beatsById.get(cut.beatId)?.videoName ?? cut.videoId,
    originalUs: cut.originalUs,
    keptUs: cut.keptUs,
    counts: beatCounts(flairByBeat.get(cut.beatId) ?? EMPTY_FLAIR),
  }))
  const chosen = beats.find((beat) => beat.beatId === selectedBeat) ?? beats[0]
  const chosenIndex = beats.findIndex((beat) => beat.beatId === chosen?.beatId)
  const chosenCut = plan?.beats.find((cut) => cut.beatId === chosen?.beatId)
  const beatFlair = flairByBeat.get(chosen?.beatId ?? "") ?? EMPTY_FLAIR

  const empty = plan !== null && plan.cuts.length === 0
  const busy = deciding || editing || thinking || writing
  const beatLines = lines?.filter((line) => line.beatId === chosen?.beatId).length ?? 0
  // the planning puts graphics on the spoken rows that play, and on nothing else
  const sentences = graphicsOn && plan !== null && plan.beats.some((beat) => beat.rows.some((row) => row.state !== "cut" && row.toggle?.type === "words"))

  // the app's bar carries this page's own buttons
  useEffect(() => {
    onToolbar(
      <>
        <button type="button" className="btn ghost" disabled={writing} onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(true)}>
          {`⚙︎ ${t("edit.settings")}`}
        </button>
        <AiMenu
          onStop={() => void api.cancelAi()}
          items={[
            {
              id: "pick",
              label: t("edit.ai.pick"),
              disabled: writing ? t("edit.ai.writing") : !highlightsOn ? t("edit.ai.offHint") : preview === null ? t("edit.busy") : undefined,
              busy: picking,
              onRun: () => void pickHighlights(),
            },
            {
              id: "flair",
              label: t("edit.ai.flair"),
              disabled: writing
                ? t("edit.ai.writing")
                : !flairOn
                  ? t("edit.ai.offHint")
                  : preview === null
                    ? t("edit.busy")
                    : nothingToPlan(preview, sentences)
                      ? t("edit.ai.nothing")
                      : undefined,
              busy: planningFlair,
              onRun: () => void planFlair(),
            },
            {
              id: "polish",
              label: t("edit.ai.polish"),
              disabled: writing ? t("edit.ai.writing") : !subtitlesOn || !subtitles?.polish ? t("edit.ai.offHint") : (lines?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? t("edit.ai.noLines") : undefined,
              busy: polishing,
              onRun: () => void polish(),
            },
          ]}
        />
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={onGoWrite}>
          {t("post.goWrite")}
        </Button>
      </>,
    )
    // the toolbar is rebuilt whenever anything it shows changes
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [writing, plan, preview, rules, subtitles, highlights, flair, subtitlesOn, highlightsOn, flairOn, picking, planningFlair, polishing, lines, texts])

  return (
    <section className="screen edit" aria-busy={placing}>
      <div className="edit-room">
        <BeatSidebar
          beats={beats}
          selected={chosen?.beatId ?? ""}
          onSelect={setSelectedBeat}
          summary={{
            durationUs: plan?.durationUs ?? 0,
            targetUs: stored.brief.targetSeconds === null ? null : stored.brief.targetSeconds * 1_000_000,
            pieces: plan?.cuts.length ?? 0,
          }}
          onEditOutline={onEditOutline}
          writing={writing}
        />

        <div className="edit-main">
          {error && <p className="notice error">{t("error.generic", { message: error })}</p>}
          {!plan && !error && <p className="hint">{t("timeline.previewing")}</p>}
          {empty && <p className="notice warn-text">{t("timeline.empty")}</p>}

          {chosen && chosenCut && (
            <BeatPanel
              name={chosen.name}
              number={chosenIndex + 1}
              videoName={chosen.videoName}
              originalUs={chosen.originalUs}
              keptUs={chosen.keptUs}
              pieces={chosenCut.pieces.length}
              tab={tab}
              onTab={setTab}
              on={{ text: highlightsOn, subtitles: subtitlesOn, flair: flairOn }}
              counts={{ text: beatFlair.counts.text, subtitles: beatLines, flair: beatFlair.counts.sound + beatFlair.counts.zoom + beatFlair.counts.insert + beatCounts(beatFlair).graphic }}
              onOpenSettings={() => {
                setSettingsTab(tab === "text" ? "highlights" : tab === "subtitles" ? "subtitles" : "flair")
                setSettingsOpen(true)
              }}
              busy={busy}
              writing={writing}
            >
              {tab === "speech" && (
                <SpeechTab
                  folder={folder}
                  cut={chosenCut}
                  busy={deciding || editing || writing}
                  onToggle={(videoId, change) => void room.decide(videoId, change)}
                  onHighlight={
                    highlightsOn && preview
                      ? (videoId, indexes) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.addHighlightGroup(folder, videoId, indexes, preview.maxChars, chosenCut.beatId))
                      : undefined
                  }
                  inserts={cutawaysOn ? beatFlair.inserts : undefined}
                  media={cutawaysOn && preview ? preview.media : undefined}
                  onInsert={cutawaysOn ? (anchor, binId, fit) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setInsert(folder, anchor, binId, fit)) : undefined}
                  graphics={graphicsOn ? beatFlair.graphics : undefined}
                />
              )}
              {tab === "text" && preview && (
                <HighlightTab
                  groups={beatFlair.groups}
                  busy={busy || placing}
                  onEdit={(groupId, index, text) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.editHighlightLine(folder, groupId, index, text))}
                  onRemove={(groupId) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.removeHighlightGroup(folder, groupId))}
                  looks={flair?.text === true}
                  landscape={preview.landscape}
                  onLook={(groupId, patch) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setFlairLook(folder, groupId, patch))}
                />
              )}
              {tab === "subtitles" && lines && (
                <SubtitleTab
                  lines={lines}
                  texts={texts}
                  beatId={chosen.beatId}
                  onEdit={room.editSubtitle}
                  onPolish={subtitles?.polish && lines.length > 0 && !writing ? () => void polish() : null}
                  polishing={polishing}
                  notice={polishNotice}
                  writing={writing}
                />
              )}
              {tab === "flair" && flair && preview && (
                <FlairTab
                  flair={beatFlair}
                  options={flair}
                  sounds={preview.sounds}
                  unused={preview.unusedSounds}
                  media={preview.media}
                  graphicsWaitForPack={preview.graphicsWaitForPack}
                  graphicsProblem={preview.graphicsProblem}
                  graphicsPlanFailed={graphicsError !== null}
                  busy={busy || placing}
                  onCue={(anchor, effectId) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setSoundCue(folder, anchor, effectId))}
                  onInsert={(anchor, binId, fit) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setInsert(folder, anchor, binId, fit))}
                  onZoom={(anchor, kind) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setZoom(folder, anchor, kind))}
                  onGraphic={(anchor, patch) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setGraphic(folder, anchor, patch))}
                  onRetryGraphic={(anchor) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.retryGraphic(folder, anchor))}
                  onEditGraphic={setEditingGraphic}
                />
              )}
            </BeatPanel>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {rules && subtitles && highlights && flair && (
        <ClipSettingsSheet
          open={settingsOpen}
          onClose={() => setSettingsOpen(false)}
          tab={settingsTab}
          onTab={setSettingsTab}
          rules={rules}
          presets={presets}
          onRules={room.changeRules}
          subtitles={subtitles}
          onSubtitles={room.changeSubtitles}
          highlights={highlights}
          onHighlights={room.changeHighlights}
          style={preview ? { value: preview.style, byAi: preview.styleByAi } : null}
          onStyle={(style: HighlightStyleId) => void room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setHighlightStyle(folder, style))}
          flair={flair}
          onFlair={room.changeFlair}
          mediaCount={preview?.media.length ?? 0}
          notices={{
            dropped,
            outlineChanged: preview?.outlineChanged === true,
            needsPictures: preview?.needsPictures === true,
            hidden: preview?.hidden ?? 0,
            flairDropped,
          }}
        />
      )}

      {editingGraphic && (
        <GraphicSheet
          key={cueKey(editingGraphic.anchor)}
          graphic={editingGraphic}
          onClose={() => setEditingGraphic(null)}
          // the sheet says in its own words when this fails, and keeps the user's edits; the message tells it an
          // emoji with no picture from any other failure
          onSave={(anchor, patch) => room.changeHighlightText(() => api.setGraphic(folder, anchor, patch), true)}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  )
}
```

- [ ] **Step 14: the write page** — create `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/screens/WriteScreen.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react"
import type { BackupInfo, FlairLevel, WriteResult } from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { formatDate, formatDuration } from "../format.ts"
import { t, type MessageKey } from "../i18n.ts"
import { useClipRoom } from "../room/ClipRoom.tsx"
import { Button } from "../ui/Button.tsx"
import { Progress } from "../ui/Progress.tsx"

export interface WriteScreenProps {
  onToolbar: (toolbar: ReactNode) => void
  /** bumped when the app's backups change, so the list is read again */
  backupsKey: number
  /** a backup was put back: the app rereads the draft and the backup menu */
  onRestored: () => void
}

type CheckState = "ok" | "wait" | "warn"

const CHECK_WORDS: Record<CheckState, MessageKey> = { ok: "write.check.ok", wait: "write.check.wait", warn: "write.check.warn" }

const LEVEL_NAMES: Record<FlairLevel, MessageKey> = { light: "flair.level.light", medium: "flair.level.medium", heavy: "flair.level.heavy" }

/** What the writers left out, by kind, named as the switches name them. */
const DROPPED_NAMES: Record<keyof WriteResult["dropped"], MessageKey> = { sounds: "flair.sound", zooms: "flair.zoom", inserts: "flair.insert", graphics: "flair.graphic" }

/** One thing checked before writing: how it stands, in words, and anything that shows it further. */
function Check({ state, text, children }: { state: CheckState; text: string; children?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <li className={`write-check ${state}`}>
      <span className="pill">{t(CHECK_WORDS[state])}</span>
      <span>{text}</span>
      {children}
    </li>
  )
}

const dateOf = (backup: BackupInfo) => formatDate(Date.parse(backup.createdAt) * 1000)

/** The draft's backups, newest first, each of which can be put back after a second look. */
function DraftBackups({ refreshKey, onRestored }: { refreshKey: number; onRestored: () => void }) {
  const { api, folder, capcutRunning, writing } = useClipRoom()
  const [backups, setBackups] = useState<BackupInfo[] | null>(null)
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [restoring, setRestoring] = useState(false)
  const [restored, setRestored] = useState<BackupInfo | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true
    api.listBackups(folder).then(
      (list) => alive && setBackups(list),
      (e: Error) => alive && setError(e.message),
    )
    return () => {
      alive = false
    }
  }, [api, folder, refreshKey])

  const restore = async (backup: BackupInfo) => {
    setRestoring(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      await api.restoreBackup(folder, backup.id)
      setConfirming(null)
      setRestored(backup)
      onRestored()
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message)
    } finally {
      setRestoring(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="write-backups">
      <h3>{t("write.backupsTitle")}</h3>
      {error && <p className="danger-text">{t("error.generic", { message: error })}</p>}
      {restored && <p className="ok-text">{t("backups.restored", { date: dateOf(restored) })}</p>}
      {backups?.length === 0 && <p className="hint">{t("backups.empty")}</p>}
      {backups && backups.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="backup-list">
          {backups.map((backup) => (
            <li key={backup.id} className="backup-row">
              <span>
                {backup.segmentCount === 0
                  ? t("backups.itemEmpty", { date: dateOf(backup) })
                  : t("backups.item", { date: dateOf(backup), duration: formatDuration(backup.durationUs), count: backup.segmentCount })}
              </span>
              {confirming === backup.id ? (
                <div className="backup-confirm">
                  <p>{t("backups.confirmRestore")}</p>
                  <div className="backup-confirm-actions">
                    <Button size="sm" disabled={restoring} onClick={() => setConfirming(null)}>
                      {t("backups.cancel")}
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={restoring || writing || capcutRunning !== false} onClick={() => void restore(backup)}>
                      {t("backups.confirm")}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <Button size="sm" disabled={capcutRunning !== false || writing} onClick={() => setConfirming(backup.id)}>
                  {t("backups.restore")}
                </Button>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/** The write page: summary, checks before writing, the write button (no second confirm), the result with every real count and the backups. */
export function WriteScreen({ onToolbar, backupsKey, onRestored }: WriteScreenProps): ReactElement {
  const room = useClipRoom()
  const { api, folder, project, stored, plan, preview, lines, texts, rules, subtitles, highlights, flair, capcutRunning, writeKnown, write: state, writing, placing, thinking, run, error } = room

  // the write button sits on the page itself: the bar carries nothing of this page's
  useEffect(() => {
    onToolbar(null)
  }, [onToolbar])

  const highlightsOn = highlights?.enabled === true
  const subtitlesOn = subtitles?.enabled === true
  const graphicsOn = flair?.graphic === true
  const empty = plan !== null && plan.cuts.length === 0
  const subtitlesReady = !subtitlesOn || lines !== null
  // the write carries the group count on screen: not while the groups are being placed again, or a
  // Claude call or a plan run may still change them
  const placed = preview !== null && !placing && !thinking && !run.running
  const canWrite = capcutRunning === false && writeKnown && plan !== null && !empty && subtitlesReady && placed && !writing && rules !== null && highlights !== null && flair !== null

  // a graphic switched off is not written, and one whose render failed is left out of the write
  const playing = graphicsOn ? (preview?.graphics.filter((graphic) => !graphic.off) ?? []) : []
  const rendered = playing.filter((graphic) => graphic.render === "ready").length
  const failed = playing.filter((graphic) => graphic.render === "failed").length
  const shownPoints = preview?.emphasis.points.filter((point) => point.shown).length ?? 0
  const levelName = flair ? t(LEVEL_NAMES[flair.level]) : ""
  const off = (what: MessageKey) => t("write.off", { what: t(what) })

  const write = () => {
    if (!canWrite || !rules || !highlights || !flair || !preview) return
    void room.runWrite(() =>
      api.writeTimeline(folder, rules, project.timelineSegmentCount, subtitlesOn && subtitles ? { length: subtitles.length, texts } : null, {
        position: highlights.position,
        hideSubtitles: highlights.hideSubtitles,
        highlightsOn,
        groupCount: preview.groups.length,
        flair,
      }),
    )
  }

  const written = state.kind === "written" ? state : null
  const result: WriteResult | null = written?.result ?? null
  const targetUs = stored.brief.targetSeconds === null ? null : stored.brief.targetSeconds * 1_000_000

  return (
    <section className="screen write">
      <div className="screen-head">
        <h1>{t("stage.write")}</h1>
      </div>
      <div className="content write-page">
        {error && <p className="notice error">{t("error.generic", { message: error })}</p>}
        {!plan && !error && <p className="hint">{t("timeline.previewing")}</p>}
        {empty && <p className="notice warn-text">{t("timeline.empty")}</p>}

        <section className="card" aria-label={t("write.summaryTitle")}>
          <div className="card-head">
            <h2>{t("write.summaryTitle")}</h2>
          </div>
          <ul className="card-body write-list">
            <li>
              {t("write.video", { pieces: plan?.cuts.length ?? 0, duration: formatDuration(plan?.durationUs ?? 0) })}
              {targetUs !== null && ` · ${t("write.target", { target: formatDuration(targetUs) })}`}
            </li>
            <li>{t("write.emphasis", { count: shownPoints, level: levelName })}</li>
            <li>
              {highlightsOn
                ? t("write.text", { groups: preview?.groups.length ?? 0, lines: preview?.groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.lines.length, 0) ?? 0 })
                : off("highlights.title")}
            </li>
            <li>{graphicsOn ? t("write.graphics", { count: playing.length - failed }) : off("flair.graphic")}</li>
            <li>{flair?.zoom ? t("write.zooms", { count: preview?.zooms.length ?? 0 }) : off("flair.zoom")}</li>
            <li>{flair?.insert ? t("write.inserts", { count: preview?.inserts.length ?? 0 }) : off("flair.insert")}</li>
            <li>{flair?.sound ? t("write.sounds", { count: preview?.cues.length ?? 0 }) : off("flair.sound")}</li>
            <li>{subtitlesOn ? t("write.subtitles", { count: texts.filter((text) => text.trim()).length }) : off("subtitles.title")}</li>
            <li>{t("write.colour")}</li>
            {(preview?.zoomsLost ?? 0) > 0 && <li className="warn-text">{t("write.zoomsLost", { count: preview!.zoomsLost })}</li>}
          </ul>
        </section>

        <section className="card" aria-label={t("write.checksTitle")}>
          <div className="card-head">
            <h2>{t("write.checksTitle")}</h2>
          </div>
          <ul className="card-body write-checks">
            {/* before the first poll answers it is not known whether CapCut is closed, so the row does not say it is */}
            <Check
              state={capcutRunning === false ? "ok" : "wait"}
              text={t(capcutRunning === true ? "write.check.capcutOpen" : capcutRunning === false ? "write.check.capcut" : "write.check.capcutUnknown")}
            />
            {!writeKnown && <Check state="wait" text={t("write.check.writeKnown")} />}
            {/* every hold on the button has a row: a plan run or a Claude call may still change what is written */}
            {(run.running || thinking) && <Check state="wait" text={t("write.check.planning")} />}
            {(placing || preview === null || !subtitlesReady) && <Check state="wait" text={t("write.check.placing")} />}
            {playing.length > 0 && (
              <Check state={rendered + failed === playing.length ? "ok" : "wait"} text={t("write.check.graphics", { done: rendered, total: playing.length })}>
                <Progress value={rendered / playing.length} label={t("write.check.graphics", { done: rendered, total: playing.length })} />
              </Check>
            )}
            {failed > 0 && <Check state="warn" text={t("write.check.graphicsFailed", { count: failed })} />}
            {!project.versionTested && <Check state="warn" text={t("warn.untestedVersion", { version: project.capcutVersion })} />}
            {project.timelineSegmentCount > 0 ? (
              <Check state="warn" text={t("warn.timelineReplaced", { count: project.timelineSegmentCount })} />
            ) : (
              <Check state="ok" text={t("write.fresh")} />
            )}
          </ul>
        </section>

        <div className="write-action">
          <Button variant="primary" disabled={!canWrite} onClick={write}>
            {writing ? t("write.writing") : result ? t("write.again") : t("timeline.write")}
          </Button>
          <p className="hint">{t("write.backup")}</p>
        </div>

        <section className="card" aria-label={t("write.resultTitle")}>
          <div className="card-head">
            <h2>{t("write.resultTitle")}</h2>
          </div>
          <div className="card-body">
            {result && (
              <ul className="write-list">
                <li>{t("write.result", { pieces: result.segmentCount, duration: formatDuration(result.durationUs) })}</li>
                {/* the level the points were counted at, not the one on screen now */}
                <li>
                  {written?.level
                    ? t("write.emphasis", { count: result.emphasisCount, level: t(LEVEL_NAMES[written.level]) })
                    : t("write.resultEmphasis", { count: result.emphasisCount })}
                </li>
                <li>{t("write.resultText", { count: result.highlightCount })}</li>
                <li>{t("write.graphics", { count: result.graphicCount })}</li>
                <li>{t("write.zooms", { count: result.zoomCount })}</li>
                <li>{t("write.inserts", { count: result.insertCount })}</li>
                <li>{t("write.sounds", { count: result.soundCount })}</li>
                <li>{t("write.subtitles", { count: result.captionCount })}</li>
                {(Object.keys(DROPPED_NAMES) as (keyof WriteResult["dropped"])[]).map(
                  (kind) =>
                    result.dropped[kind] > 0 && (
                      <li key={kind} className="warn-text">
                        {t("write.resultDropped", { what: t(DROPPED_NAMES[kind]), count: result.dropped[kind] })}
                      </li>
                    ),
                )}
                {result.graphicsSkipped > 0 && <li className="warn-text">{t("write.resultSkipped", { count: result.graphicsSkipped })}</li>}
                {result.zoomsLost > 0 && <li className="warn-text">{t("write.zoomsLost", { count: result.zoomsLost })}</li>}
              </ul>
            )}
            <DraftBackups refreshKey={backupsKey} onRestored={onRestored} />
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
```

## Task 8: Renderer — post-production page with six tabs and the emphasis tab

Spec §3.3 (and §4.4 for the emphasis edits, §5.1 for the plan button and the AI menu). Builds on T7's `room/ClipRoom.tsx` (`useClipRoom()`, `ClipRoomValue` of contract §6.1) and T7's first `screens/PostScreen.tsx`, which this task replaces whole. Paths below are under `apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/` unless they start with `apps/` or `packages/`. Line numbers are today's (2026-09-27); where T2–T7 have edited a file since, the hunk is found by its content, which this task quotes in full.

What T8 relies on from T7 (T7 plan, Steps 3, 7, 12–14): `ClipRoom` reads `postPlanState` when it mounts; a `post-plan` event sets `run.running` and that work's state, `post-plan-finished` ends the run; `planPost()`/`rethink()` set `running: true` while their call is out, keeping the states of the works they do not touch (as main keeps them), and take its answer after; `rethink("emphasis")` calls `api.planEmphasis(folder, rules)` and then reads `postPlanState(folder)`, `rethink(work)` calls `api.rethinkPost(folder, work, request())`, `planPost()` calls `api.planPost(folder, request())`; `editSubtitle` saves through `setSubtitleText` once typing rests 400 ms; `writing` is true while a write this room follows runs. The test helper `apps/desktop/src/renderer/test/room.tsx` (`renderRoom`) renders the room with a page, and `PostScreen.test.tsx`'s `renderScreen` is `renderRoom(…, { page: "post" })`; its `placing()` helper reads `aria-busy` on `section.edit`, which this task's page keeps. T7 gave `ClipRoomValue` two members for the old AI menu only — `thinking` and `ask(call)` — and said T8 removes them with that menu: Step 12 does, in `room/ClipRoom.tsx` and `screens/WriteScreen.tsx`. From T4: `fake-api.ts` exports `emphasisView(extra)` (an `EmphasisView` with no point, sentence or scene) and `highlightPreview()` carries `emphasis: emphasisView()`.

**Deviations from the contract (§6.2, §7), and why:**
- `BeatPanelProps` gains `strip?: ReactNode`: the plan strip sits between the tab bar and the tab's body, which only the panel can place.
- `EmphasisTabProps` gains `chosenPicture?: (point) => string | undefined`: the picture picker marks the picture a point shows now, and only the page can find the cutaway on a point. Its `dropped` doc names where the number comes from: `run.states.emphasis`, the last run of the points, which main keeps (and the room with it, T7) while other works are thought again, so the note stays until the points are planned again, the same way the strip's own line does.
- `AiMenu` takes `running: string | null` and `AiItem` has no `busy`: only one run goes at a time (the whole plan or one work), so the menu names that run and brings the stop button, and no item has a busy state of its own. `onStop` is unchanged.
- `postTabs.ts` also exports `failureText`, `wasStopped` and `pointLabel`: the plan strip, the tab flags and the room share one rule for "a stop is not an error" and "timed out in plain words" (T7's `aiFailure` is rebuilt on `failureText` in Step 12), and the graphics, sound and highlight lists share one way to name a point.

```ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest"
import type { EmphasisPointView } from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"
import { failureText, pointLabel, POST_TABS, TAB_OF_WORK, tabRuns, wasStopped } from "./postTabs.ts"

test("the six tabs are in the order of the work, and each work of the run fills one of them", () => {
  expect(POST_TABS).toEqual(["cut", "emphasis", "graphics", "colour", "sound", "subtitles"])
  expect(TAB_OF_WORK).toEqual({ emphasis: "emphasis", text: "graphics", techniques: "graphics", graphics: "graphics", sounds: "sound", subtitles: "subtitles" })
})

test("a tab spins while a work of it runs, is flagged when one failed, and is idle otherwise", () => {
  const runs = tabRuns({
    running: true,
    states: {
      emphasis: { state: "done", count: 4, dropped: 0 },
      text: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" },
      techniques: { state: "running" },
      sounds: { state: "waiting" },
      subtitles: { state: "failed", error: "timed out" },
    },
  })
  expect(runs).toEqual({
    cut: { state: "idle" },
    emphasis: { state: "idle" },
    graphics: { state: "running" },
    colour: { state: "idle" },
    sound: { state: "idle" },
    subtitles: { state: "failed", error: "timed out" },
  })
})

test("a failed work of a tab shows until another work of that tab runs", () => {
  expect(tabRuns({ running: true, states: { text: { state: "running" }, techniques: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" } } }).graphics).toEqual({ state: "running" })
  expect(tabRuns({ running: false, states: { text: { state: "done", count: 1, dropped: 0 }, graphics: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" } } }).graphics).toEqual({
    state: "failed",
    error: "Claude is busy",
  })
})

    tabRuns({ running: false, states: {} }),

})
```

```tsx
    sounds: [{ effectId: "s1", name: "ปัง" }],
    cues: [{ anchor: { kind: "highlight", groupId: "g1", line: 0 }, atUs: 100_000, what: 'ข้อความเด่น "เอาล่ะ"', beatId: "b1", effectId: "s1", soundName: "ปัง", edited: false }],
    emphasis: emphasisOf(),
  })
  renderScreen({
    getSettings: async () =>
      settingsView({
        highlights: { enabled: true, position: "auto", hideSubtitles: true, custom: DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS.custom },
        subtitles: { enabled: true, length: "line", polish: false },
      }),
    previewHighlights: async () => preview,
  })
  await ready()
  expect(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง").getAttribute("aria-current")).toBe("true")
  expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).getByText(t("edit.beatLength", { before: "5.1", after: "4.5" }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText(t("edit.summaryTarget", { total: "0:12", target: "0:30", pieces: 5 }))).toBeTruthy()
  // the rough cut has no marks of its own
  expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).queryByText(/Aa|🔊|★|CC/)).toBeNull()
  await openTab("graphics")
  // the fake's groups sit in the first and the last beat
  await waitFor(() => expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).getByText("Aa 1")).toBeTruthy())
  expect(within(beatPick("ปิดท้าย")).getByText("Aa 1")).toBeTruthy()
  expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).queryByText("🔊 1")).toBeNull()
  await openTab("sound")
  expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).getByText("🔊 1")).toBeTruthy()
  expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).queryByText("Aa 1")).toBeNull()
  await openTab("emphasis")
  expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).getByText("★ 1")).toBeTruthy()
  // the picture beat's point is held back by the level, so it marks nothing
  expect(within(beatPick("ภาพประกอบ")).queryByText(/★/)).toBeNull()
  await openTab("subtitles")
  await waitFor(() => expect(within(beatPick("เปิดเรื่อง")).getByText("CC 2")).toBeTruthy())
  expect(within(beatPick("ปิดท้าย")).getByText("CC 1")).toBeTruthy()
})

test("a plan run shows on the tabs: a spinner on those working, a warning on one that failed, and counts once they are done", async () => {
  const { api } = renderScreen(withPoints())
  await ready()
  act(() => {
    api.emit(planEvent("emphasis", { state: "done", count: 2, dropped: 0 }))
    api.emit(planEvent("text", { state: "running" }))
    api.emit(planEvent("sounds", { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" }))
    api.emit(planEvent("subtitles", { state: "failed", error: "cancelled" }))
  })
  await waitFor(() => expect(within(tab("graphics")).getByRole("img", { name: t("post.tabBusy") })).toBeTruthy())
  expect(tab("graphics").querySelector(".tab-count")).toBeNull()
  // the strip under the tabs names the work running, over a bar of how many of the run's works are over: three of four
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.running", { work: t("post.work.text") }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByRole("progressbar", { name: t("post.planRunning") }).getAttribute("aria-valuenow")).toBe("75")
  expect(within(tab("sound")).getByRole("img", { name: t("post.tabFailed") })).toBeTruthy()
  // the user's stop is not a failure
  expect(within(tab("subtitles")).queryByRole("img")).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(tab("emphasis").querySelector(".tab-count")!.textContent).toBe("1"))
  act(() => api.emit(planEvent("text", { state: "done", count: 1, dropped: 0 })))
  await waitFor(() => expect(within(tab("graphics")).queryByRole("img", { name: t("post.tabBusy") })).toBeNull())
  expect(tab("graphics").querySelector(".tab-count")).not.toBeNull()
})

test("the strip under the tabs says how each work went: counts, what could not be used, a skip, a failure, and a stop in plain words", async () => {
  renderScreen({
    postPlanState: async () => ({
      running: false,
      states: {
        emphasis: { state: "done", count: 5, dropped: 2 },
        text: { state: "done", count: 3, dropped: 0 },
        techniques: { state: "skipped", reason: "off" },
        graphics: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" },
        sounds: { state: "failed", error: "cancelled" },
        subtitles: { state: "skipped", reason: "stopped" },
      },
    }),
  })
  await ready()
  const work = (id: PostWork) => t(`post.work.${id}` as MessageKey)
  expect(await screen.findByText(t("post.run.done", { work: work("emphasis"), count: 5 }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.dropped", { work: work("emphasis"), count: 2 }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.done", { work: work("text"), count: 3 }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.queryByText(t("post.run.dropped", { work: work("text"), count: 0 }))).toBeNull()
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.off", { work: work("techniques") }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.failed", { work: work("graphics"), message: "Claude is busy" }))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.stopped"))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.queryByText(/cancelled/)).toBeNull()
  // nothing runs, so there is no bar
  expect(screen.queryByRole("progressbar")).toBeNull()
})

test("when the points fail, the works that stand on them are skipped and the strip says why, while the polish still runs", async () => {
  renderScreen({
    postPlanState: async () => ({
      running: false,
      states: {
        emphasis: { state: "failed", error: "Claude is busy" },
        text: { state: "skipped", reason: "no-emphasis" },
        techniques: { state: "skipped", reason: "no-emphasis" },
        graphics: { state: "skipped", reason: "no-emphasis" },
        sounds: { state: "skipped", reason: "no-emphasis" },
        subtitles: { state: "done", count: 2, dropped: 0 },
      },
    }),
  })
  await ready()
  const work = (id: PostWork) => t(`post.work.${id}` as MessageKey)
  expect(await screen.findByText(t("post.run.failed", { work: work("emphasis"), message: "Claude is busy" }))).toBeTruthy()
  for (const skipped of ["text", "techniques", "graphics", "sounds"] as const) {
    expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.noEmphasis", { work: work(skipped) }))).toBeTruthy()
  }
  expect(screen.getByText(t("post.run.done", { work: work("subtitles"), count: 2 }))).toBeTruthy()
  // a skip is not a failure of its own: only the points' tab is flagged
  expect(within(tab("emphasis")).getByRole("img", { name: t("post.tabFailed") })).toBeTruthy()
  expect(within(tab("graphics")).queryByRole("img")).toBeNull()
  expect(within(tab("sound")).queryByRole("img")).toBeNull()
})

  expect(screen.getByText(t("edit.flairInserts"))).toBeTruthy()
  expect(screen.queryByRole("radio", { name: t("highlights.position.bottom") })).toBeNull()
})

test("while a write runs nothing on the post page can be changed, since the write already took what it writes", async () => {
  renderScreen({
    ...withGraphics({ graphics: [GRAPHIC], emphasis: emphasisOf() }),
    getSettings: async () =>
      settingsView({
        subtitles: { enabled: true, length: "line", polish: true },
        highlights: { enabled: true, position: "auto", hideSubtitles: true, custom: DEFAULT_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS.custom },
        flair: GRAPHICS_ON,
      }),
    writingTimeline: async () => true,
  })
  await ready()
  await waitFor(() => expect(within(speechRows()[1]!).getByRole("button", { name: t("timeline.action.keep") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true))
  expect(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: t("timeline.preset.loose") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(planButton()).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)

  await openTab("emphasis")
  await screen.findByText("เอาล่ะครับ")
  expect(within(pointRow("เอาล่ะครับ")).getByRole("combobox", { name: t("emphasis.importance") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("emphasis.deleteLabel", { text: "เอาล่ะครับ" }) })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: t("flair.level.heavy") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)

  await openTab("graphics")
  expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: t("highlights.lineLabel", { number: 1, time: "0:00.1" }) })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(graphicButton("graphics.offLabel")).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(graphicButton("graphics.editLabel")).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: new RegExp(`^${t("flair.graphic")}`) })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)

  await openTab("sound")
  expect(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: t("flair.sound") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  expect(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: t("flair.sound.label", { what: 'ข้อความเด่น "เอาล่ะ"' }) })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)

  await openTab("subtitles")
  const line = (await screen.findAllByRole("textbox"))[0] as HTMLInputElement
  // shut as it looks, rather than taking the typing and dropping it
  expect(line).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  await userEvent.type(line, "!")
  expect(line.value).toBe("สวัสดีครับวันนี้")
  expect(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: t("subtitles.enabled") })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)

  const menu = await openAi()
  for (const work of ["emphasis", "graphics", "sounds", "subtitles"] as const) {
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("button", { name: t(`post.ai.rethink.${work}` as MessageKey) })).toHaveProperty("disabled", true)
  }
  expect(within(menu).getAllByText(t("edit.ai.writing"))).toHaveLength(4)
})

})
```

Create `edit/postTabs.ts`:

```ts
import { POST_WORKS, type EmphasisPointView, type PostRunView, type PostWork } from "../../../shared/api.ts"
import { t } from "../i18n.ts"

/** The six tabs of the post-production page, in the order of the work. */
export const POST_TABS = ["cut", "emphasis", "graphics", "colour", "sound", "subtitles"] as const
export type PostTab = (typeof POST_TABS)[number]

/** Which tab each work of the run fills. */
export const TAB_OF_WORK: Record<PostWork, PostTab> = { emphasis: "emphasis", text: "graphics", techniques: "graphics", graphics: "graphics", sounds: "sound", subtitles: "subtitles" }

/** How a tab stands in the run: a spinner while a work of it runs, a warning when one failed (not stopped), else its count. */
export type TabRun = { state: "idle" } | { state: "running" } | { state: "failed"; error: string }

/**
 * What a failed Claude call's message tells the user: nothing when it was their own stop, plain words
 * when it ran out of time, else the message as it came. The room's `aiFailure` and the plan strip both
 * use it, so the two cannot drift apart.
 */
export function failureText(error: string): string | null {
  if (/\bcancelled$/.test(error)) return null
  if (/\btimed out$/.test(error)) return t("edit.ai.timedOut")
  return error
}

/** A failure that is the user's own stop, which is not a failure to show. */
export const wasStopped = (error: string): boolean => failureText(error) === null

/** Each tab's state in the run: a running work of a tab says more than a failed one. */
export function tabRuns(run: PostRunView): Record<PostTab, TabRun> {
  const runs = Object.fromEntries(POST_TABS.map((tab) => [tab, { state: "idle" } as TabRun])) as Record<PostTab, TabRun>
  for (const work of POST_WORKS) {
    const state = run.states[work]
    const tab = TAB_OF_WORK[work]
    if (state?.state === "running") runs[tab] = { state: "running" }
    else if (state?.state === "failed" && !wasStopped(state.error) && runs[tab].state !== "running") runs[tab] = { state: "failed", error: state.error }
  }
  return runs
}

/** Which point an item was made for, in the user's words; null for an item bound to none, or to a point not on the cut now. */
export function pointLabel(points: EmphasisPointView[], pointId: string | undefined): string | null {
  if (pointId === undefined) return null
  const point = points.find((one) => one.id === pointId)
  return point ? t("emphasis.from", { text: point.text }) : null
}
```

Replace `edit/byBeat.ts`:

```ts
import type { CutPlan, CueView, EmphasisPointView, GraphicView, HighlightGroupView, HighlightPreview, InsertView, ZoomView } from "../../../shared/api.ts"

/** Everything the post page shows for one beat, or for the whole clip. */
export interface BeatFlair {
  groups: HighlightGroupView[]
  slots: HighlightPreview["slots"]
  cues: CueView[]
  inserts: InsertView[]
  pieces: HighlightPreview["pieces"]
  zooms: ZoomView[]
  graphics: GraphicView[]
  /** the emphasis points placed in it */
  points: EmphasisPointView[]
  counts: { text: number; sound: number; zoom: number; insert: number; graphic: number; emphasis: number }
}

const empty = (): BeatFlair => ({
  groups: [],
  slots: [],
  cues: [],
  inserts: [],
  pieces: [],
  zooms: [],
  graphics: [],
  points: [],
  counts: { text: 0, sound: 0, zoom: 0, insert: 0, graphic: 0, emphasis: 0 },
})

const byTime = <T extends { atUs: number }>(items: T[]): T[] => [...items].sort((a, b) => a.atUs - b.atUs)

/** The lists in playing order, and what they count. */
const settled = (flair: BeatFlair): BeatFlair => ({
  groups: [...flair.groups].sort((a, b) => a.startUs - b.startUs),
  slots: byTime(flair.slots),
  cues: byTime(flair.cues),
  inserts: byTime(flair.inserts),
  pieces: byTime(flair.pieces),
  zooms: byTime(flair.zooms),
  graphics: byTime(flair.graphics),
  points: byTime(flair.points),
  counts: {
    text: flair.groups.length,
    sound: flair.cues.length,
    zoom: flair.zooms.length,
    insert: flair.inserts.length,
    // a graphic switched off is listed so it can be switched back on, but it does not play
    graphic: flair.graphics.filter((graphic) => !graphic.off).length,
    // a point the level holds back is listed so it can be changed, but nothing plays on it
    emphasis: flair.points.filter((point) => point.shown).length,
  },
})

/** Puts every item of the preview where `into` says its beat is. */
function pour(preview: HighlightPreview, into: (beatId: string) => BeatFlair): void {
  for (const group of preview.groups) into(group.beatId).groups.push(group)
  for (const slot of preview.slots) into(slot.beatId).slots.push(slot)
  for (const cue of preview.cues) into(cue.beatId).cues.push(cue)
  for (const insert of preview.inserts) into(insert.beatId).inserts.push(insert)
  for (const piece of preview.pieces) into(piece.beatId).pieces.push(piece)
  for (const zoom of preview.zooms) into(zoom.beatId).zooms.push(zoom)
  for (const graphic of preview.graphics) into(graphic.beatId).graphics.push(graphic)
  for (const point of preview.emphasis.points) into(point.beatId).points.push(point)
}

/**
 * Sorts a preview's flat lists into the beats of the plan, in time order inside each. Anything
 * whose beat is not on the rough cut lands in the last beat rather than disappearing — it is still
 * on the timeline somewhere, and the user has to be able to reach it.
 */
export function byBeat(preview: HighlightPreview, plan: CutPlan): { beats: Map<string, BeatFlair>; orphaned: number } {
  const beats = new Map<string, BeatFlair>()
  for (const beat of plan.beats) beats.set(beat.beatId, empty())
  if (beats.size === 0) return { beats, orphaned: 0 }

  const last = plan.beats.at(-1)!.beatId
  let orphaned = 0
  pour(preview, (beatId) => {
    const found = beats.get(beatId)
    if (found) return found
    orphaned++
    return beats.get(last)!
  })
  for (const [beatId, flair] of beats) beats.set(beatId, settled(flair))
  return { beats, orphaned }
}

/** Everything the preview holds, as one list for the whole clip, in playing order. */
export function wholeClip(preview: HighlightPreview): BeatFlair {
  const all = empty()
  pour(preview, () => all)
  return settled(all)
}
```
