```ts
  /**
   * runs a Claude call that answers with the groups already placed: the answer is shown unless a newer
   * placement was asked for while it thought, and nothing is written meanwhile. Rejects as the call does.
   */
  ask<T extends { preview: HighlightPreview }>(call: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
```

from the state:

```ts
  // how many of the AI menu's calls are out
  const [thinking, setThinking] = useState(0)
```

the two functions (`answered` served `ask` alone):

```ts
  /**
   * Shows the groups Claude's answer came placed in — unless the rules or settings changed while it
   * thought, and a placement for them was asked for since: then the new groups are placed again.
   */
  const answered = (since: number, placed: HighlightPreview) => {
    if (latestHighlights.current === since) {
      // an older placement still on its way must not replace Claude's answer
      latestHighlights.current += 1
      setPreview(placed)
      setPlacing(false)
    } else setHighlightsVersion((version) => version + 1)
  }

  const ask = async <T extends { preview: HighlightPreview }>(call: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
    setThinking((count) => count + 1)
    setError(null)
    const since = latestHighlights.current
    try {
      const result = await call()
      answered(since, result.preview)
      setHighlightTextVersion((version) => version + 1)
      return result
    } finally {
      setThinking((count) => count - 1)
    }
  }
```

and from the `value` object the lines `    thinking: thinking > 0,` and `    ask,`.

```ts
/** What to tell the user when a Claude call ends badly: nothing when they stopped it, plain words when it ran out of time. */
export const aiFailure = (error: unknown): string | null => {
  const message = (error as Error).message
  if (/\bcancelled$/.test(message)) return null
  if (/\btimed out$/.test(message)) return t("edit.ai.timedOut")
  return message
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict"
import { test } from "node:test"
import { applyAdjust, findAdjust, keptAfterResave, mainPieces, SLIDERS, type Info, type SliderName } from "./adjust.mts"

const CODE = Object.fromEntries(SLIDERS.map((slider) => [slider.name, slider.code])) as Record<SliderName, number>

/** Two pieces on the main track (listed out of time order on purpose), each with its own speed and canvas, and one overlay piece. */
function draft(): Info {
  return {
    platform: { app_version: "9.5.0" },
    tracks: [
      {
        type: "video",
        flag: 0,
        segments: [
          { id: "SEG2", material_id: "V2", extra_material_refs: ["S2", "C2"], target_timerange: { start: 1_000_000, duration: 1_000_000 }, enable_adjust: false },
          { id: "SEG1", material_id: "V1", extra_material_refs: ["S1", "C1"], target_timerange: { start: 0, duration: 1_000_000 }, enable_adjust: false },
        ],
      },
      { type: "video", flag: 2, segments: [{ id: "OV", material_id: "V3", extra_material_refs: [], target_timerange: { start: 0, duration: 500_000 } }] },
    ],
    materials: {
      videos: [{ id: "V1" }, { id: "V2" }, { id: "V3" }],
      speeds: [{ id: "S1", speed: 1 }, { id: "S2", speed: 1 }],
      canvases: [{ id: "C1", type: "canvas_color" }, { id: "C2", type: "canvas_color" }],
      effects: [],
    },
  }
}

/** The first piece after the user moved the six sliders, stored the way JianYing-family drafts store adjusts: one effect per slider at slider ÷ 50. */
function adjustedAsEffects(): Info {
  const info = draft()
  const first = mainPieces(info)[0]!
  const effects = SLIDERS.map((slider, i) => ({ id: `E${i}`, type: slider.name, value: slider.user / 50, path: `/effects/${slider.name}`, apply_target_type: 0 }))
  ;(info.materials.effects as unknown[]).push(...effects)
  first.extra_material_refs = ["S1", ...effects.map((effect) => effect.id), "C1"]
  first.enable_adjust = true
  return info
}

/** Both pieces already carry a zeroed hsl-like material; the user's adjust changes the first one's in place, at slider ÷ 100. */
function withHsl(): { opened: Info; adjusted: Info } {
  const opened = draft()
  const zero = Object.fromEntries(SLIDERS.map((slider) => [slider.name, 0]))
  opened.materials.hsl = [{ id: "H1", ...zero }, { id: "H2", ...zero }]
  mainPieces(opened)[0]!.extra_material_refs.push("H1")
  mainPieces(opened)[1]!.extra_material_refs.push("H2")
  const adjusted = structuredClone(opened)
  Object.assign((adjusted.materials.hsl as Record<string, unknown>[])[0]!, Object.fromEntries(SLIDERS.map((slider) => [slider.name, slider.user / 100])))
  return { opened, adjusted }
}

  assert.deepEqual(format.changed, [])
  assert.deepEqual(format.segmentFields, { enable_adjust: true })
  assert.deepEqual(format.others, [])
  assert.deepEqual(format.notes, [])

    assert.deepEqual(format.sliders[slider.name], { where: "added", index: i, path: ["value"], stored: slider.user / 50, ratio: 0.02 })
  }
})

  const adjusted = draft()
  adjusted.materials.adjusts = [{ id: "A1", type: "adjust", params: Object.fromEntries(SLIDERS.map((slider) => [slider.name, slider.user])) }]
  mainPieces(adjusted)[0]!.extra_material_refs.push("A1")

  assert.deepEqual(format.segmentFields, {})

})

test("a material the piece already had is changed in place, and the other piece's own material is changed the same way", () => {

  assert.deepEqual(format.changed.map((entry) => [entry.listKey, entry.refIndex, entry.leaves.length]), [["hsl", 2, 6]])
  assert.deepEqual(format.sliders.temperature, { where: "changed", index: 0, path: ["temperature"], stored: -29 / 100, ratio: 0.01 })
  assert.deepEqual(format.others, [])

test("a slider whose number is not a plain multiple of what was set is reported missing, not guessed", () => {
  const adjusted = adjustedAsEffects()
  const effects = adjusted.materials.effects as { type: string; value: number }[]
  effects.find((effect) => effect.type === "temperature")!.value = 0.123
  const format = findAdjust(draft(), adjusted)

  assert.ok(format.notes.some((note) => note.startsWith("temperature: ")))

test("the same block goes onto another piece with new ids, the code's values and that piece's own refs; the draft given is left alone", () => {
  const opened = draft()
  // as write-adjust.mts reads it back from format.json
  const format = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(findAdjust(opened, adjustedAsEffects())))
  let n = 0

  assert.equal(second!.enable_adjust, true)
  assert.deepEqual(first!.extra_material_refs, ["S1", "C1"])
  assert.equal(first!.enable_adjust, false)
  const effects = out.materials.effects as { id: string; type: string; value: number; path: string }[]
  assert.deepEqual(effects.map((effect) => [effect.id, effect.type, effect.value]), SLIDERS.map((slider, i) => [`NEW${i + 1}`, slider.name, slider.code * 0.02]))
  assert.equal(effects[0]!.path, "/effects/brightness")
  assert.deepEqual(opened.materials.effects, [])
  assert.deepEqual(mainPieces(opened)[1]!.extra_material_refs, ["S2", "C2"])
})

test("nothing is taken for the adjust when more than the piece changed, and nothing is written for such a block or a missing piece", () => {
  const moved = adjustedAsEffects()
  moved.tracks[1]!.segments[0]!.visible = false
  assert.deepEqual(findAdjust(draft(), moved).others, ["another track or piece changed too"])
```

```ts
/**
 * The colour spike's pure half (spec §8): what CapCut wrote when the user moved six basic adjust
 * sliders on the first piece of the main track, and the same block written onto another piece by
 * code. No file access, so adjust.test.mts runs it on made-up drafts before 0917 is touched.
 */

/** A place in a JSON value: object keys and array indexes, outermost first. */
export type Path = (string | number)[]
/** A value at a path; `value` absent means the path is gone. */
export interface Leaf {
  path: Path
  value?: unknown
}

export interface Segment {
  id: string
  material_id?: string
  extra_material_refs: string[]
  target_timerange: { start: number; duration: number }
  [key: string]: unknown
}
export interface Track {
  type: string
  flag?: number
  segments: Segment[]
  [key: string]: unknown
}
/** The parts of draft_info.json this spike reads; everything else rides along untouched. */
export interface Info {
  tracks: Track[]
  materials: Record<string, unknown>
  platform?: { app_version?: string }
  last_modified_platform?: { app_version?: string }
  [key: string]: unknown
}

/**
 * The six sliders: what the user sets by hand, and what the code writes — the opposite, so neither
 * can pass for the other. The sizes differ, so a stored number points at one slider only.
 */
export const SLIDERS = [
  { name: "brightness", label: "ความสว่าง (Brightness)", user: 23, code: -23 },
  { name: "contrast", label: "คอนทราสต์ (Contrast)", user: -17, code: 17 },
  { name: "saturation", label: "ความอิ่มตัวของสี (Saturation)", user: 31, code: -31 },
  { name: "temperature", label: "อุณหภูมิสี (Temperature)", user: -29, code: 29 },
  { name: "shadows", label: "เงา (Shadow)", user: 13, code: -13 },
  { name: "highlights", label: "ไฮไลต์ (Highlight)", user: -41, code: 41 },
] as const
export type SliderName = (typeof SLIDERS)[number]["name"]

/** The plain scales a stored number may have against its slider (0.46 for 23 is ×0.02). */
const RATIOS = [1, 0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02, 0.01, 0.005, 0.002, 0.001, 2, 5, 10, 100]

/** Where one slider's number was found. */
export interface SliderAt {
  /** in a material the adjust added, a material of the piece it changed, or on the segment itself */
  where: "added" | "changed" | "segment"
  /** index into AdjustFormat.added or .changed; -1 on the segment */
  index: number
  path: Path
  stored: number
  /** stored = slider × ratio */
  ratio: number
}

/** What the adjust is in the draft, as analyse.mts saves it to format.json. */
export interface AdjustFormat {
  appVersion: string
  /** materials the adjust added that the piece refers to, whole, and their place in its refs */
  added: { listKey: string; template: Record<string, unknown>; refIndex: number }[]
  /** materials the piece already had that the adjust changed, by their place in the piece's refs */
  changed: { listKey: string; refIndex: number; leaves: Leaf[] }[]
  /** the piece's own fields the adjust changed, extra_material_refs aside */
  segmentFields: Record<string, unknown>
  sliders: Record<SliderName, SliderAt | null>
  /** worth reading, not a reason to stop: a top-level field that changed, a slider not found */
  notes: string[]
  /** changes that make it more than one piece's own block; writing refuses while there are any */
  others: string[]
}

/** The pieces of the main track (the video track with flag 0), in playing order. */
export function mainPieces(info: Info): Segment[] {
  const main = info.tracks.find((track) => track.type === "video" && (track.flag ?? 0) === 0)
  if (!main) throw new Error("the draft has no main video track")
  return [...main.segments].sort((a, b) => a.target_timerange.start - b.target_timerange.start)
}

/** Every leaf of a JSON value; an empty array or object is a leaf of its own, so it can be written back. */
export function leaves(value: unknown, path: Path = []): Leaf[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length === 0 ? [{ path, value }] : value.flatMap((item, i) => leaves(item, [...path, i]))
  if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
    const entries = Object.entries(value)
    return entries.length === 0 ? [{ path, value }] : entries.flatMap(([key, item]) => leaves(item, [...path, key]))
  }
  return [{ path, value }]
}

const same = (a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b)
/** Four significant figures: CapCut may keep a float32, so 0.46 can come back as 0.4600000083. */
const round = (n: number): number => Number(n.toPrecision(4))

/** The leaves that differ from `before` to `after`: new or changed ones with their value, gone ones without. */
export function changedLeaves(before: unknown, after: unknown): Leaf[] {
  const was = new Map(leaves(before).map((leaf) => [JSON.stringify(leaf.path), leaf.value]))
  const now = new Map(leaves(after).map((leaf) => [JSON.stringify(leaf.path), leaf]))
  const out: Leaf[] = []
  for (const [key, leaf] of now) if (!was.has(key) || !same(was.get(key), leaf.value)) out.push(leaf)
  for (const key of was.keys()) if (!now.has(key)) out.push({ path: JSON.parse(key) as Path })
  return out
}

/** Every material that has a string id, with the list it sits in. */
function materialsById(info: Info): Map<string, { listKey: string; item: Record<string, unknown> }> {
  const found = new Map<string, { listKey: string; item: Record<string, unknown> }>()
  for (const [listKey, list] of Object.entries(info.materials)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue
    for (const item of list as Record<string, unknown>[]) {
      if (item !== null && typeof item === "object" && typeof item.id === "string") found.set(item.id, { listKey, item })
    }
  }
  return found
}

/**
 * What changed between the draft as CapCut opened it and as it saved it after the user moved the six
 * sliders on the first piece. Anything that is not the first piece's own block lands in `others`.
 */
export function findAdjust(opened: Info, adjusted: Info): AdjustFormat {
  const before = mainPieces(opened)[0]
  const after = mainPieces(adjusted)[0]
  if (!before || !after) throw new Error("the main track has no piece")
  if (before.id !== after.id) throw new Error(`the first piece changed id (${before.id} → ${after.id}): CapCut rebuilt the timeline, compare by hand`)
  const was = materialsById(opened)
  const now = materialsById(adjusted)
  const refs = after.extra_material_refs
  // ids a copied block must not carry to another piece: they belong to the first one
  const known = new Set([...was.keys(), after.id, ...(typeof after.material_id === "string" ? [after.material_id] : [])])
  const format: AdjustFormat = {
    appVersion: adjusted.last_modified_platform?.app_version ?? adjusted.platform?.app_version ?? "unknown",
    added: [],
    changed: [],
    segmentFields: {},
    sliders: {} as AdjustFormat["sliders"],
    notes: [],
    others: [],
  }

  for (const [id, { listKey, item }] of now) {
    const old = was.get(id)
    const refIndex = refs.indexOf(id)
    if (!old) {
      // a new material the piece does not refer to is not part of its block (a cover or cache CapCut
      // refreshes, or an adjust kept somewhere else): reported, never copied, and kept out of the slider search
      if (refIndex === -1) {
        format.others.push(`added materials.${listKey} ${id}, which the piece does not refer to`)
        continue
      }
      for (const leaf of leaves(item)) {
        if (typeof leaf.value === "string" && known.has(leaf.value)) format.others.push(`added materials.${listKey} ${id} names ${leaf.value}, which was there before`)
      }
      format.added.push({ listKey, template: item, refIndex })
    } else if (!same(old.item, item)) {
      if (refIndex === -1) format.others.push(`changed materials.${listKey} ${id}, which the piece does not refer to`)
      else format.changed.push({ listKey, refIndex, leaves: changedLeaves(old.item, item) })
    }
  }
  for (const [id, { listKey }] of was) if (!now.has(id)) format.others.push(`removed materials.${listKey} ${id}`)
  for (const id of before.extra_material_refs) if (!refs.includes(id)) format.others.push(`the piece stopped referring to ${id}`)
  for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)])) {
    if (key !== "extra_material_refs" && !same(before[key], after[key])) format.segmentFields[key] = after[key]
  }
  const rest = (info: Info) => JSON.stringify(info.tracks.map((track) => ({ ...track, segments: track.segments.filter((segment) => segment.id !== before.id) })))
  if (rest(opened) !== rest(adjusted)) format.others.push("another track or piece changed too")
  for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(opened), ...Object.keys(adjusted)])) {
    if (key !== "tracks" && key !== "materials" && !same(opened[key], adjusted[key])) format.notes.push(`top-level ${key} changed`)
  }

  // every non-zero number the adjust wrote, wherever it wrote it
  const numbers: { where: SliderAt["where"]; index: number; path: Path; value: number }[] = []
  const collect = (where: SliderAt["where"], index: number, found: Leaf[]) => {
    for (const leaf of found) if (typeof leaf.value === "number" && leaf.value !== 0) numbers.push({ where, index, path: leaf.path, value: leaf.value })
  }
  format.added.forEach((entry, index) => collect("added", index, leaves(entry.template)))
  format.changed.forEach((entry, index) => collect("changed", index, entry.leaves))
  collect("segment", -1, Object.entries(format.segmentFields).flatMap(([key, value]) => leaves(value, [key])))
  for (const slider of SLIDERS) {
    const hits = numbers.flatMap((number) => {
      const ratio = round(number.value / slider.user)
      return RATIOS.includes(ratio) ? [{ ...number, ratio }] : []
    })
    if (hits.length === 1) {
      const hit = hits[0]!
      format.sliders[slider.name] = { where: hit.where, index: hit.index, path: hit.path, stored: hit.value, ratio: hit.ratio }
    } else {
      format.sliders[slider.name] = null
      format.notes.push(
        hits.length === 0
          ? `${slider.name}: no stored number is a plain multiple of ${slider.user}`
          : `${slider.name}: ${hits.length} stored numbers fit ${slider.user} (${hits.map((hit) => `${hit.where}[${hit.index}].${hit.path.join(".")}=${hit.value}`).join(", ")})`,
      )
    }
  }
  return format
}

/** Sets (or, with no `value`, removes) the leaf at `path`, making the objects and arrays on the way. */
function setAt(holder: object, path: Path, leaf: { value?: unknown }): void {
  if (path.length === 0) throw new Error("an empty path names the whole value")
  let node = holder as Record<string | number, unknown>
  for (const [i, key] of path.slice(0, -1).entries()) {
    const next = node[key]
    if (next === null || typeof next !== "object") node[key] = typeof path[i + 1] === "number" ? [] : {}
    node = node[key] as Record<string | number, unknown>
  }
  const last = path[path.length - 1]!
  if ("value" in leaf) node[last] = structuredClone(leaf.value)
  else if (Array.isArray(node)) node.splice(Number(last), 1)
  else delete node[last]
}

/**
 * The draft with the adjust block written onto one piece (0 = the first in playing order): added
 * materials copied under new ids (every mention of an old id renamed), changed ones changed the same
 * way on this piece's own material, the segment fields copied, and each slider found set to
 * `values[slider] × ratio`. Refuses a block with `others`. Pure: `info` is left as it was.
 */
export function applyAdjust(info: Info, format: AdjustFormat, pieceIndex: number, values: Record<SliderName, number>, newId: () => string): Info {
  if (format.others.length > 0) throw new Error(`not a per-piece block, nothing written: ${format.others.join("; ")}`)
  const out = structuredClone(info)
  const piece = mainPieces(out)[pieceIndex]
  if (!piece) throw new Error(`the main track has no piece ${pieceIndex + 1}`)

  const ids = new Map(format.added.map((entry) => [String(entry.template.id), newId()]))
  const renamed = (value: unknown): unknown => {
    if (typeof value === "string") return ids.get(value) ?? value
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(renamed)
    if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, renamed(item)]))
    return value
  }
  const clones = format.added.map((entry) => renamed(entry.template) as Record<string, unknown>)

  const targets = format.changed.map((entry) => {
    const id = piece.extra_material_refs[entry.refIndex]
    const list = out.materials[entry.listKey]
    const target = Array.isArray(list) ? (list as Record<string, unknown>[]).find((material) => material?.id === id) : undefined
    if (!target) throw new Error(`piece ${pieceIndex + 1} has no materials.${entry.listKey} at ref ${entry.refIndex}`)
    // removals run last, highest index first, so an array's other indexes stay where they were
    const kept = entry.leaves.filter((leaf) => "value" in leaf)
    const gone = entry.leaves.filter((leaf) => !("value" in leaf)).reverse()
    for (const leaf of [...kept, ...gone]) setAt(target, leaf.path, leaf)
    return target
  })

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(format.segmentFields)) piece[key] = structuredClone(value)

  for (const slider of SLIDERS) {
    const at = format.sliders[slider.name]
    if (!at) continue
    const holder = at.where === "added" ? clones[at.index] : at.where === "changed" ? targets[at.index] : piece
    setAt(holder!, at.path, { value: values[slider.name] * at.ratio })
  }

  format.added.forEach((entry, i) => {
    const list = out.materials[entry.listKey]
    if (Array.isArray(list)) list.push(clones[i])
    else out.materials[entry.listKey] = [clones[i]]
  })
  const refs = [...piece.extra_material_refs]
  format.added
    .map((entry, i) => ({ at: entry.refIndex, id: String(clones[i]!.id) }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at)
    .forEach((ref) => refs.splice(Math.min(ref.at, refs.length), 0, ref.id))
  piece.extra_material_refs = refs
  return out
}

/**
 * What CapCut did to the written materials when it saved the draft again: each kept as written, changed
 * (which leaves) or gone, and whether the piece still refers to it. A number equal to four significant
 * figures counts as kept: CapCut may keep a float32, so -0.62 can come back as -0.6200000047683716.
 */
export function keptAfterResave(
  written: Info,
  reopened: Info,
  ids: string[],
  pieceIndex: number,
): { id: string; state: "kept" | "changed" | "gone"; changed: string[]; referenced: boolean }[] {
  const was = materialsById(written)
  const now = materialsById(reopened)
  const piece = mainPieces(reopened)[pieceIndex]
  return ids.map((id) => {
    const referenced = piece?.extra_material_refs.includes(id) ?? false
    const after = now.get(id)?.item
    if (!after) return { id, state: "gone", changed: [], referenced }
    const before = was.get(id)?.item ?? {}
    const old = new Map(leaves(before).map((leaf) => [JSON.stringify(leaf.path), leaf.value]))
    const changed = changedLeaves(before, after)
      .filter((leaf) => {
        const value = old.get(JSON.stringify(leaf.path))
        return !(typeof value === "number" && typeof leaf.value === "number" && round(value) === round(leaf.value))
      })
      .map((leaf) => leaf.path.join("."))
    return { id, state: changed.length === 0 ? "kept" : "changed", changed, referenced }
  })
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Reads what CapCut saved (spec §8 step 3) and prints it plainly.
 *   node analyse.mts <opened.json> <adjusted.json> <format.json>    finds the adjust block, saves it to format.json
 *   node analyse.mts --kept <written.json> <reopened.json> <written-ids.json>
 *                                                                    what CapCut did to the block written by code
 */
import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { findAdjust, keptAfterResave, mainPieces, SLIDERS, type Info } from "./adjust.mts"

const read = async (path: string) => JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")) as Info
const args = process.argv.slice(2)

if (args[0] === "--kept") {
  const [, writtenPath, reopenedPath, idsPath] = args
  if (!writtenPath || !reopenedPath || !idsPath) throw new Error("usage: node analyse.mts --kept <written.json> <reopened.json> <written-ids.json>")
  const record = JSON.parse(await readFile(idsPath, "utf8")) as { piece: number; ids: string[]; changedIds: string[] }
  const reopened = await read(reopenedPath)
  for (const result of keptAfterResave(await read(writtenPath), reopened, [...record.ids, ...record.changedIds], record.piece - 1)) {
    console.log(`${result.id} ${result.state}${result.changed.length > 0 ? `: ${result.changed.join(", ")}` : ""} · ${result.referenced ? "the piece still refers to it" : "THE PIECE NO LONGER REFERS TO IT"}`)
  }
  console.log(`piece ${record.piece} enable_adjust after the save: ${JSON.stringify(mainPieces(reopened)[record.piece - 1]?.enable_adjust)}`)
} else {
  const [openedPath, adjustedPath, outPath] = args
  if (!openedPath || !adjustedPath || !outPath) throw new Error("usage: node analyse.mts <opened.json> <adjusted.json> <format.json>")
  const opened = await read(openedPath)
  const adjusted = await read(adjustedPath)
  const format = findAdjust(opened, adjusted)
  await writeFile(outPath, JSON.stringify(format, null, 2))
  console.log(`CapCut ${format.appVersion}`)
  console.log(`first piece enable_adjust: ${JSON.stringify(mainPieces(opened)[0]?.enable_adjust)} → ${JSON.stringify(mainPieces(adjusted)[0]?.enable_adjust)}`)
  for (const entry of format.added) {
    const t = entry.template
    const named = ["type", "name", "resource_id", "effect_id", "path"].filter((key) => key in t).map((key) => `${key}=${JSON.stringify(t[key])}`)
    console.log(`added   materials.${entry.listKey} ${String(t.id)} · ref #${entry.refIndex} · ${named.join(" ")}`)
  }
  for (const entry of format.changed) console.log(`changed materials.${entry.listKey} at ref #${entry.refIndex} · ${entry.leaves.map((leaf) => leaf.path.join(".")).join(", ")}`)
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(format.segmentFields)) console.log(`segment ${key} = ${JSON.stringify(value)}`)
  for (const slider of SLIDERS) {
    const at = format.sliders[slider.name]
    console.log(at ? `${slider.name.padEnd(12)} ${slider.user} → ${at.stored} (×${at.ratio}) at ${at.where}[${at.index}].${at.path.join(".")}` : `${slider.name.padEnd(12)} ${slider.user} → NOT FOUND`)
  }
  for (const note of format.notes) console.log(`note: ${note}`)
  for (const other of format.others) console.log(`OTHER: ${other}`)
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Writes the adjust block analyse.mts found onto one piece of draft 0917 by code (spec §8 step 4),
 * with the code's slider values (the opposite of the user's). It goes through core's writeDraft, so
 * all six timeline copies change together and nothing is written while CapCut runs.
 * The block's ref places were read from CapCut's own saves (opened.json, beside format.json). When the
 * restored draft lays the target piece's materials out differently (CapCut added or reordered some as
 * it opened the draft, or moved it to a newer version), those places would land on the wrong material,
 * so the block goes onto opened.json's state instead: the spike still asks whether CapCut takes the block.
 *   node write-adjust.mts <format.json> <piece number from 1> [--allow-others]
 * --allow-others writes although analyse.mts listed OTHER changes; use it only for the case Step 10 names.
 * A material the piece does not refer to is never in the block (findAdjust leaves it out), so it is not copied.
 */
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto"
import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { homedir } from "node:os"
import { dirname, join } from "node:path"
import { loadDraft } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/capcut/read.ts"
import { writeDraft } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/capcut/write.ts"
import { applyAdjust, mainPieces, SLIDERS, type AdjustFormat, type Info, type SliderName } from "./adjust.mts"

// the one draft this task may write
const FOLDER = join(homedir(), "Movies/CapCut/User Data/Projects/com.lveditor.draft/0917")
const [formatPath, pieceArg, flag] = process.argv.slice(2)
const piece = Number(pieceArg)
if (!formatPath || !Number.isInteger(piece) || piece < 1 || (flag !== undefined && flag !== "--allow-others")) {
  throw new Error("usage: node write-adjust.mts <format.json> <piece number from 1> [--allow-others]")
}
const format = JSON.parse(await readFile(formatPath, "utf8")) as AdjustFormat
if (flag === "--allow-others" && format.others.length > 0) {
  console.log(`writing although these changed too (judged unrelated): ${format.others.join("; ")}`)
  format.others = []
}
const draft = await loadDraft(FOLDER)
const restored = draft.info as unknown as Info
const opened = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(dirname(formatPath), "opened.json"), "utf8")) as Info
/** The list each of the target piece's materials sits in, in ref order: what the block's ref places count on. */
const layout = (info: Info): string => {
  const listOf = new Map(Object.entries(info.materials).flatMap(([key, list]) => (Array.isArray(list) ? list.map((material: { id?: unknown }) => [material?.id, key] as const) : [])))
  return JSON.stringify(mainPieces(info)[piece - 1]?.extra_material_refs.map((id) => listOf.get(id) ?? "?") ?? null)
}
const onOpened = layout(restored) !== layout(opened)
if (onOpened) console.log(`piece ${piece}'s materials differ from CapCut's opened save (${layout(restored)} → ${layout(opened)}): writing onto opened.json's state`)
const base = onOpened ? opened : restored
const before = new Set(Object.values(base.materials).flatMap((list) => (Array.isArray(list) ? list.map((material: { id?: unknown }) => material?.id) : [])))
const values = Object.fromEntries(SLIDERS.map((slider) => [slider.name, slider.code])) as Record<SliderName, number>
const info = applyAdjust(base, format, piece - 1, values, () => randomUUID().toUpperCase())
await writeDraft(draft, info as never)

const target = mainPieces(info)[piece - 1]!
const ids = target.extra_material_refs.filter((id) => !before.has(id))
const changedIds = format.changed.map((entry) => target.extra_material_refs[entry.refIndex]!)
await writeFile(join(dirname(formatPath), "written-ids.json"), JSON.stringify({ piece, segment: target.id, base: onOpened ? "opened" : "restored", ids, changedIds }, null, 2))
console.log(`piece ${piece} (${target.id}) on the ${onOpened ? "opened" : "restored"} state: ${ids.length} new materials ${ids.join(", ")}; ${changedIds.length} changed ${changedIds.join(", ")}`)
for (const slider of SLIDERS) {
  const at = format.sliders[slider.name]
  console.log(`${slider.name.padEnd(12)} ${slider.code}${at ? ` → ${slider.code * at.ratio} at ${at.where}[${at.index}].${at.path.join(".")}` : " → not written (not found in the user's save)"}`)
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Backs up, restores and compares draft 0917 for the M25 tests. 0917 is the only draft these tests
 * may write, so its folder is fixed here and no other draft can be named by mistake.
 *   node draft-backup.mts backup <label>    copies 0917 and its root_meta entry to m25/backups/<label>/
 *   node draft-backup.mts restore <label>   puts that copy back (refused while CapCut runs); what it replaces goes to ~/.Trash
 *   node draft-backup.mts check <label>     says whether 0917 and its root_meta entry are the copy again
 */
import { execFile } from "node:child_process"
import { readdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { homedir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
import { promisify } from "node:util"
import { loadDraft } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/capcut/read.ts"
import { backupDraft, restoreDraft } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/capcut/write.ts"

const FOLDER = join(homedir(), "Movies/CapCut/User Data/Projects/com.lveditor.draft/0917")
const ROOT = "/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ford-Desktop-Thalent-Ai-excp-prodeck2/f297d1d6-b448-49ed-8563-d0f74dd57a87/scratchpad/m25/backups"
const [command, label] = process.argv.slice(2)
if (!command || !["backup", "restore", "check"].includes(command) || !label || !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(label)) {
  throw new Error("usage: node draft-backup.mts backup|restore|check <label>")
}
const labelDir = join(ROOT, label)
const latest = async () => (await readFile(join(labelDir, "LATEST"), "utf8")).trim()

if (command === "backup") {
  const dir = await backupDraft(await loadDraft(FOLDER), labelDir)
  await writeFile(join(labelDir, "LATEST"), dir)
  console.log(dir)
} else if (command === "restore") {
  const dir = await latest()
  await restoreDraft(dir)
  // restoreDraft keeps what it replaced as replaced-<time> in the backup; it goes to the Trash, never deleted
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(":", "-")
  for (const name of (await readdir(dir)).filter((entry) => entry.startsWith("replaced-"))) {
    const to = join(homedir(), ".Trash", `0917-m25-${label}-${name}-${stamp}`)
    await rename(join(dir, name), to)
    console.log(`the draft that was there is in ${to}`)
  }
  console.log(`0917 restored from ${dir}`)
} else {
  const dir = await latest()
  try {
    await promisify(execFile)("diff", ["-r", join(dir, "draft"), FOLDER])
    console.log("folder: identical")
  } catch (error) {
    console.log("folder: DIFFERENT")
    console.log((error as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? String(error))
    process.exitCode = 1
  }
  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(dir, "manifest.json"), "utf8")) as { root: string; folder: string; rootEntry: unknown }
  if (manifest.rootEntry === null) {
    console.log("root_meta entry: none was found at backup time (not compared)")
  } else {
    const rootMeta = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(manifest.root, "root_meta_info.json"), "utf8")) as { all_draft_store: { draft_fold_path: string }[] }
    const entry = rootMeta.all_draft_store.find((item) => item.draft_fold_path === manifest.folder) ?? null
    const same = JSON.stringify(entry) === JSON.stringify(manifest.rootEntry)
    console.log(`root_meta entry: ${same ? "identical" : "DIFFERENT"}`)
    if (!same) process.exitCode = 1
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * What a draft holds, read only: whether the six timeline copies agree, each track with its pieces,
 * render index range and overlaps inside it, and the most overlay pieces playing at one moment. Used
 * by the colour spike and the live test.
 *   node draft-summary.mts [draft folder]     (default: 0917)
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto"
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { homedir } from "node:os"
import { join } from "node:path"
import { loadDraft } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/capcut/read.ts"
import { timelineCopies } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/capcut/write.ts"

const folder = process.argv[2] ?? join(homedir(), "Movies/CapCut/User Data/Projects/com.lveditor.draft/0917")
const draft = await loadDraft(folder)
console.log(`${draft.name} · CapCut ${draft.capcutVersion} · ${(draft.info.duration / 1e6).toFixed(2)} s`)
const shas = await Promise.all(
  timelineCopies(draft).map(async (path: string) => {
    try {
      return createHash("sha256").update(await readFile(path)).digest("hex").slice(0, 12)
    } catch {
      return "missing"
    }
  }),
)
console.log(`timeline copies: ${shas.join(" ")} → ${new Set(shas.filter((sha) => sha !== "missing")).size === 1 ? "identical" : "DIFFER"}`)
draft.info.tracks.forEach((track: { type: string; flag?: number; segments: { render_index?: unknown; target_timerange: { start: number; duration: number } }[] }, i: number) => {
  const pieces = [...track.segments].sort((a, b) => a.target_timerange.start - b.target_timerange.start)
  const indexes = pieces.map((piece) => piece.render_index).filter((n): n is number => typeof n === "number")
  let overlaps = 0
  for (let k = 1; k < pieces.length; k++) {
    const previous = pieces[k - 1]!.target_timerange
    if (pieces[k]!.target_timerange.start < previous.start + previous.duration) overlaps++
  }
  // an overlay track (flag 2): cutaways have render index 8 + lane, graphics 1000 + lane
  const kind = track.type === "video" && track.flag === 2 ? (indexes.length > 0 && Math.min(...indexes) >= 1000 ? "graphics lane" : "cutaway lane") : track.type === "video" ? "main video" : track.type
  const range = indexes.length > 0 ? `${Math.min(...indexes)}–${Math.max(...indexes)}` : "-"
  console.log(`#${i} ${kind.padEnd(13)} flag ${track.flag ?? "-"} · ${pieces.length} pieces · render_index ${range} · overlaps inside ${overlaps}`)
})
type Piece = { target_timerange: { start: number; duration: number } }
/** The most pieces of these tracks playing at one moment, and when; an end sorts before a start at the same time, so pieces that only touch never count together. */
const peak = (tracks: { segments: Piece[] }[]): string => {
  const edges = tracks.flatMap((track) => track.segments.flatMap((piece): [number, number][] => [[piece.target_timerange.start, 1], [piece.target_timerange.start + piece.target_timerange.duration, -1]]))
  edges.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1])
  let playing = 0
  let most = 0
  let at = 0
  for (const [time, step] of edges) {
    playing += step
    if (playing > most) [most, at] = [playing, time]
  }
  return `${most}${most > 0 ? ` at ${(at / 1e6).toFixed(2)} s` : ""}`
}
const tracks = draft.info.tracks as { type: string; flag?: number; segments: Piece[] }[]
// how busy the screen gets (spec §11): cutaways and graphics, and text pieces (subtitles among them)
console.log(`most at once: cutaways and graphics ${peak(tracks.filter((track) => track.type === "video" && track.flag === 2))} · text pieces ${peak(tracks.filter((track) => track.type === "text"))} (subtitles included)`)
const lists = Object.entries(draft.info.materials)
  .filter(([, list]) => Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0)
  .map(([key, list]) => `${key} ${(list as unknown[]).length}`)
console.log(`materials: ${lists.join(" · ")}`)
```

### Part B — the one-time cleanup on copies of old outlines (spec §9 "ลองโปรเจคเก่า"), after Task 8

Task 4 built the cleanup with its own tests, the case the real 0917 outline holds among them: `c07960c5….json` has three Claude groups, all `source:"ai", edited:false`, and an edited cutaway anchored `{kind:"highlight", groupId:"8dbf6480…", line:0}` on one of them, which Task 4 Step 10 moves to the start of that group's beat (`offGoneLines`; spec §7 keeps what the user edited, edited line sounds included since the user's decision of 2026-09-28, and lets a group take only its own look and the line sounds nobody edited). This part runs the cleanup on copies of every real outline before Part C builds the dev app, so a case the tests lack is found, and fixed test first, while nothing else runs.

- [ ] **Step 17: run the cleanup on copies** — create `<scratchpad>/m25/cleanup/try-cleanup.mts`:

```ts
/**
 * The one-time cleanup (spec §7) tried on copies of the real outlines — never the real ones (spec §9).
 * Every file in the folder is read through ProjectFiles with the upgrade, as the app reads it the
 * first time, and then checked. Prints one block per outline; exits 1 when any check fails, and also
 * when a copy already has postVersion: that is a folder cleaned by an earlier run, which would prove nothing.
 *   node try-cleanup.mts <folder of outline copies>
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto"
import { readdir, readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { join } from "node:path"
import { POST_VERSION, withoutOldEffects } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/apps/desktop/src/main/post-cleanup.ts"
import { ProjectFiles } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/apps/desktop/src/main/project-files.ts"

type Item = { edited: boolean; pointId?: string; anchor?: { kind: string; groupId?: string; line?: number; beatId?: string } }
type Group = { id: string; source: "ai" | "user"; edited: boolean; pointId?: string; beatId?: string; lines?: { videoId: string }[] }
type Outline = {
  folder: string
  postVersion?: number
  outline?: { beats: { id: string; videoId: string }[] }
  highlights?: { groups: Group[]; [key: string]: unknown }
  flair?: { looks: Record<string, unknown>; cues?: Item[]; zooms?: Item[]; inserts?: Item[]; graphics?: Item[] }
  [key: string]: unknown
}

const dir = process.argv[2]
if (!dir) throw new Error("usage: node try-cleanup.mts <folder of outline copies>")
const KINDS = ["cues", "zooms", "inserts", "graphics"] as const
const sha = async (path: string) => createHash("sha256").update(await readFile(path)).digest("hex")
/** An item as the checks compare it: never its pointId (the cleanup takes it off), and its anchor only when `anchor` is true. */
const shape = (item: Item, anchor: boolean) => {
  const { pointId: _pointId, anchor: where, ...rest } = item
  return JSON.stringify(anchor ? { ...rest, anchor: where } : rest)
}
/** Everything but what the cleanup may change. */
const untouched = (outline: Outline) => JSON.stringify({ ...outline, highlights: { ...outline.highlights, groups: undefined }, flair: undefined, postVersion: undefined })
let failed = 0

for (const name of (await readdir(dir)).filter((entry) => entry.endsWith(".json")).sort()) {
  const path = join(dir, name)
  const before = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")) as Outline
  const groupsBefore = before.highlights?.groups ?? []
  const keptGroups = groupsBefore.filter((group) => group.source === "user" || group.edited).map((group) => group.id)

  const store = new ProjectFiles<Outline>(dir, { upgrade: withoutOldEffects })
  const got = await store.get(before.folder)
  // queued behind the write-back the read started, so the file on disk is the cleaned one after it
  await store.update(before.folder, (current) => current!)
  const after = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")) as Outline
  const groups = after.highlights?.groups ?? []
  const ids = new Set(groups.map((group) => group.id))
  /**
   * An item of the old outline that sat on a line of a group the cleanup removed: a sound, cutaway or
   * graphic the user edited stays, moved off the group to the start of its beat (spec §7, sounds too
   * since the user's decision of 2026-09-28); one nobody edited goes with the group.
   */
  const movedOff = (item: Item) => item.anchor?.kind === "highlight" && !ids.has(item.anchor.groupId!)
  const beats = before.outline?.beats ?? []
  /**
   * The beat such an item moves to, as offGoneLines' beatOf finds it (Task 4 Step 13): the group's own
   * while the outline has it, else the first beat that plays the line's video. With none (a group never
   * stored, a video no beat plays) offGoneLines leaves the item and regroupFlair drops it, by design
   * (Task 4 Step 8, `edited-on-nothing`): such an item is counted apart, not expected to stay.
   */
  const beatFor = (item: Item): string | undefined => {
    const group = groupsBefore.find((one) => one.id === item.anchor!.groupId)
    if (!group) return undefined
    if (group.beatId !== undefined && beats.some((beat) => beat.id === group.beatId)) return group.beatId
    const videoId = group.lines?.[item.anchor!.line!]?.videoId
    return beats.find((beat) => beat.videoId === videoId)?.id
  }
  const noBeat = (item: Item) => item.edited && movedOff(item) && beatFor(item) === undefined

  const checks: [string, boolean][] = [
    ["the copy had no postVersion (a fresh copy of an old outline)", before.postVersion === undefined],
    [`postVersion is ${POST_VERSION}`, after.postVersion === POST_VERSION],
    ["the store handed back what it wrote", JSON.stringify(got) === JSON.stringify(after)],
    ["no unedited Claude group left", groups.every((group) => group.source === "user" || group.edited)],
    ["the user's and edited groups all stayed", JSON.stringify([...ids].sort()) === JSON.stringify([...keptGroups].sort())],
    ["every look belongs to a group still there", Object.keys(after.flair?.looks ?? {}).every((id) => ids.has(id))],
    [
      "every sound, cutaway and graphic on a line sits on a group still there",
      KINDS.flatMap((kind) => after.flair?.[kind] ?? []).every((item) => item.anchor?.kind !== "highlight" || ids.has(item.anchor.groupId!)),
    ],
    ["nothing else changed", untouched(before) === untouched(after)],
  ]
  const counts: string[] = []
  let moved = 0
  let dropped = 0
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const was = before.flair?.[kind] ?? []
    const now = after.flair?.[kind] ?? []
    moved += was.filter((item) => item.edited && movedOff(item) && !noBeat(item)).length
    dropped += was.filter(noBeat).length
    // every edited item stays, sounds on a removed group's lines too, but for one with no beat to move to
    const expected = was.filter((item) => item.edited && !noBeat(item))
    // in order and unchanged; one moved off a removed group is compared without its anchor, which must now be the start of beatFor's beat
    const same =
      now.length === expected.length &&
      expected.every(
        (item, index) =>
          shape(item, !movedOff(item)) === shape(now[index]!, !movedOff(item)) &&
          (!movedOff(item) || (now[index]!.anchor?.kind === "beat" && now[index]!.anchor?.beatId === beatFor(item))),
      )
    checks.push([`no unedited ${kind} left`, now.every((item) => item.edited)])
    checks.push([`every edited ${kind} stayed as it was`, same])
    counts.push(`${kind} ${was.length}→${now.length}`)
  }
  checks.push(["nothing carries a pointId", [...groups, ...KINDS.flatMap((kind) => after.flair?.[kind] ?? [])].every((item) => item.pointId === undefined)])
  checks.push(["cleaning again hands back the same object", withoutOldEffects(after as never) === (after as never)])
  const shaBefore = await sha(path)
  await new ProjectFiles<Outline>(dir, { upgrade: withoutOldEffects }).get(before.folder)
  checks.push(["reading again leaves the file as it is", (await sha(path)) === shaBefore])

  failed += checks.filter(([, ok]) => !ok).length
  console.log(`${before.folder.split("/").at(-1)} (${name.slice(0, 8)}) · postVersion ${before.postVersion ?? "none"} → ${after.postVersion}`)
  console.log(
    `  groups ${groupsBefore.length}→${groups.length} (kept ${keptGroups.length}) · looks ${Object.keys(before.flair?.looks ?? {}).length}→${Object.keys(after.flair?.looks ?? {}).length}` +
      ` · ${counts.join(" · ")} · edited sounds, cutaways and graphics moved off a removed group ${moved}` +
      ` · edited items with no beat to move to (dropped by design) ${dropped}`,
  )
  for (const [label, ok] of checks) console.log(`  ${ok ? "ok  " : "FAIL"} ${label}`)
}
process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0)
```

- [ ] **Step 21: implement** — create `<scratchpad>/m25/live/summary.mts`:

```ts
/**
 * What an outline holds, for the M25 live test (spec §9): the emphasis points, and every item by
 * kind — bound to a point or not — with how many each level lets through. An item on no point always
 * shows; one on a point shows when that point's importance passes the level; one on a point that is
 * gone never does (contract decision 3). The app's read rules (hidden points, minimum lengths, lost
 * zooms) can only make it show fewer than these counts.
 *   node summary.mts <outline.json>
 */
import { LEVEL_IMPORTANCE } from "file:///Users/ford/Desktop/Thalent%20Ai/excp/prodeck2/packages/core/src/emphasis/types.ts"

type Level = "light" | "medium" | "heavy"
type Importance = "key" | "secondary" | "extra"
const LEVELS: Level[] = ["light", "medium", "heavy"]

interface PointLike {
  id: string
  importance: Importance
  type: string
  source: "ai" | "user"
  edited: boolean
  reason: string
  anchor: { kind: string; videoId: string; beatId: string; from?: number; to?: number; startUs?: number; endUs?: number }
}
interface Bound {
  edited: boolean
  pointId?: string
}
/** The parts of a StoredOutline this reads; loose on purpose so an outline from any version reads. */
export interface OutlineLike {
  postVersion?: number
  subtitleTexts?: Record<string, string>
  emphasis?: { points: PointLike[]; version: number; plannedOn: { graphics: number | null; sounds: number | null } }
  highlights?: { groups: (Bound & { source: string })[] }
  flair?: { cues?: Bound[]; zooms?: Bound[]; inserts?: Bound[]; graphics?: Bound[] }
}
export interface Counts {
  total: number
  bound: number
  edited: number
  /** on a point the outline no longer has */
  dangling: number
  byLevel: Record<Level, number>
}

function count(items: Bound[], points: Map<string, PointLike>): Counts {
  const passes = (item: Bound, level: Level) => {
    if (item.pointId === undefined) return true
    const point = points.get(item.pointId)
    return point !== undefined && LEVEL_IMPORTANCE[level].includes(point.importance)
  }
  return {
    total: items.length,
    bound: items.filter((item) => item.pointId !== undefined).length,
    edited: items.filter((item) => item.edited).length,
    dangling: items.filter((item) => item.pointId !== undefined && !points.has(item.pointId)).length,
    byLevel: Object.fromEntries(LEVELS.map((level) => [level, items.filter((item) => passes(item, level)).length])) as Record<Level, number>,
  }
}

export function summarise(outline: OutlineLike) {
  const list = outline.emphasis?.points ?? []
  const points = new Map(list.map((point) => [point.id, point]))
  const version = outline.emphasis?.version ?? 0
  const plannedOn = outline.emphasis?.plannedOn ?? { graphics: null, sounds: null }
  const tally = <K extends string>(keys: readonly K[], of: (point: PointLike) => K) =>
    Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, list.filter((point) => of(point) === key).length])) as Record<K, number>
  return {
    postVersion: outline.postVersion ?? null,
    subtitleTexts: Object.keys(outline.subtitleTexts ?? {}).length,
    points: {
      total: list.length,
      byImportance: tally(["key", "secondary", "extra"] as const, (point) => point.importance),
      bySource: tally(["ai", "user"] as const, (point) => point.source),
      edited: list.filter((point) => point.edited).length,
      /** the first point in stored order: right after a plan run, the first one played */
      firstType: list[0]?.type ?? null,
      version,
      plannedOn,
      /** planned before, on an older version of the points: the "จุดเน้นเปลี่ยน" banner shows */
      stale: { graphics: plannedOn.graphics !== null && plannedOn.graphics !== version, sounds: plannedOn.sounds !== null && plannedOn.sounds !== version },
    },
    text: count(outline.highlights?.groups ?? [], points),
    sounds: count(outline.flair?.cues ?? [], points),
    zooms: count(outline.flair?.zooms ?? [], points),
    inserts: count(outline.flair?.inserts ?? [], points),
    graphics: count(outline.flair?.graphics ?? [], points),
  }
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises")
  const path = process.argv[2]
  if (!path) throw new Error("usage: node summary.mts <outline.json>")
  const outline = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8")) as OutlineLike
  const s = summarise(outline)
  const p = s.points
  console.log(`postVersion ${s.postVersion ?? "none"} · subtitle texts ${s.subtitleTexts}`)
  console.log(
    `points ${p.total} (key ${p.byImportance.key} · secondary ${p.byImportance.secondary} · extra ${p.byImportance.extra}; ai ${p.bySource.ai} · user ${p.bySource.user}; edited ${p.edited})` +
      ` first ${p.firstType ?? "-"} · version ${p.version} · planned on graphics ${p.plannedOn.graphics ?? "-"} sounds ${p.plannedOn.sounds ?? "-"}` +
      `${p.stale.graphics || p.stale.sounds ? ` → banner (graphics ${p.stale.graphics}, sounds ${p.stale.sounds})` : ""}`,
  )
  for (const kind of ["text", "sounds", "zooms", "inserts", "graphics"] as const) {
    const c = s[kind]
    console.log(`${kind.padEnd(9)} ${c.total} (bound ${c.bound} · edited ${c.edited} · dangling ${c.dangling}) · light ${c.byLevel.light} · medium ${c.byLevel.medium} · heavy ${c.byLevel.heavy}`)
  }
  const items: Bound[] = [
    ...(outline.highlights?.groups ?? []),
    ...(outline.flair?.cues ?? []),
    ...(outline.flair?.zooms ?? []),
    ...(outline.flair?.inserts ?? []),
    ...(outline.flair?.graphics ?? []),
  ]
  for (const point of outline.emphasis?.points ?? []) {
    const a = point.anchor
    const where = a.kind === "speech" ? `words ${a.from}–${a.to}` : `${((a.startUs ?? 0) / 1e6).toFixed(2)}–${((a.endUs ?? 0) / 1e6).toFixed(2)} s`
    const on = items.filter((item) => item.pointId === point.id).length
    console.log(`  ${point.id.slice(0, 8)} ${point.importance.padEnd(9)} ${point.type.padEnd(7)} ${point.source}${point.edited ? " edited" : ""} · ${a.kind} ${where} · beat ${a.beatId.slice(0, 8)} · items ${on} · ${point.reason.slice(0, 60)}`)
  }
}
```

  Then the narrow window (spec §3.1: the four chips fit at 900 px; the top bar now also carries "ไปเขียนลง CapCut ›", the new AI menu and the backup menu). Create `<scratchpad>/m25/live/narrow.mts`:

```ts
/**
 * Lays the test app's page out as if its window were this wide, through the app's remote debugging
 * port (9333), without resizing the window: saves a picture of it and prints whatever reaches past the
 * right edge. The width goes back to the window's own when this script ends. Changes nothing stored.
 *   node narrow.mts <width> <picture.png>
 */
import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"

const [widthArg, out] = process.argv.slice(2)
const width = Number(widthArg)
if (!Number.isInteger(width) || width < 400 || !out) throw new Error("usage: node narrow.mts <width> <picture.png>")
const pages = (await (await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9333/json/list")).json()) as { type: string; url: string; webSocketDebuggerUrl: string }[]
const page = pages.find((entry) => entry.type === "page" && !entry.url.startsWith("devtools:"))
if (!page) throw new Error("no page on port 9333: is the test app running?")
const socket = new WebSocket(page.webSocketDebuggerUrl)
await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  socket.onopen = resolve
  socket.onerror = reject
})
let next = 0
const waiting = new Map<number, { resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: Error) => void }>()
socket.onmessage = (event) => {
  const message = JSON.parse(String(event.data)) as { id?: number; result?: unknown; error?: { message: string } }
  const call = message.id === undefined ? undefined : waiting.get(message.id)
  if (!call) return
  waiting.delete(message.id!)
  if (message.error) call.reject(new Error(message.error.message))
  else call.resolve(message.result)
}
const send = <T>(method: string, params: object = {}) =>
  new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const id = ++next
    waiting.set(id, { resolve: resolve as (value: unknown) => void, reject })
    socket.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }))
  })
const evaluate = async <T>(expression: string) => (await send<{ result: { value: T } }>("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, returnByValue: true })).result.value

const height = await evaluate<number>("window.innerHeight")
await send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width, height, deviceScaleFactor: 0, mobile: false })
// one second for the layout and the 1060 px rule to settle
await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000))
const spill = await evaluate<{ page: number; wide: string[] }>(`(() => {
  const wide = [...document.querySelectorAll("body *")]
    .filter((el) => { const box = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return box.width > 0 && box.right > innerWidth + 1 })
    .slice(0, 10)
    .map((el) => el.tagName.toLowerCase() + " " + (el.textContent ?? "").trim().slice(0, 30))
  return { page: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, wide }
})()`)
const shot = await send<{ data: string }>("Page.captureScreenshot", { format: "png" })
await writeFile(out, Buffer.from(shot.data, "base64"))
await send("Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride")
socket.close()
console.log(`width ${width} · page scroll width ${spill.page} · past the right edge: ${spill.wide.length === 0 ? "nothing" : spill.wide.join(" | ")}`)
```

**Decided 2026-09-28** (the user's answers to the six open questions; spec §5.1, §7 and §11 were updated the same day):
1. **Where an edited item on removed text goes: the beat start.** An edited sound, cutaway or graphic on a line of Claude's text that goes (its point deleted or planned over, with its beat, or in the one-time cleanup) moves to `{ kind: "beat", beatId, edge: "start" }` of that text's beat through `offGoneLines`, not to the line's first word; the outline keeps no word times (Task 4 Step 13, contract D7). Accepted as proposed.
2. **The one-time cleanup keeps edited line sounds too.** A removed Claude group takes only its look and the line sounds nobody edited; an edited line sound moves to the start of the group's beat like an edited cutaway or graphic (spec §7 reworded). Task 4 Step 10 passes the cues through `offGoneLines`, Step 8's last test pins it, `t4-cleanup.json` carries the mutation; Task 9 Part B's script and Steps 25 and 42 expect it.
3. **Points of an earlier transcript are hidden, then deleted** by the next plan or by a point added or moved on that video (Task 4, contract D9). Accepted as proposed.
4. **Stored subtitle texts are capped at 5,000 by forgetting the oldest**, never by refusing a new one (Task 4, contract D4). Accepted as proposed.
5. **จัดเต็ม too busy → fewer `extra` points in the emphasis prompt**, never a placement rule or a cap on items at once (spec §11). Task 9 Step 31 records the decision and, when the user finds it too busy, Step 32a changes the prompt test first (`EMPHASIS_PROMPT_VERSION` `emphasis-2026-09-27-fewer-extra`), runs `t1-emphasis.json` and plans 0917 again on the test profile.
6. **Thinking again on the text keeps what the user edited.** An edited sound, cutaway or graphic on Claude's replaced text follows the new text with the same words, as today; when none takes it, it moves to the start of its beat through the same `offGoneLines` instead of going (spec §5.1). Task 5 gives `regroupFlair` an `orElse` parameter (Steps 11–12) and `highlights.pick` passes `offGoneLines` (Steps 14–15), with entries in `t5-text-state.json` and `t5-text-highlights.json`; Task 9 Step 28 item 5 expects the move.

- **D5 (T4; decision 10) Only a real change makes a point edited:** the API refuses a patch naming no field; the service leaves a point, its `edited` and the version alone when every field named equals what it has (the reason compared trimmed, the anchor field by field).

### 1. New symbols

#### 1.1 `packages/core/src/emphasis/types.ts` (T1) — no runtime imports except type-only, so the renderer may import it

```ts
import type { FlairLevel } from "../flair/catalogue.ts"

/** How much a point matters: key must be remembered, secondary helps understanding, extra is for a loud clip. Thai: สำคัญ · รอง · เสริม. */
export const IMPORTANCE = ["key", "secondary", "extra"] as const
export type Importance = (typeof IMPORTANCE)[number]

/** What kind of thing a point is: the opening hook, a number or price, a product, an action, a feeling, a place, a good-looking picture. */
export const EMPHASIS_TYPES = ["hook", "number", "product", "action", "emotion", "place", "visual"] as const
export type EmphasisType = (typeof EMPHASIS_TYPES)[number]

/** Where a point is: words [from, to) of a video's transcript said in a beat, or a stretch of a picture beat's file. */
export type EmphasisAnchor =
  | { kind: "speech"; videoId: string; from: number; to: number; beatId: string }
  | { kind: "scene"; videoId: string; startUs: number; endUs: number; beatId: string }

/** One thing the clip should stress; works 2 and 4 put their items on it. */
export interface EmphasisPoint {
  id: string
  anchor: EmphasisAnchor
  importance: Importance
  type: EmphasisType
  /** Claude's one line on why, or the user's */
  reason: string
  source: "ai" | "user"
  /** the user changed its importance, type, reason or phrase: thinking again leaves it alone */
  edited: boolean
}

/** The points of one outline, stored as `StoredOutline.emphasis`. */
export interface StoredEmphasis {
  points: EmphasisPoint[]
  /** goes up by one whenever the points change in a way works 2 and 4 should hear about */
  version: number
  /** the version works 2 and 4 last planned on; one that differs from `version` shows the "จุดเน้นเปลี่ยน" banner */
  plannedOn: { graphics: number | null; sounds: number | null }
  /** per video, the transcript fingerprint the speech points' word numbers belong to */
  transcripts: Record<string, string>
}

/** What the user may change on a point; a field left out stays. */
export interface EmphasisPatch {
  importance?: Importance
  type?: EmphasisType
  reason?: string
  /** a new phrase (or scene stretch) for the point */
  anchor?: EmphasisAnchor
}

/** An outline with no points yet. */
export const EMPTY_EMPHASIS: StoredEmphasis = { points: [], version: 0, plannedOn: { graphics: null, sounds: null }, transcripts: {} }

/** The longest reason kept, Claude's or the user's. */
export const EMPHASIS_REASON_MAX = 200

/** The importances each level lets through: light the key points, medium key and secondary, heavy all. */
export const LEVEL_IMPORTANCE: Record<FlairLevel, readonly Importance[]> = { light: ["key"], medium: ["key", "secondary"], heavy: ["key", "secondary", "extra"] }

/** Whether a point of this importance gets effects at this level. */
export const passesLevel = (importance: Importance, level: FlairLevel): boolean => LEVEL_IMPORTANCE[level].includes(importance)
```

#### 1.2 `packages/core/src/emphasis/filter.ts` (T1)

```ts
/** A stored point where it plays on this rough cut. */
export interface PlacedPoint {
  point: EmphasisPoint
  videoId: string
  /** the beat it plays in */
  beatId: string
  /** index into plan.cuts of the piece its first kept moment plays in */
  cut: number
  /** its first kept moment in the source: a speech point's first kept word start (never before its piece's start), a scene point's first moment inside a kept piece */
  sourceUs: number
  /** where it starts and ends on the rough cut, before rounding to frames */
  atUs: number
  endUs: number
}

/**
 * Where stored points play on a rough cut, in playing order. Pure. A speech point is placed by the
 * rule placeHighlights uses: a word is kept when its middle falls in a kept piece of its video,
 * preferring the pieces of the point's own beat; a point with no kept word is left out. A scene
 * point is placed where its stretch overlaps kept pieces of its video, its own beat's first; none
 * left out when no piece overlaps.
 */
export function placePoints(args: { points: EmphasisPoint[]; plan: CutPlan; wordsOf: (videoId: string) => TimedText[] }): PlacedPoint[]

/** Whether an item bound to a point shows: an item with no point always does; one on a point shows only when that point is placed and passes the level. */
export type PointFilter = (pointId: string | undefined) => boolean

/** The filter for a level: unbound items pass, items on a placed point of an importance the level lets through pass, all others (a point cut away, hidden, or gone) do not. */
export function pointFilter(placed: PlacedPoint[], level: FlairLevel): PointFilter

/** Whether two points claim the same thing: speech on the same video, beat and overlapping words; scene on the same video, beat and overlapping time. Speech never overlaps scene. */
export function pointsOverlap(a: EmphasisAnchor, b: EmphasisAnchor): boolean
```

#### 1.3 `packages/core/src/emphasis/plan.ts` (T1)

```ts
export const EMPHASIS_PROMPT_VERSION = "emphasis-2026-09-27"
/** The prompt built into the app (Thai text per spec §4.2 rules). */
export const EMPHASIS_PROMPT: SystemPrompt

/** A kept scene of a picture beat, numbered s1… for Claude. */
export interface EmphasisScene {
  /** "s1", "s2"… in playing order */
  label: string
  videoId: string
  beatId: string
  beatName: string
  /** the scene's stretch in its file, clipped to what the rough cut keeps */
  startUs: number
  endUs: number
  /** where it starts on the rough cut, and how long it plays there */
  timelineUs: number
  durationUs: number
  description: string
  kind: Scene["kind"]
  /** the beat's own `Beat.visual` */
  visual: string
}

/** A beat as Claude is shown it, in playing order. */
export interface EmphasisBeat {
  id: string
  name: string
  purpose: string
}

export const EmphasisReplySchema = z.object({
  points: z.array(
    z.object({
      /** the sentence's number from 1, or null for a scene point */
      at: z.number().int().nullable(),
      /** "s3" for a scene point, "" for a speech one */
      scene: z.string().default(""),
      /** copied from the sentence, shorter than it; "" for a scene point */
      quote: z.string().default(""),
      importance: z.enum(IMPORTANCE),
      type: z.enum(EMPHASIS_TYPES),
      reason: z.string().default(""),
    }),
  ),
})
export type EmphasisReply = z.infer<typeof EmphasisReplySchema>

/** The request text: brief, beats with purpose, numbered sentences with rough-cut times, scenes s1… with time, length, description, kind and visual. Exported for tests. */
export function describeEmphasis(args: { brief: Brief; durationUs: number; beats: EmphasisBeat[]; sentences: HighlightSentence[]; scenes: EmphasisScene[] }): string

/**
 * Turns Claude's reply into points: a quote is found in its sentence with findQuote; an answer whose
 * sentence, scene or quote does not exist, whose quote is the whole sentence, or whose phrase overlaps
 * an earlier answer or a `kept` point is dropped and counted. The reason is trimmed and cut to
 * EMPHASIS_REASON_MAX. New points are source "ai", edited false, in playing order.
 */
export function acceptEmphasis(args: {
  reply: EmphasisReply
  sentences: HighlightSentence[]
  scenes: EmphasisScene[]
  wordsOf: (videoId: string) => TimedText[]
  /** the user's and edited points that stay: new ones may not overlap them */
  kept: EmphasisPoint[]
  newId: () => string
}): { points: EmphasisPoint[]; dropped: number }

/** One Claude call for the points; no call when there is neither a sentence nor a scene. */
export async function planEmphasis(args: {
  transport: LlmTransport
  model: string
  brief: Brief
  durationUs: number
  beats: EmphasisBeat[]
  sentences: HighlightSentence[]
  scenes: EmphasisScene[]
  wordsOf: (videoId: string) => TimedText[]
  kept: EmphasisPoint[]
  newId: () => string
  prompt?: SystemPrompt
  signal?: AbortSignal
}): Promise<{ points: EmphasisPoint[]; dropped: number }>
```

`packages/core/src/emphasis/index.ts` (T1) re-exports everything of types.ts, filter.ts, plan.ts. `packages/core/package.json` exports gain `"./emphasis": "./src/emphasis/index.ts"` and `"./emphasis/types": "./src/emphasis/types.ts"` (T1).

#### 1.4 `packages/core/src/capcut/lanes.ts` (T3)

```ts
/**
 * Which lane each item goes on, newest on top: in start order, an item takes the lane just above the
 * highest lane still playing when it starts (its end frame after the item's start frame), or lane 0
 * when none is. Frames, so two items that only touch share a lane. Pure.
 */
export function laneOf(items: { startFrame: number; endFrame: number }[]): number[]
```

```ts
/** What a writer laid on the timeline: the draft info after it, how many items it placed, and how many it left out (less than a frame to play; a zoom whose piece is not there, or a second zoom on a piece already zoomed). */
export interface Written {
  info: DraftInfo
  kept: number
  dropped: number
}
```

```ts
export const SOUNDS_PROMPT_VERSION = "sounds-2026-09-27-points"
export const SOUNDS_PROMPT: SystemPrompt

/** A place a sound can go, as Claude is shown it, with the point it serves; null for a place no point is on. */

/** Asks Claude which sound goes on which slot; no call when there is no slot or no sound. */
export async function planSounds(args: { transport: LlmTransport; model: string; brief: Brief; slots: SoundSlot[]; sounds: SoundEffect[]; prompt?: SystemPrompt; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<{ cues: SoundCue[]; dropped: number }>
```

#### 1.6 New in `packages/core/src/flair/direct.ts` (T6; replaces `planFlair`)

```ts
export const TECHNIQUES_PROMPT_VERSION = "techniques-2026-09-27-points"
export const TECHNIQUES_PROMPT: SystemPrompt

/** A point as Claude is shown it for zooms and cutaways. */
export interface TechniquePoint {
  pointId: string
  kind: "speech" | "scene"
  importance: Importance
  type: EmphasisType
  reason: string
  videoId: string
  beatId: string
  /** where it starts on the rough cut */
  atUs: number
  /** where a cutaway on it starts: the phrase's first kept word, or the scene's first kept moment (a "speech" anchor) */
  anchor: CueAnchor
  /** the phrase, or the scene's description */
  text: string
  /** the piece that plays it, when that piece is long enough to zoom; null otherwise */
  piece: ZoomSlot | null
}

export const TechniquesReplySchema = z.object({
  zooms: z.array(z.object({ point: z.number().int(), kind: z.enum(ZOOM_KINDS) })),
  inserts: z.array(z.object({ point: z.number().int(), picture: z.number().int() })),
})
export type TechniquesReply = z.infer<typeof TechniquesReplySchema>

/** Zooms land on the piece of their point (a second zoom on one piece is dropped); cutaways at the point's anchor. Every cue carries its pointId. No quota, no file-once rule. */
export function acceptTechniques(reply: TechniquesReply, points: TechniquePoint[], media: InsertMedia[]): { zooms: ZoomCue[]; inserts: InsertCue[]; dropped: number }

export async function planTechniques(args: {
  transport: LlmTransport
  model: string
  brief: Brief
  points: TechniquePoint[]
  media: InsertMedia[]
  pictureFrames?: Record<string, string[]>
  prompt?: SystemPrompt
  signal?: AbortSignal
}): Promise<{ zooms: ZoomCue[]; inserts: InsertCue[]; dropped: number }>
```

#### 1.8 `apps/desktop/src/main/emphasis.ts` (T4)

```ts
export interface EmphasisDeps {
  outlines: OutlineStore
  timeline: Pick<TimelineService, "compiled">
  llm?: () => Promise<{ transport: LlmTransport; model: string }>
  newId?: () => string
}

export function createEmphasisService(deps: EmphasisDeps): {
  /** Claude plans the points; the user's and edited ones stay, Claude's old ones go with what sat on them; version goes up by one. */
  plan(folder: string, rules: CutRules): Promise<{ count: number; dropped: number }>
  /** Changes a point by hand (it becomes edited), or deletes it with null; see withoutPoint. Importance or phrase changes bump the version. */
  setPoint(folder: string, id: string, patch: EmphasisPatch | null): Promise<void>
  /** A point of the user's on words or a scene they chose; bumps the version; answers the new id. */
  addPoint(folder: string, anchor: EmphasisAnchor): Promise<string>
}
export type EmphasisService = ReturnType<typeof createEmphasisService>

/**
 * The outline with a point taken out: every highlight group, sound, zoom, cutaway and graphic that
 * carries its id and is not edited goes (a group through regroupFlair, so its look and line sounds go
 * too); the edited ones stay with their pointId removed, so they show at every level. Pure.
 * → D7: a group the user made stays too, and an edited item on a line of a group that goes moves to the start of the group's beat (`offGoneLines`, exported beside it).
 */
export function withoutPoint(stored: StoredOutline, pointId: string): StoredOutline

/** The kept scenes of the outline's picture beats (Beat.kind "scenes"), numbered s1… in playing order, as planEmphasis is shown them. */
export function emphasisScenes(stored: StoredOutline, plan: CutPlan, clips: CutClip[]): EmphasisScene[]

/** What the emphasis tab shows (see EmphasisView in §3.3). `items` are the ids carried by what plays now, by kind. Pure. */
export function emphasisView(input: {
  stored: StoredOutline
  plan: CutPlan
  clips: CutClip[]
  level: FlairLevel
  items: { text: (string | undefined)[]; zoom: (string | undefined)[]; insert: (string | undefined)[]; graphic: (string | undefined)[]; sound: (string | undefined)[] }
}): EmphasisView
```

#### 1.9 `apps/desktop/src/main/post-cleanup.ts` (T4)

```ts
/** The post-production data version an outline written by this app carries; one without it is from before M25. */
export const POST_VERSION = 1

/**
 * The one-time cleanup of an outline from before M25: Claude's unedited highlight groups go with their
 * looks and line sounds (regroupFlair with nothing taking them), every unedited sound, zoom, cutaway
 * and graphic goes, and postVersion becomes POST_VERSION. What the user edited stays, with no pointId.
 * An outline that has postVersion is handed back as the same object, so running it twice changes nothing.
 * → D7: an edited sound, cutaway or graphic on a line of a group that goes moves to the start of the group's beat; only unedited line sounds go with their group.
 */
export function withoutOldEffects(stored: StoredOutline): StoredOutline
```

```ts
export interface PostPlanDeps {
  outlines: OutlineStore
  emphasis: Pick<EmphasisService, "plan">
  highlights: Pick<HighlightService, "pick" | "preview">
  flair: Pick<FlairService, "planTechniques" | "planGraphics" | "planSounds">

export function createPostPlanService(deps: PostPlanDeps): {
  /** The run behind the one button (spec §5.1): emphasis; then text, techniques, graphics; then sounds; the subtitles' polish alongside. */
  plan(folder: string, request: PostRequest): Promise<PostRunView>
  /** One work again on the points as they are ("graphics" runs text, techniques and graphics). */
  rethink(folder: string, work: RethinkWork, request: PostRequest): Promise<PostRunView>
  /** The points alone, with the same events (the planEmphasis API). */
  emphasisOnly(folder: string, rules: CutRules): Promise<{ count: number; dropped: number }>
  /** How the run of this project stands, or how the last ended; null when none ran since the app started. */
  state(folder: string): PostRunView | null
}
export type PostPlanService = ReturnType<typeof createPostPlanService>
```

A second `planPost`/`rethinkPost`/`planEmphasis` on a folder whose run is going is refused: `"a plan for this project is already running"`. `cancelAi` stops the run (spec §3.3).

#### 3.2 Removed methods (T8, when the renderer stops calling them)

`pickHighlights`, `planFlair`, `polishSubtitles` — from `API_METHODS`, `DesktopApi`, `LICENSED_METHODS`, `highlight-api.ts`, `timeline-api.ts`, `fake-api.ts` and their tests. `HighlightService.pick` and `TimelineService.polish` stay (the run uses them). Until T8, T5 keeps `pickHighlights` calling `highlights.pick`, and T6 keeps `planFlair` as a shim: `post.rethink(folder, "graphics", { rules, view: options, subtitles: null })`, then `{ preview: await highlights.preview(folder, rules, options), dropped: <sum of the three works' dropped> }`.

#### 3.3 New shared types (in `api.ts`)

```ts
// T4 — the emphasis tab's view, part of HighlightPreview
export type { EmphasisAnchor, EmphasisPatch, EmphasisPoint, EmphasisType, Importance, StoredEmphasis } from "@boxblack/core/emphasis/types"

/** One point as the emphasis tab shows it. */
export interface EmphasisPointView {
  id: string
  anchor: EmphasisAnchor
  importance: Importance
  type: EmphasisType
  reason: string
  source: "ai" | "user"
  edited: boolean
  /** the beat it plays in */
  beatId: string
  /** where it plays on the rough cut, before rounding to frames */
  atUs: number
  endUs: number
  /** the words it stresses, or the scene's description */
  text: string
  /** it passes the level in force: its items play */
  shown: boolean
  /** what plays on it now, by kind */
  items: { text: number; zoom: number; insert: number; graphic: number; sound: number }
}

/** A sentence the rough cut plays, with its words, for picking a phrase in the emphasis tab. */
export interface EmphasisSentenceView {
  videoId: string
  beatId: string
  /** its words [from, to) in the transcript */
  from: number
  to: number
  atUs: number
  words: string[]
}

/** A kept scene of a picture beat, for making a point of it. */
export interface EmphasisSceneView {
  videoId: string
  beatId: string
  /** its stretch in the file, clipped to what is kept */
  startUs: number
  endUs: number
  atUs: number
  durationUs: number
  description: string
  /** the point already on it, if any */
  pointId: string | null
}

export interface EmphasisView {
  /** the stored points placed on this rough cut, in playing order */
  points: EmphasisPointView[]
  sentences: EmphasisSentenceView[]
  scenes: EmphasisSceneView[]
  /** stored points not shown: every word of them cut, or their transcript changed */
  hidden: number
  version: number
  /** the points changed since work 2 (graphics) or work 4 (sounds) last planned on them */
  changed: { graphics: boolean; sounds: boolean }
}

// T6 — the plan run
/** The works of the plan run in the order they run; text, techniques and graphics are work 2's three calls (2a, 2b, 2c). */
export const POST_WORKS = ["emphasis", "text", "techniques", "graphics", "sounds", "subtitles"] as const
export type PostWork = (typeof POST_WORKS)[number]
/** What the AI menu can think again on its own; the points go through planEmphasis. */
export const RETHINK_WORKS = ["graphics", "sounds", "subtitles"] as const
export type RethinkWork = (typeof RETHINK_WORKS)[number]

export type PostWorkState =
  | { state: "waiting" }
  | { state: "running" }
  | { state: "done"; count: number; dropped: number }
  /** off: its switch is off · no-emphasis: the points failed, or there are none · stopped: the user pressed stop before it ran */
  | { state: "skipped"; reason: "off" | "no-emphasis" | "stopped" }
  /** error "cancelled" is the user's stop, not a failure to show */
  | { state: "failed"; error: string }

export interface PostRunView {
  running: boolean
  states: Partial<Record<PostWork, PostWorkState>>
}

/** Everything a plan run needs from the screen: the cut rules, the view options, and the subtitles as they are shown. */
export interface PostRequest {
  rules: CutRules
  view: HighlightViewOptions
  /** null when subtitles are off; `polish` says whether work 5 asks Claude */
  subtitles: { length: SubtitleLength; polish: boolean; hideUnderHighlights: boolean } | null
}
```

`POST_WORKS`/`RETHINK_WORKS` are plain const arrays, which the preload bundle can carry (like `APPEARANCES`).

Skips (T6): text when `!view.highlightsOn`; techniques when `!flair.zoom && !flair.insert`; graphics when `!flair.graphic` or the rough cut has no canvas; sounds when `!flair.sound`; subtitles when `subtitles === null || !subtitles.polish`; text/techniques/graphics/sounds `no-emphasis` when emphasis failed or no point is placed. `plannedOn.graphics` = the version work 2 started on, set when none of its calls that ran failed (→ D16: also when every call was skipped "off"); `plannedOn.sounds` likewise for work 4. Works 2 and 4 plan on every placed point (`SHOW_ALL`), whatever the level (→ D15: through `pointFilter(placed, "heavy")`).

#### 3.4 `WriteResult` (T3)

```ts
export interface WriteResult {
  backup: BackupInfo
  durationUs: number
  segmentCount: number
  /** subtitle segments written */
  captionCount: number
  /** highlight text lines written */
  highlightCount: number
  /** what each writer really placed */
  soundCount: number
  zoomCount: number
  insertCount: number
  graphicCount: number
  /** what the writers left out: less than a frame left to play (a zoom: its piece not on the timeline, or a second zoom on a piece already zoomed) */
  dropped: { sounds: number; zooms: number; inserts: number; graphics: number }
  /** zooms stored whose piece is not on the rough cut any more */
  zoomsLost: number
  /** graphics left out because their render failed, or their file was gone by the write */
  graphicsSkipped: number
  /** emphasis points placed on the rough cut that pass the level in force; 0 without a highlight request */
  emphasisCount: number
}
```
