### 4. New `AppEvent` variants (T6)

```ts
  /** how one work of a plan run stands; a run starts by sending "waiting" for every work it will touch */
  | { type: "post-plan"; folder: string; work: PostWork; state: PostWorkState }
  /** a plan run (planPost, rethinkPost or planEmphasis) is over, stopped or not */
  | { type: "post-plan-finished"; folder: string }
```

The renderer re-reads the preview on every `done` of emphasis/text/techniques/graphics/sounds, and the subtitle lines on `done` of subtitles.

---

### 5. `StoredOutline` additions and the cleanup marker

```ts
export interface StoredOutline {
  // … unchanged fields …
  /** T2 — the emphasis points and their bookkeeping; absent until points are planned or added */
  emphasis?: StoredEmphasis
  /** T4 — the user's or the polish's text per subtitle line, by `SubtitleLine.key` */
  subtitleTexts?: Record<string, string>
  /** T4 — POST_VERSION once the pre-M25 cleanup ran (or the outline was made by M25); absent on older outlines */
  postVersion?: number
}
```

T2 only declares `emphasis` (it reads it for the filter); T4 declares the other two and writes all three.

Cleanup marker: `postVersion === undefined` ⇒ `withoutOldEffects` runs once when the store reads the outline (`OutlineStore` built with `{ upgrade: withoutOldEffects }` in `index.ts` only), result written back with `writeFileAtomic` through `ProjectFiles.update`; `postVersion: 1` afterwards. Re-running on a cleaned outline returns the same object. New outlines from `planner.run` carry `postVersion: POST_VERSION`.

`shell/StageChips.tsx:4-12`:

/** The four stages of the work, in order. */
export type Stage = "prepare" | "outline" | "post" | "write"
export const STAGES: Stage[] = ["prepare", "outline", "post", "write"]
const LABELS: Record<Stage, "stage.prepare" | "stage.outline" | "stage.post" | "stage.write"> = { prepare: "stage.prepare", outline: "stage.outline", post: "stage.post", write: "stage.write" }

`App.tsx`: `WorkScreen` (:18-22) replaces `timeline` by `{ name: "post"; project: ProjectDetail; stored: StoredOutline }` and `{ name: "write"; project: ProjectDetail; stored: StoredOutline }`; `goTimeline` (:149) becomes `goPost` and a new `goWrite` (same shape); `stageOf` (:41) maps them; `reachable` (:167) `post` and `write` = `journey.stored?.confirmed === true`; `shut` (:175) unchanged (outline only); `storedChanged` (:158) sends a no-longer-confirmed outline back from `post` or `write`; `onStage` (:177); toolbar shown for `post` and `write`; `OutlineScreen onConfirmed` goes to `post`. Rendered as:

```tsx
{licensed && (screen.name === "post" || screen.name === "write") && (
  <ClipRoom key={screen.project.folder} api={api} project={screen.project} stored={screen.stored} capcutRunning={capcutRunning} draftVersion={restoredVersion} claim={claimRoom} onWritten={() => setBackupsVersion((n) => n + 1)} page={screen.name}>
    {screen.name === "post" ? <PostScreen onEditOutline={…} onToolbar={setToolbar} onGoWrite={() => goWrite(screen.project, screen.stored)} /> : <WriteScreen onToolbar={setToolbar} backupsKey={backupsVersion} onRestored={…} />}
  </ClipRoom>
)}
```

`room/ClipRoom.tsx` (new):

```ts
/** How the write to this draft stands, as the room last heard. A failed one is idle with `error` set. */
export type WriteState = { kind: "idle" } | { kind: "writing" } | { kind: "written"; result: WriteResult } // → D18: "written" also carries `level: FlairLevel | null`

export interface ClipRoomProps {
  api: RendererApi
  project: ProjectDetail
  stored: StoredOutline
  capcutRunning: boolean | null
  /** bumped when a backup was restored: the draft is no longer what it was */
  draftVersion?: number
  /** tells the app which draft's write ends this room tells itself, and with null that it tells none */
  claim?: (folder: string | null) => void
  /** a write took a new backup */
  onWritten?: () => void
  /** the page showing: a write that ends while the post page shows is told by a toast there */
  page: "post" | "write"
  children: ReactNode
}

export interface ClipRoomValue {
  api: RendererApi
  folder: string
  project: ProjectDetail
  stored: StoredOutline
  capcutRunning: boolean | null
  rules: CutRules | null
  presets: Record<CutPresetId, CutPreset>
  subtitles: SubtitleOptions | null
  highlights: HighlightOptions | null
  flair: FlairOptions | null
  plan: CutPlan | null
  /** read whatever is switched on or off; null until the first answer */
  preview: HighlightPreview | null
  lines: SubtitleLine[] | null
  /** one per line: `savedText` when there is one, else the generated text */
  texts: string[]
  error: string | null
  setError: (message: string | null) => void
  /** the groups are being placed again: nothing is written meanwhile */
  placing: boolean
  deciding: boolean
  /** a change of the user's is being saved */
  editing: boolean
  /** the main process has said whether a write to this draft is running */
  writeKnown: boolean
  write: WriteState
  /** a write is running: the post page shows but changes nothing */
  writing: boolean
  run: PostRunView
  decide(videoId: string, change: CutDecisionChange): Promise<void>
  changeRules(next: CutRules): void
  changeSubtitles(next: SubtitleOptions): void
  changeHighlights(next: HighlightOptions): void
  changeFlair(next: FlairOptions): void
  /** saves a change to what is stored, then places everything again; answers the failure's message, or null */
  changeHighlightText(action: () => Promise<unknown>, showsFailure?: boolean): Promise<string | null>
  /** a subtitle line typed by the user: shown at once, saved with setSubtitleText (null when back to the generated text) */
  editSubtitle(index: number, text: string): void
  /** the PostRequest for the settings on screen, or null before they are read */
  request(): PostRequest | null
  planPost(): Promise<void>
  rethink(work: RethinkWork | "emphasis"): Promise<void>
  /** runs a write the write page built: marks it as this room's own, follows it to its end, refreshes the project */
  runWrite(call: () => Promise<WriteResult>): Promise<void>
}

export function ClipRoom(props: ClipRoomProps): ReactElement
export function useClipRoom(): ClipRoomValue
```

State/effect moves out of `screens/EditScreen.tsx` (today's lines): into ClipRoom — `project` (:89), `rules` (:90), `presets` (:91), `plan` (:92), `phase` (:93, becomes `write`), `writeKnown` (:95), `ownWrite` (:97), `following` (:100), `error` (:101), `subtitles` (:102), `lines` (:103), `texts` (:104), `decisionsVersion` (:107), `deciding` (:108), `highlights` (:109), `flair` (:110), `preview` (:115), `highlightsVersion` (:117), `graphicsVersion` (:120), `highlightTextVersion` (:122), `placing` (:125-131), `editingHighlights` (:132 → `editing`), the refs (:142-148), and the effects at :156-170, :177-227, :230-236, :239-244, :246-256, :269-298 (no longer gated on `highlightsOn`; sends `highlightsOn`), :303-324, :329-342 (texts from `savedText`), :384-395; the actions `decide`, `changeSubtitles`, `changeFlair`, `changeHighlights`, `changeRules`, `changeHighlightText`, `answered`. Gone: `polishing`/`polishNotice` (:105-106), `planningFlair`/`flairDropped`/`graphicsError` (:111-114), `picking` (:123), `dropped` (:133), `settingsOpen`/`settingsTab` (:136-137), `edits` (:141, replaced by main) — their jobs go to `run` and the post-plan events. To PostScreen: `selectedBeat` (:134), `tab` (:135), `editingGraphic` (:139). To WriteScreen: `canWrite` (:543) and the write call (:493-517 minus the ownWrite/following bookkeeping, which is `runWrite`).

### 9. Decisions the spec leaves open

1. **The level filter runs in main's `*InForce`, not in core `enforce*`** — the spec puts the predicate in core (T1 `pointFilter`) and says every read function filters; keeping `enforce*` level-free makes them pure rules and one `passes` input carries the filter everywhere.
2. **Items the level hides are neither kept nor counted as dropped** — they are stored and wait for the level, so counting them as losses would mislead.
3. **A `pointId` naming a point that no longer exists hides the item** — deletion clears ids of edited items and removes the rest, so a dangling id can only be Claude's leftover.
4. **Highlight groups are filtered in `placeStored`** (via `ShowRules`) — so a hidden group also stops hiding subtitles, offering sound slots and pushing graphics, the same as a group that is not there.
5. **`HighlightViewOptions.highlightsOn` and `HighlightRequest.highlightsOn` are new** — today highlight text off means no preview and no flair written at all; with a switch per work, sounds, zooms, cutaways and graphics must preview and write with the text off.
6. **`FlairOptions.enabled` stays in the type, deprecated, default true** — settings files and requests still carry it (spec §7), and removing it would change every validator for nothing.
7. **Points are only made on picture beats' scenes (`Beat.kind === "scenes"`)** — speech beats are covered by their sentences; spec §4.2 says "บีตภาพ".
8. **Scene points and scene groups skip the transcript check** — their anchors are file times, which a new transcript does not move.
9. **Items on scene points use a `"speech"`-kind `CueAnchor` at the scene's first kept moment** — `placeOf`, `sentenceOf` and the graphic validators already place such a moment without a sentence, so no new anchor kind is needed.
10. **Any `setEmphasisPoint` patch makes the point `edited` (→ D5: any patch that changes something), but only importance and phrase changes bump `version`; add bumps; delete does not** — spec §4.4 lists which changes raise the banner; a deleted point takes its items with it, so works 2 and 4 have nothing to redo.
11. **`plannedOn` is set to the version a work started on, only when none of its calls that ran failed** (→ D6 for how the tab reads it, D16 for a work whose calls were all off) — an edit made during the run keeps the banner, and a failed call keeps it too.
12. **Beat-edge and join slots stay in `slotsFor` for the user's picks; only Claude's list (`soundSlotsFor`) drops them** — edited sounds on beat edges must keep playing (spec §7 keeps the user's items).
13. **`cuesInForce` resolves cues through `placeOf`** (T6) — sounds on point starts and graphic starts are speech moments, which `slotFinder` cannot place.
14. **Works 2 and 4 plan on every placed point (`SHOW_ALL`; → D15: `pointFilter(placed, "heavy")`, the same points)** — spec §4.3 says AI plans for all points at every level; the level only filters at read time.
15. **`planPost` resolves (never rejects on a stop) with each work's state; a stop marks the running work failed "cancelled" and the rest skipped "stopped"** — the page shows per-tab results either way, and "cancelled" stays silent as today.
16. **`postPlanState` API and a `post-plan-finished` event** — the room remounts after the settings screen, so a run going on must be read from main (renderer-layout memory note).
17. **One run per project at a time; a second is refused** — the run writes the outline piece by piece and two would interleave.
18. **`planEmphasis` stays a separate API (spec §4.4); `rethinkPost` covers graphics, sounds and subtitles** — spec names planEmphasis; the other rethinks share one method.
19. **Emphasis rethink does not start works 2 and 4** — spec §5.1: only the banner.
20. **`pickHighlights`, `planFlair`, `polishSubtitles` stay as shims until T8 removes them** — each task must leave the renderer green, and T8 is the task that replaces the AI menu.
21. **Subtitle texts: `SubtitleLine.text` stays the generated line, new `savedText` carries the stored one; the renderer sends `null` when a line is typed back to the generated text** — keeps the key and the renderer fixtures stable and the stored map small.
22. **`setSubtitleText` caps the map at 5 000 keys** (→ D4: by forgetting the oldest, not by refusing) — a limit keeps a bad renderer from growing the outline file without end (the other validators cap similarly).
23. **The write phase lives in ClipRoom, not WriteScreen** — spec §3.2 puts it on the write page, but a write must survive switching to the post page and back, and ClipRoom is the part that stays mounted; WriteScreen keeps `canWrite` and builds the call.
24. **A write that ends while the post page shows is told there by a toast from ClipRoom** — the app only toasts when neither page is open (spec §3.4), so someone else must tell it.
25. **The cleanup runs through an `upgrade` option of `ProjectFiles`, passed only in `index.ts`** — spec §12 names project-files.ts; opting in at the one real construction leaves every existing test fixture (outlines without `postVersion`) untouched.
26. **New outlines from `planner.run` carry `postVersion: 1`** — nothing to clean, and the marker then means "M25 data" everywhere.
27. **Writers return `Written { info, kept, dropped }`; insert and graphic lanes use `laneOf` (newest on top), sounds keep their first-free lanes** — spec §6.1 changes only cutaways and graphics; sounds were already on lanes.
28. **The graphic end trim applies only to a one-frame overlap (a graphic still playing on only the frame a later written graphic starts on ends on that frame; the writer gets `atUs` already on the rounded pieces, so raw µs cannot show a rounding overlap); cutaways get no trim, the lane takes the one-frame overlap** — spec §6.1.
29. **Zoom losses are reported twice: `HighlightPreview.zoomsLost` before writing and `WriteResult.zoomsLost` after** — spec §11 wants lost zooms counted on the write page, which shows the summary before the write too.
30. **`enforceZooms` treats two zooms as one piece when `anchor.videoId`, `sourceUs` and `beatId` match (after `zoomsInForce` puts each on its slot's anchor)** — spec §6.2; core cannot import main's `pieceKey`.
31. **The "Aa เน้น" and "รูป" buttons move to each point row of the emphasis tab** — spec §3.3 says they leave the speech rows "(ดูแท็บจุดเน้น)"; this keeps `addHighlightGroup` and `setInsert` reachable by hand.
32. **Level labels become เบา · กลาง · จัดเต็ม** — spec §2 uses เบา; the key `flair.level.light` is reworded.
33. **The emphasis tab receives sentences with their words (`EmphasisSentenceView.words`)** — picking a phrase needs word-level choice, which `CutRow` does not carry.
34. **Mutation list per task under `mut25/t<N>-<name>.json`** — one file per task keeps the lists apart for the executor.

## Changes after review

Recorded 2026-09-29 in Task 9 (release 0.4.0), from the spec and quality reviews of Tasks 1–8, the final whole-M25 review with its fix round, and the live test. Where this section and anything above disagree (a task's code, a test, a mutation list entry or the contract), this section and the code win. The spec's §13.1 lists the same changes in Thai, with the known limits the reviews accepted.

**After release (0.4.1, 2026-09-29):** the user cancelled M26 (colour), so 0.4.1 removed colour from the app: `"colour"` left `POST_TABS` (and its `MARKS` row in `BeatSidebar.tsx`), the colour tab's placeholder (`post.tab.colour`, `post.colourSoon`) and the write summary's `write.colour` row are gone, and the post page has five tabs (cut, emphasis, graphics, sound, subtitles). Every six-tab or colour-placeholder line above is 0.4.0's; Task 9 Part A's colour-spike result stays true and is kept as reference (spec §14).

### Lines above that no longer hold

- Task 1 Step 3 (the `said(3, "ทักมาได้เลย"), // the whole sentence` case), Step 9 (`anchorOf`'s whole-sentence `return null` and the `acceptEmphasis` doc), Step 13 (the "whole-sentence quote kept" mutation) and contract §1.3's `acceptEmphasis` doc: a whole-sentence quote is accepted now.
- Task 4 "The subtitle-text cap forgets the oldest instead of refusing": "`polishStored` … with no cap" is obsolete (`withTexts`).
- Task 5 and contract §2.2 on `regroupFlair`'s `orElse` being handed only the items no free line takes: it gets the whole list after following.
- Contract D13 on where `pointText`/`pointAnchor` live.
- Task 8's note that a point-bound picture is silent after a cut moves its point's start: `itemPlaceOf` plays it at the point's start.
- Contract decision 3's "a dangling id can only be Claude's leftover" still holds, but a user-made item can now carry a `pointId` (`setPointPicture`, `addHighlightGroup`'s `pointId`), and it follows its point's level.
- Task 9 Part A: the scratchpad scripts differ from the code printed here. `applyAdjust` must splice the added refs in before it looks up changed materials by `refIndex` (the printed version looks them up first); `draft-summary` is 0917-only; `draft-backup` refuses non-0917 manifests and survives a failed Trash move; `check` uses `diff -rq`; outputs live under `$S/m25`; Step 12 asks for Cmd+S before Cmd+Q; Step 13 compares `written.json` with `reopened.json` (`cmp`). The fixed `adjust.mts` lives only in the session scratchpad (/private/tmp), so an M26 writer must not copy the printed `applyAdjust`.

### Tests added after the plan

- `apps/desktop/src/main/post-flow.test.ts`: the chain end to end in main: the one button plans every work on the points, the preview at each level is what the write lays, the banner follows the points as they change, and point-bound items whose own moment is cut play at the point's start (or nowhere when the point is off the cut).
- `npm test` at release: 149 files, 2,260 passed, 3 skipped; `npm run typecheck` clean.
